queries.sql: WITH catalog_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date AS sales_date, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS catalog_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ), web_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date AS sales_date, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS web_net_paid, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ) SELECT COALESCE(cd.sales_date, wd.sales_date) AS sales_date, cd.catalog_net_paid, wd.web_net_paid, wd.web_net_paid - cd.catalog_net_paid AS net_paid_diff, CASE WHEN cd.catalog_net_paid = 0 THEN NULL ELSE wd.web_net_paid / cd.catalog_net_paid END AS web_to_catalog_ratio, CASE WHEN cd.catalog_net_paid = 0 THEN 'Undefined' WHEN wd.web_net_paid > cd.catalog_net_paid * 1.10 THEN 'Web > Catalog +10%' ELSE 'Normal' END AS sales_flag, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(cd.catalog_net_paid,0) + COALESCE(wd.web_net_paid,0)) DESC) AS total_sales_rank FROM catalog_daily cd FULL OUTER JOIN web_daily wd ON cd.sales_date = wd.sales_date ORDER BY total_sales_rank LIMIT 100

WITH sales_with_dates AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq, cs.cs_net_profit, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_close.d_date AS close_date FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_close ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, cc_name AS call_center_name, d_year AS year, d_month_seq AS month_seq, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_monthly_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(cs_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(cs_net_profit) > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY SUM(cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank, MIN(open_date) AS open_date, MAX(close_date) AS close_date FROM sales_with_dates GROUP BY cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, profit_rank

WITH recent_ship_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode, cs.cs_net_profit, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax, d.d_year FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim) ) SELECT call_center_name, ship_mode, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid, CASE WHEN SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cs_net_profit) / SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS profit_margin, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY call_center_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cs_net_profit) / SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) END DESC) AS margin_rank, CASE WHEN (SUM(cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax),0)) > ( SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE profit / net_paid END) FROM ( SELECT cs.cs_net_profit AS profit, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk WHERE d2.d_year = (SELECT MAX(d_year) FROM date_dim) ) sub ) THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS margin_category FROM recent_ship_sales GROUP BY call_center_name, ship_mode ORDER BY call_center_name, margin_rank

WITH catalog_monthly AS ( SELECT d.d_year AS year, d.d_month_seq AS month_seq, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_month_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ), sales_with_cc AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, d.d_year AS year, d.d_month_seq AS month_seq, ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, d.d_date AS sale_date FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON d.d_date_sk = cc.cc_open_date_sk ), monthly_customer AS ( SELECT customer_sk, call_center_name, year, month_seq, SUM(net_profit) AS month_profit, MIN(sale_date) AS month_start, MAX(sale_date) AS month_end FROM sales_with_cc GROUP BY customer_sk, call_center_name, year, month_seq ), customer_with_catalog AS ( SELECT mc.*, cm.catalog_month_profit FROM monthly_customer mc LEFT JOIN catalog_monthly cm ON mc.year = cm.year AND mc.month_seq = cm.month_seq ), profit_with_lag AS ( SELECT customer_sk, call_center_name, year, month_seq, month_profit, catalog_month_profit, month_start, month_end, LAG(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY year, month_seq) AS prev_month_profit FROM customer_with_catalog ), growth_flag AS ( SELECT customer_sk, call_center_name, month_profit, prev_month_profit, catalog_month_profit, month_start, month_end, CASE WHEN prev_month_profit IS NOT NULL AND month_profit > prev_month_profit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS grew FROM profit_with_lag ) SELECT g.customer_sk, MAX(g.call_center_name) AS call_center_name, SUM(g.month_profit) AS total_web_profit, SUM(g.catalog_month_profit) AS total_catalog_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(g.month_profit) DESC) AS web_profit_rank, CASE WHEN MIN(g.grew) = 1 THEN 'Consistent Growth' ELSE 'Irregular' END AS growth_pattern, MIN(g.month_start) AS first_purchase_date, MAX(g.month_end) AS last_purchase_date FROM growth_flag g GROUP BY g.customer_sk ORDER BY web_profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH combined_returns AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk AS addr_sk,
           cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax AS return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk AS addr_sk,
           wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax AS return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
),
address_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_address_id,
        ca.ca_city,
        ca.ca_state,
        SUM(cr.return_amount) AS total_return_amount
    FROM combined_returns cr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_address_id, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state
),
sales_by_address AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_address_id,
        ca.ca_city,
        ca.ca_state,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_address_id, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state
)
SELECT
    ar.ca_address_id,
    ar.ca_city,
    ar.ca_state,
    ar.total_return_amount,
    sb.total_sales_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN ar.total_return_amount > 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN ar.total_return_amount > 500 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_rank
FROM address_returns ar
LEFT JOIN sales_by_address sb
    ON ar.ca_address_id = sb.ca_address_id
    AND ar.ca_city = sb.ca_city
    AND ar.ca_state = sb.ca_state
WHERE ar.total_return_amount > 0
ORDER BY return_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS sales_amount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ss.ss_item_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS return_qty,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, cr.cr_item_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS return_qty,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, wr.wr_item_sk
),
returns_combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        item_sk,
        SUM(return_qty) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(return_amount) AS total_return_amount
    FROM returns_agg
    GROUP BY ca_state, item_sk
)
SELECT
    s.ca_state,
    s.item_sk,
    s.sold_qty,
    COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS return_qty,
    s.sales_amount,
    COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN s.sold_qty = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.sold_qty
    END AS return_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN CASE
                WHEN s.sold_qty = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.sold_qty
             END > 0.2 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS return_rate_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN s.sold_qty = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.sold_qty
        END DESC) AS state_item_rank
FROM sales_agg s
LEFT JOIN returns_combined r
    ON s.ca_state = r.ca_state AND s.item_sk = r.item_sk
WHERE s.sold_qty > 0
ORDER BY s.ca_state, state_item_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_id,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    d.sale_date,
    d.web_page_id,
    d.daily_net_paid,
    AVG(d.daily_net_paid) OVER (
        PARTITION BY d.web_page_id
        ORDER BY d.sale_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_7d,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.sale_date ORDER BY d.daily_net_paid DESC) AS daily_page_rank,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promo') AS promo_name,
    CASE
        WHEN d.daily_net_paid > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN d.daily_net_paid BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS revenue_category
FROM daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN promotion p
    ON d.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk

WITH cust_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amount
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.total_net_profit,
    c.total_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN c.total_net_profit > 0 THEN c.total_return_amount / c.total_net_profit ELSE NULL END AS return_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN c.total_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN c.total_net_profit BETWEEN 5000 AND 20000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM cust_agg c

WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        p.p_channel_email,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders_count,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM promotion p
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv
), promo_returns AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amount
    FROM promotion p
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    ps.p_promo_id,
    ps.p_promo_name,
    ps.orders_count,
    ps.total_sales,
    ps.total_discount,
    pr.total_return_amount,
    (ps.total_net_profit - pr.total_return_amount) AS net_profit_after_returns,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ps.total_net_profit - pr.total_return_amount) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE WHEN ps.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email'
        WHEN ps.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS primary_channel
FROM promo_sales ps
LEFT JOIN promo_returns pr
    ON ps.p_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk

WITH sales_returns AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        COALESCE(ws.ws_net_profit, 0) AS net_profit,
        COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0) AS return_amt,
        CASE WHEN wr.wr_return_amt > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_return_flag
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
), cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        sr.c_customer_sk,
        sr.c_customer_id,
        sr.c_first_name,
        sr.c_last_name,
        sr.ws_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(sr.net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.c_customer_sk ORDER BY sr.ws_sold_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_profit,
        SUM(sr.return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.c_customer_sk ORDER BY sr.ws_sold_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_return,
        MAX(sr.high_return_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.c_customer_sk) AS any_high_return
    FROM sales_returns sr
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    cum.cumulative_profit,
    cum.cumulative_return,
    CASE WHEN cum.any_high_return = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS high_return_occurred,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cum.cumulative_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN cum.cumulative_profit > 50000 THEN 'VIP'
        WHEN cum.cumulative_profit > 20000 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Regular'
    END AS customer_segment
FROM cumulative cum
JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = cum.c_customer_sk
WHERE cum.ws_sold_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(ws2.ws_sold_date_sk) FROM web_sales ws2)

WITH sales_quarter AS (
  SELECT d.d_quarter_seq,
         d.d_year,
         SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_year
),
 returns_quarter AS (
  SELECT d.d_quarter_seq,
         d.d_year,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_returns
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_year
),
 quarter_combined AS (
  SELECT s.d_quarter_seq,
         s.d_year,
         s.total_sales_amount,
         s.total_sales_profit,
         r.total_return_amount,
         r.total_return_loss,
         (s.total_sales_amount - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0)) AS net_sales_amount,
         (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit,
         CASE
           WHEN s.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) / s.total_sales_amount
         END AS profit_margin,
         CASE
           WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Profitable'
           ELSE 'Loss'
         END AS quarter_status,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank
  FROM sales_quarter s
  LEFT JOIN returns_quarter r ON s.d_quarter_seq = r.d_quarter_seq AND s.d_year = r.d_year
)
SELECT d_quarter_seq,
       d_year,
       total_sales_amount,
       total_return_amount,
       net_sales_amount,
       net_profit,
       profit_margin,
       quarter_status,
       profit_rank
FROM quarter_combined
WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2002
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 12

WITH daily_sales AS (
  SELECT d.d_date,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_date
),
 daily_returns AS (
  SELECT d.d_date,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count_returns
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_date
)
SELECT d.d_date,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) AS sales_profit,
       COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS return_loss,
       COALESCE(s.avg_vehicle_count_sales, 0) AS avg_vehicle_sales,
       COALESCE(r.avg_vehicle_count_returns, 0) AS avg_vehicle_returns,
       (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_impact,
       CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) >= 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS impact_category,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM date_dim d
LEFT JOIN daily_sales s ON s.d_date = d.d_date
LEFT JOIN daily_returns r ON r.d_date = d.d_date
WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
ORDER BY net_impact DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH sales_by_hh AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers_sales,
         AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  GROUP BY ss.ss_hdemo_sk
),
 returns_by_hh AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers_returns,
         AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_quantity_returns
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
)
SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk,
       hd.hd_income_band_sk,
       hd.hd_vehicle_count,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) AS total_sales_profit,
       COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
       (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_contribution,
       (COALESCE(s.distinct_customers_sales, 0) + COALESCE(r.distinct_customers_returns, 0)) AS total_customers,
       CASE
         WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) >= 5000 THEN 'High Contributor'
         WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium Contributor'
         ELSE 'Low/Negative Contributor'
       END AS contribution_category,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM household_demographics hd
LEFT JOIN sales_by_hh s ON hd.hd_demo_sk = s.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_by_hh r ON hd.hd_demo_sk = r.hd_demo_sk
WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY net_contribution DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT d.d_week_seq,
         MIN(d.d_date) AS week_start_date,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS week_sales_profit,
         AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_week_seq
),
 weekly_returns AS (
  SELECT d.d_week_seq,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS week_return_loss,
         AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_returns
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_week_seq
),
 weekly_combined AS (
  SELECT s.d_week_seq,
         s.week_start_date,
         s.week_sales_profit,
         r.week_return_loss,
         s.avg_vehicle_sales,
         r.avg_vehicle_returns,
         (s.week_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.week_return_loss, 0)) AS net_week_impact
  FROM weekly_sales s
  LEFT JOIN weekly_returns r ON s.d_week_seq = r.d_week_seq
)
SELECT wc.d_week_seq,
       wc.week_start_date,
       wc.week_sales_profit,
       wc.week_return_loss,
       wc.net_week_impact,
       LAG(wc.net_week_impact) OVER (ORDER BY wc.d_week_seq) AS prev_week_impact,
       (wc.net_week_impact - LAG(wc.net_week_impact) OVER (ORDER BY wc.d_week_seq)) AS week_delta,
       CASE WHEN (wc.net_week_impact - LAG(wc.net_week_impact) OVER (ORDER BY wc.d_week_seq)) > 10000 THEN 'Significant Increase' ELSE 'Stable/Decrease' END AS impact_trend,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wc.net_week_impact DESC) AS profit_percent_rank
FROM weekly_combined wc
WHERE wc.d_week_seq BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000
ORDER BY wc.d_week_seq
LIMIT 25

SELECT d.d_year, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) AS total_return_loss, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) - SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)) AS adjusted_profit, CASE WHEN (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) - SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)) > 5000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) - SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)) > 2000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) - SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)) DESC) AS profit_rank, MIN(t.t_hour) AS first_purchase_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY d.d_year, profit_rank

SELECT d.d_year, cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity),0) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_year, AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY d.d_year, profit_rank_in_year

SELECT d_sold.d_date, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax),0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity),0) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)/SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) END AS profit_margin, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)/SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 0.2 THEN 3 WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)/SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 0.1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC) AS profit_tier_rank, MIN(t_sold.t_hour) AS first_sale_hour, MAX(t_sold.t_hour) AS last_sale_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk GROUP BY d_sold.d_date ORDER BY d_sold.d_date

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT d.d_date, t.t_hour, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS sales_qty FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, t.t_hour ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT d.d_date, t.t_hour, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS return_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS return_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, t.t_hour ) SELECT s.d_date, s.t_hour, s.sales_amount, COALESCE(r.return_amount,0) AS return_amount, s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss,0) AS net_profit, SUM(s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_date ORDER BY s.t_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_date ORDER BY s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss,0) DESC) AS profit_hour_rank, CASE WHEN s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss,0) > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss,0) > 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_level FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.d_date = r.d_date AND s.t_hour = r.t_hour ORDER BY s.d_date, s.t_hour

WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        p.p_channel_email,
        p.p_channel_tv,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders_count,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        MAX(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS latest_sale_date_sk
    FROM promotion p
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv
), promo_returns AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_transactions
    FROM promotion p
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws
        ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    ps.p_promo_id,
    ps.p_promo_name,
    ps.orders_count,
    ps.total_sales,
    ps.total_discount,
    pr.total_return_amount,
    (ps.total_net_profit - pr.total_return_amount) AS net_profit_after_returns,
    (ps.total_sales / NULLIF(ps.orders_count, 0)) AS avg_sale_per_order,
    CASE WHEN ps.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email'
        WHEN ps.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS primary_channel,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.p_discount_active ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_within_status
FROM promo_sales ps
LEFT JOIN promo_returns pr
    ON ps.p_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY net_profit_after_returns DESC

SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk, i.i_brand_id ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk, i.i_brand_id ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk) AS return_seq, CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk, i.i_brand_id ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > 5000 THEN 'High Cumulative Loss' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_category FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.s_store_sk, i.i_brand_id, sr.sr_returned_date_sk LIMIT 100

WITH store_item AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_qty, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk ), web_item AS ( SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_qty, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, COALESCE(si.store_qty, 0) AS store_qty, COALESCE(si.store_net_loss, 0) AS store_net_loss, COALESCE(wi.web_qty, 0) AS web_qty, COALESCE(wi.web_net_loss, 0) AS web_net_loss, (COALESCE(si.store_net_loss,0) - COALESCE(wi.web_net_loss,0)) AS net_loss_diff FROM item i LEFT JOIN store_item si ON i.i_item_sk = si.sr_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_item wi ON i.i_item_sk = wi.wr_item_sk ) SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, store_qty, web_qty, store_net_loss, web_net_loss, net_loss_diff, CASE WHEN net_loss_diff > 0 THEN 'Store Worse' WHEN net_loss_diff < 0 THEN 'Web Worse' ELSE 'Equal' END AS loss_source, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_loss_diff DESC) AS loss_diff_rank FROM combined WHERE (store_qty + web_qty) > 0 ORDER BY loss_diff_rank LIMIT 20

WITH store_state_agg AS ( SELECT s.s_state, s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS state_store_net_loss FROM store s JOIN store_returns sr ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk GROUP BY s.s_state, s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name ), state_total AS ( SELECT s_state, SUM(state_store_net_loss) AS total_state_net_loss FROM store_state_agg GROUP BY s_state ), web_total AS ( SELECT SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss FROM web_returns wr ) SELECT sa.s_state, sa.s_store_sk, sa.s_store_name, sa.state_store_net_loss, st.total_state_net_loss, (sa.state_store_net_loss / NULLIF(st.total_state_net_loss,0)) * 100 AS store_state_pct, CASE WHEN (sa.state_store_net_loss / NULLIF(st.total_state_net_loss,0)) * 100 > 5 THEN 'Key Store' ELSE 'Regular Store' END AS store_role, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.s_state ORDER BY sa.state_store_net_loss DESC) AS store_rank_in_state, wt.total_web_net_loss FROM store_state_agg sa JOIN state_total st ON sa.s_state = st.s_state CROSS JOIN web_total wt ORDER BY sa.s_state, store_rank_in_state LIMIT 50

SELECT d.d_year,
       cs.cs_item_sk,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
       SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
       AVG(t.t_hour) FILTER (WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17) AS avg_business_hour,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rownum
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0
GROUP BY d.d_year, cs.cs_item_sk
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT d.d_year,
       cs.cs_item_sk,
       SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
       COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS net_profit_after_returns,
       CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) > 15000 THEN 'VERY HIGH'
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) > 8000 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) > 3000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_year,
       MIN(t.t_hour) AS earliest_sale_hour
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
GROUP BY d.d_year, cs.cs_item_sk
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 1000
ORDER BY d.d_year DESC, profit_rank_in_year

SELECT d.d_year,
       cs.cs_item_sk,
       SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
       COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS net_profit_after_returns,
       NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) DESC) AS profit_quartile,
       MAX(t.t_hour) AS latest_sale_hour
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
GROUP BY d.d_year, cs.cs_item_sk
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0
ORDER BY d.d_year, profit_quartile

WITH store_item AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS store_returns_cnt, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_qty FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk ), web_item AS ( SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS web_returns_cnt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_qty FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, COALESCE(si.store_qty,0) AS store_qty, COALESCE(wi.web_qty,0) AS web_qty, COALESCE(si.store_returns_cnt,0) AS store_cnt, COALESCE(wi.web_returns_cnt,0) AS web_cnt, (COALESCE(si.store_qty,0) - COALESCE(wi.web_qty,0)) AS qty_diff FROM item i LEFT JOIN store_item si ON i.i_item_sk = si.sr_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_item wi ON i.i_item_sk = wi.wr_item_sk ) SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, store_qty, web_qty, store_cnt, web_cnt, qty_diff, CASE WHEN qty_diff > 0 THEN 'Store Higher Qty' WHEN qty_diff < 0 THEN 'Web Higher Qty' ELSE 'Equal Qty' END AS qty_trend, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN qty_diff > 0 THEN 'Store' ELSE 'Web' END ORDER BY qty_diff DESC) AS row_num FROM combined WHERE (store_qty + web_qty) > 0 ORDER BY qty_diff DESC LIMIT 20

WITH store_item AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_qty, AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_store_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk ), web_item AS ( SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_qty, AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_web_loss FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, COALESCE(si.store_qty,0) AS store_qty, COALESCE(wi.web_qty,0) AS web_qty, COALESCE(si.avg_store_loss,0) AS avg_store_loss, COALESCE(wi.avg_web_loss,0) AS avg_web_loss, (COALESCE(si.avg_store_loss,0) - COALESCE(wi.avg_web_loss,0)) AS loss_avg_diff FROM item i LEFT JOIN store_item si ON i.i_item_sk = si.sr_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_item wi ON i.i_item_sk = wi.wr_item_sk ) SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, store_qty, web_qty, avg_store_loss, avg_web_loss, loss_avg_diff, CASE WHEN loss_avg_diff > 0 THEN 'Store Higher Avg Loss' WHEN loss_avg_diff < 0 THEN 'Web Higher Avg Loss' ELSE 'Equal Avg Loss' END AS loss_category, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY loss_avg_diff DESC) AS loss_percentile FROM combined WHERE (store_qty + web_qty) > 5 ORDER BY loss_percentile DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT
  ws.ws_order_number,
  ws.ws_item_sk,
  ws.ws_quantity,
  ws.ws_net_profit,
  wr.wr_return_quantity,
  wr.wr_return_amt,
  wr.wr_return_tax,
  wr.wr_fee,
  wr.wr_return_ship_cost,
  (ws.ws_net_profit - (wr.wr_return_amt + wr.wr_return_tax + wr.wr_fee + wr.wr_return_ship_cost)) AS adjusted_profit,
  r.r_reason_desc,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (ws.ws_net_profit - (wr.wr_return_amt + wr.wr_return_tax + wr.wr_fee + wr.wr_return_ship_cost)) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_returns wr
  ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
 AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
JOIN reason r
  ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE ws.ws_net_profit > 0
ORDER BY adjusted_profit DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH cr AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_reason_sk,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_reason_sk
),
wr AS (
  SELECT
    wr.wr_reason_sk,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt
  FROM web_returns wr
  GROUP BY wr.wr_reason_sk
)
SELECT
  r.r_reason_desc,
  COALESCE(cr.total_catalog_loss, 0) AS catalog_loss,
  COALESCE(wr.total_web_loss, 0) AS web_loss,
  (COALESCE(cr.total_catalog_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.total_web_loss, 0)) AS total_loss,
  CASE
    WHEN (COALESCE(cr.total_catalog_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.total_web_loss, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'High'
    WHEN (COALESCE(cr.total_catalog_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.total_web_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS loss_category,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(cr.total_catalog_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.total_web_loss, 0)) DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM reason r
LEFT JOIN cr ON r.r_reason_sk = cr.cr_reason_sk
LEFT JOIN wr ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
ORDER BY total_loss DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH cr_daily AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_catalog_loss
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN reason r
    ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
wr_daily AS (
  SELECT
    wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_web_loss
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
combined_daily AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cr.date_sk, wr.date_sk) AS date_sk,
    COALESCE(cr.reason_desc, wr.reason_desc) AS reason_desc,
    COALESCE(cr.daily_catalog_loss, 0) AS catalog_loss,
    COALESCE(wr.daily_web_loss, 0) AS web_loss,
    (COALESCE(cr.daily_catalog_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.daily_web_loss, 0)) AS total_loss
  FROM cr_daily cr
  FULL OUTER JOIN wr_daily wr
    ON cr.date_sk = wr.date_sk
   AND cr.reason_desc = wr.reason_desc
)
SELECT
  date_sk,
  reason_desc,
  catalog_loss,
  web_loss,
  total_loss,
  SUM(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loss,
  CASE
    WHEN total_loss > 5000 THEN 'Spike'
    WHEN total_loss BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Elevated'
    ELSE 'Normal'
  END AS loss_level,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc ORDER BY total_loss DESC) AS daily_loss_rank
FROM combined_daily
ORDER BY reason_desc, date_sk

WITH catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS catalog_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns
  GROUP BY cr_item_sk
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS web_return_qty
  FROM web_returns
  GROUP BY wr_item_sk
),
sales_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_sold_qty
  FROM web_sales
  GROUP BY ws_item_sk
),
combined_returns AS (
  SELECT
    item_sk,
    SUM(COALESCE(catalog_return_qty, 0) + COALESCE(web_return_qty, 0)) AS total_return_qty
  FROM (
    SELECT item_sk, catalog_return_qty, 0 AS web_return_qty FROM catalog_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT item_sk, 0 AS catalog_return_qty, web_return_qty FROM web_agg
  ) t
  GROUP BY item_sk
),
catalog_reason AS (
  SELECT
    cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
    cr_reason_sk,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM catalog_returns
  GROUP BY cr_item_sk, cr_reason_sk
),
web_reason AS (
  SELECT
    wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
    wr_reason_sk,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM web_returns
  GROUP BY wr_item_sk, wr_reason_sk
),
combined_reason AS (
  SELECT
    item_sk,
    cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
    cnt
  FROM catalog_reason
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    item_sk,
    wr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
    cnt
  FROM web_reason
),
most_common_reason AS (
  SELECT
    item_sk,
    reason_sk,
    cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM combined_reason
)
SELECT
  cr.item_sk,
  cr.total_return_qty,
  s.total_sold_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN s.total_sold_qty = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE CAST(cr.total_return_qty AS double) / s.total_sold_qty
  END AS return_ratio,
  r.r_reason_desc AS top_reason_desc,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.total_sold_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(cr.total_return_qty AS double) / s.total_sold_qty END DESC) AS return_rank
FROM combined_returns cr
JOIN sales_agg s
  ON cr.item_sk = s.item_sk
JOIN most_common_reason mr
  ON cr.item_sk = mr.item_sk AND mr.rn = 1
JOIN reason r
  ON mr.reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
ORDER BY return_ratio DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS sales_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ss.ss_item_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS return_qty,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS return_amount
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, cr.cr_item_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS return_qty,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, wr.wr_item_sk
),
returns_combined AS (
    SELECT
        ca_state,
        item_sk,
        SUM(return_qty) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(return_amount) AS total_return_amount
    FROM returns_agg
    GROUP BY ca_state, item_sk
)
SELECT
    s.ca_state,
    s.item_sk,
    s.sold_qty,
    s.transaction_count,
    COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS return_qty,
    s.sales_amount,
    COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS return_amount,
    (COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.sold_qty) AS return_rate,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.sold_qty) > 0.25 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state ORDER BY s.sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM sales_agg s
LEFT JOIN returns_combined r ON s.ca_state = r.ca_state AND s.item_sk = r.item_sk
WHERE s.sales_amount > 1000
ORDER BY s.ca_state, sales_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH page_reason_counts AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS net_loss_per_reason, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double) / COUNT(*) AS female_ratio FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc ), ranked_page_reason AS ( SELECT cp_id, cp_department, reason_desc, reason_return_cnt, net_loss_per_reason, female_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_id ORDER BY reason_return_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM page_reason_counts ) SELECT cp_id, cp_department, reason_desc, reason_return_cnt, net_loss_per_reason, female_ratio, CASE WHEN net_loss_per_reason > 5000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN net_loss_per_reason > 2000 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_loss_per_reason DESC) AS loss_rank FROM ranked_page_reason WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 5

WITH daily_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT return_date, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, cp_department, r_reason_desc, CAST(female_cnt AS double) / total_cnt AS female_ratio, SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY return_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount, AVG(total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY return_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_average_7_days, LAG(total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY return_date) AS previous_day_amount, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_return_amount > 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS amount_category FROM daily_agg ORDER BY return_date

WITH demo_dept AS ( SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cp.cp_department, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_return_quantity, cr.cr_reason_sk FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk ), demographic_agg AS ( SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cp_department, SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM demo_dept GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cp_department ), demographic_stats AS ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 50000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN total_return_amount > 25000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS amount_category FROM demographic_agg ), top_reason_per_demo AS ( SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cp_department, cr_reason_sk, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cp_department ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM demo_dept GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cp_department, cr_reason_sk ) SELECT ds.cd_gender, ds.cd_marital_status, ds.cp_department, ds.total_return_amount, ds.avg_return_amount, ds.total_return_qty, ds.qty_rank, ds.amount_category, r.r_reason_desc AS most_common_reason, tr.reason_cnt AS reason_count FROM demographic_stats ds JOIN top_reason_per_demo tr ON ds.cd_gender = tr.cd_gender AND ds.cd_marital_status = tr.cd_marital_status AND ds.cp_department = tr.cp_department AND tr.rn = 1 JOIN reason r ON tr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk ORDER BY ds.qty_rank LIMIT 10

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender ), ranked_reason AS ( SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, avg_net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS rn_quantity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_id ORDER BY avg_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM reason_agg ) SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, avg_net_loss, loss_rank, CASE WHEN avg_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Severe Loss' WHEN avg_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'Moderate Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_severity FROM ranked_reason WHERE rn_quantity <= 3 ORDER BY cp_id, rn_quantity

WITH ship_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_day_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) DESC) AS ship_cost_rank
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, d.d_day_name
)
SELECT
    ss.d_date,
    ss.d_day_name,
    ss.total_ship_cost,
    ss.total_tax,
    ss.avg_discount,
    ss.distinct_items,
    ss.ship_cost_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.total_ship_cost > 200000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN ss.total_ship_cost > 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN ss.total_ship_cost > 50000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS ship_cost_category,
    ws.web_name,
    wp.wp_url
FROM ship_stats ss
LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_close_date_sk = ss.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = ss.d_date_sk
WHERE ss.ship_cost_rank <= 20
ORDER BY ss.ship_cost_rank

WITH month_key AS (
    SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, MIN(d_date_sk) AS month_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    GROUP BY d_year, d_month_seq
),
month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    ms.d_year,
    ms.d_month_seq,
    ms.total_profit,
    ms.total_quantity,
    ms.order_count,
    CASE
        WHEN ms.total_profit > 1000000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN ms.total_profit > 500000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS profit_level,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ms.d_year ORDER BY ms.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    ws.web_name,
    ws.web_gmt_offset,
    wp.wp_url,
    wp.wp_type
FROM month_sales ms
JOIN month_key mk ON ms.d_year = mk.d_year AND ms.d_month_seq = mk.d_month_seq
LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = mk.month_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = mk.month_date_sk
ORDER BY ms.d_year, profit_rank

WITH year_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year
),
year_site AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        MIN(ws.web_name) AS web_name
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year
),
year_page AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        MIN(wp.wp_type) AS wp_type
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year
)
SELECT
    ys.d_year,
    ys.total_net_paid,
    ys.total_profit,
    ys.sales_count,
    LAG(ys.total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY ys.d_year) AS prev_year_net_paid,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(ys.total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY ys.d_year) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE (ys.total_net_paid - LAG(ys.total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY ys.d_year)) / NULLIF(LAG(ys.total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY ys.d_year), 0) * 100
    END AS yoy_growth_percent,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ys.total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank,
    COALESCE(ysite.web_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS web_site_name,
    COALESCE(ypage.wp_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS web_page_type,
    CASE
        WHEN ys.total_net_paid > 5000000 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN ys.total_net_paid > 2000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Average'
    END AS performance_tier
FROM year_sales ys
LEFT JOIN year_site ysite ON ys.d_year = ysite.d_year
LEFT JOIN year_page ypage ON ys.d_year = ypage.d_year
ORDER BY ys.d_year

WITH ranked_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_order_number, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_net_loss, returning_ca.ca_address_sk, returning_ca.ca_city, returning_ca.ca_state, refunded_ca.ca_city AS refunded_city, refunded_ca.ca_state AS refunded_state, CASE WHEN cr.cr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'LOSS' WHEN cr.cr_net_loss < 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'BREAKEVEN' END AS net_loss_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY returning_ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_return_amount DESC) AS rn, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY returning_ca.ca_address_sk) AS total_return_amount_by_addr, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand),0) FROM inventory inv WHERE inv.inv_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk AND inv.inv_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = cr.cr_warehouse_sk) AS inventory_qty FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address returning_ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = returning_ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address refunded_ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = refunded_ca.ca_address_sk ) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, cr_order_number, cr_return_amount, cr_net_loss, net_loss_type, total_return_amount_by_addr, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount_by_addr DESC) AS address_return_amount_rank, refunded_city, refunded_state, inventory_qty FROM ranked_returns WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY ca_state, address_return_amount_rank, rn

WITH daily_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk ), inventory_with_returns AS ( SELECT inv.inv_date_sk, inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, COALESCE(dr.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty, (inv.inv_quantity_on_hand - COALESCE(dr.total_return_qty, 0)) AS net_quantity FROM inventory inv LEFT JOIN daily_returns dr ON inv.inv_date_sk = dr.date_sk AND inv.inv_item_sk = dr.item_sk AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = dr.warehouse_sk ) SELECT iwr.inv_date_sk, iwr.inv_item_sk, iwr.inv_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, iwr.inv_quantity_on_hand, iwr.total_return_qty, iwr.net_quantity, LAG(iwr.net_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY iwr.inv_item_sk, iwr.inv_warehouse_sk ORDER BY iwr.inv_date_sk) AS prev_net_quantity, (iwr.net_quantity - COALESCE(LAG(iwr.net_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY iwr.inv_item_sk, iwr.inv_warehouse_sk ORDER BY iwr.inv_date_sk), 0)) AS net_quantity_change, CASE WHEN iwr.net_quantity < 0 THEN 'UNDERSTOCK' ELSE 'OK' END AS stock_status FROM inventory_with_returns iwr JOIN warehouse w ON iwr.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE iwr.inv_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY iwr.inv_item_sk, iwr.inv_warehouse_sk, iwr.inv_date_sk

WITH warehouse_stats AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.ca_state) AS distinct_returning_states FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name ) SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_warehouse_name, total_net_loss, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, avg_inventory_qty, distinct_returning_states, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS net_loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM warehouse_stats ORDER BY net_loss_rank

WITH returns_by_state AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state AS state, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state ), inventory_by_state AS ( SELECT w.w_state AS state, AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory inv JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_state ) SELECT r.state, r.return_cnt, r.total_return_amount, r.total_net_loss, r.total_return_qty, i.avg_inventory_qty, i.total_inventory_qty, CASE WHEN r.total_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN r.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS net_loss_category, ROUND(r.total_return_amount / SUM(r.total_return_amount) OVER () * 100, 2) AS return_amount_pct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_state_rank FROM returns_by_state r LEFT JOIN inventory_by_state i ON r.state = i.state ORDER BY net_loss_state_rank

WITH cr_daily AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_catalog_loss
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
wr_daily AS (
  SELECT
    wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_web_loss
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
combined_daily AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cr.date_sk, wr.date_sk) AS date_sk,
    COALESCE(cr.reason_desc, wr.reason_desc) AS reason_desc,
    COALESCE(cr.daily_catalog_loss, 0) AS catalog_loss,
    COALESCE(wr.daily_web_loss, 0) AS web_loss,
    (COALESCE(cr.daily_catalog_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.daily_web_loss, 0)) AS total_loss
  FROM cr_daily cr
  FULL OUTER JOIN wr_daily wr ON cr.date_sk = wr.date_sk AND cr.reason_desc = wr.reason_desc
)
SELECT
  date_sk,
  reason_desc,
  catalog_loss,
  web_loss,
  total_loss,
  SUM(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc ORDER BY date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_loss,
  MIN(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc) AS min_loss,
  MAX(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc) AS max_loss,
  CASE WHEN total_loss = MAX(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc) THEN 'MaxDay' ELSE '' END AS max_day_flag,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc ORDER BY total_loss ASC) AS asc_loss_rank
FROM combined_daily
WHERE total_loss IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY reason_desc, date_sk

WITH cr_daily AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_catalog_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk >= 20200101
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
wr_daily AS (
  SELECT
    wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
    r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_web_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk >= 20200101
  GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc
),
combined_daily AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cr.date_sk, wr.date_sk) AS date_sk,
    COALESCE(cr.reason_desc, wr.reason_desc) AS reason_desc,
    COALESCE(cr.daily_catalog_loss, 0) AS catalog_loss,
    COALESCE(wr.daily_web_loss, 0) AS web_loss,
    (COALESCE(cr.daily_catalog_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wr.daily_web_loss, 0)) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(cr.catalog_return_cnt, 0) AS catalog_cnt,
    COALESCE(wr.web_return_cnt, 0) AS web_cnt
  FROM cr_daily cr
  FULL OUTER JOIN wr_daily wr ON cr.date_sk = wr.date_sk AND cr.reason_desc = wr.reason_desc
)
SELECT
  date_sk,
  reason_desc,
  catalog_loss,
  web_loss,
  total_loss,
  catalog_cnt,
  web_cnt,
  SUM(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc ORDER BY date_sk) AS cumulative_loss,
  AVG(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc) AS avg_daily_loss,
  CASE WHEN total_loss > 8000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN total_loss > 3000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_severity,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reason_desc ORDER BY total_loss DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM combined_daily
ORDER BY reason_desc, date_sk

SELECT d_sold.d_date, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax),0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity),0) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)/SUM(cs.cs_quantity) END AS avg_price_per_unit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) FILTER (WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost > 20) AS high_wholesale_units, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_dense_rank, MIN(t_sold.t_hour) AS first_sale_hour, MAX(t_sold.t_hour) AS last_sale_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk WHERE cs.cs_list_price > cs.cs_wholesale_cost GROUP BY d_sold.d_date HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 10000 ORDER BY profit_dense_rank

SELECT d_sold.d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit_per_sale, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax),0) AS total_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)/SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) END AS profit_margin, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS sales_rank, MIN(t_sold.t_hour) AS earliest_sale_hour, MAX(t_sold.t_hour) AS latest_sale_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk WHERE cs.cs_net_paid > 0 GROUP BY d_sold.d_date ORDER BY d_sold.d_date DESC

SELECT d_sold.d_date, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_units_sold, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax),0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity),0) AS total_return_qty, (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax),0)) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_net_paid),0) AS adjusted_profit_margin, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_sold.d_year ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS yearly_profit_rank, MIN(t_sold.t_hour) AS first_sale_hour, MAX(t_sold.t_hour) AS last_sale_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t_sold ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sold.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk WHERE d_sold.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 GROUP BY d_sold.d_date, d_sold.d_year ORDER BY total_sales DESC

WITH discounted_orders AS (SELECT ws.ws_order_number, wsit.web_site_id, sm.sm_type, td.t_shift, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt, ws.ws_ext_list_price, (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / nullif(ws.ws_ext_list_price,0)) AS discount_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id ORDER BY (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / nullif(ws.ws_ext_list_price,0)) DESC) AS rn FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk INNER JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk) SELECT ws_order_number, web_site_id, sm_type, t_shift, ws_ext_discount_amt, ws_ext_list_price, discount_ratio, rn FROM discounted_orders WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY web_site_id, rn

WITH cum_profit AS (SELECT wsit.web_site_id, td.t_time, td.t_hour, td.t_shift, ws.ws_net_profit, sm.sm_type, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id ORDER BY td.t_time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_profit FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk INNER JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk) SELECT web_site_id, t_time, t_hour, t_shift, ws_net_profit, cum_profit, CASE WHEN cum_profit > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN cum_profit > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_tier, sm_type FROM cum_profit ORDER BY web_site_id, t_time

WITH ship_mode_efficiency AS (SELECT wsit.web_site_id, sm.sm_type, MIN(td.t_shift) AS any_shift, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) / nullif(SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost),0) AS profit_per_ship_cost FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk INNER JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY wsit.web_site_id, sm.sm_type) SELECT web_site_id, sm_type, any_shift, total_profit, total_ship_cost, profit_per_ship_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id ORDER BY profit_per_ship_cost DESC) AS efficiency_rank, CASE WHEN profit_per_ship_cost > 2 THEN 'Efficient' WHEN profit_per_ship_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Inefficient' END AS efficiency_category FROM ship_mode_efficiency WHERE profit_per_ship_cost IS NOT NULL ORDER BY web_site_id, efficiency_rank

WITH sales_with_dates AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq, cs.cs_net_profit, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_close.d_date AS close_date FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_close ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, cc_name AS call_center_name, d_year AS year, d_month_seq AS month_seq, AVG(cs_net_profit) AS avg_monthly_profit, CASE WHEN AVG(cs_net_profit) > 40000 THEN 'High' WHEN AVG(cs_net_profit) > 15000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY AVG(cs_net_profit) DESC) AS yearly_rank, MIN(open_date) AS open_date, MAX(close_date) AS close_date FROM sales_with_dates GROUP BY cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, d_year, d_month_seq HAVING AVG(cs_net_profit) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year, month_seq, yearly_rank

SELECT w.web_site_id,
       ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
       i.i_class AS item_class,
       AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
       SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.web_site_id, ca_ship.ca_state ORDER BY AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) DESC) AS discount_class_rank,
       CASE WHEN AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 50 THEN 'Very High Discount'
            WHEN AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 20 THEN 'High Discount'
            WHEN AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 5 THEN 'Moderate Discount'
            ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY w.web_site_id, ca_ship.ca_state, i.i_class
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_quantity) > 0
ORDER BY w.web_site_id, ca_ship.ca_state, discount_class_rank

SELECT w.web_site_id,
       ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
       SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_id) AS distinct_items_sold,
       CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 1000000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 500000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_tier,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.web_site_id ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS state_rank
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY w.web_site_id, ca_bill.ca_state
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0
ORDER BY w.web_site_id, state_rank

WITH city_item_rank AS (
    SELECT ca_bill.ca_city AS city,
           w.web_site_id,
           i.i_product_name AS product_name,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
           CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profitable'
                WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) = 0 THEN 'Break-even'
                ELSE 'Loss' END AS profitability,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_bill.ca_city ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) DESC) AS rn
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_city, w.web_site_id, i.i_product_name
)
SELECT city,
       web_site_id,
       product_name,
       total_net_paid,
       total_profit,
       profitability
FROM city_item_rank
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY city, rn

WITH daily_manufacturer_sales AS (
    SELECT w.web_site_id,
           ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
           i.i_manufact AS manufacturer_id,
           ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_key,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY w.web_site_id, ca_bill.ca_state, i.i_manufact, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT web_site_id,
       bill_state,
       manufacturer_id,
       sold_date_key,
       daily_net_profit,
       daily_sales,
       CASE WHEN daily_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE daily_net_profit / daily_sales END AS profit_margin,
       AVG(CASE WHEN daily_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE daily_net_profit / daily_sales END) OVER (PARTITION BY manufacturer_id ORDER BY sold_date_key ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_margin,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sold_date_key ORDER BY daily_net_profit DESC) AS manufacturer_daily_rank
FROM daily_manufacturer_sales
WHERE daily_sales > 0
ORDER BY web_site_id, sold_date_key

WITH bill_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS bill_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk), ship_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_ship_customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS ship_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_ship_customer_sk), order_discrepancy AS (SELECT b.cs_order_number, b.cs_bill_customer_sk, s.cs_ship_customer_sk, b.bill_net_paid, s.ship_net_paid FROM bill_agg b JOIN ship_agg s ON b.cs_order_number = s.cs_order_number AND b.cs_bill_customer_sk <> s.cs_ship_customer_sk WHERE s.ship_net_paid > b.bill_net_paid), order_cc AS (SELECT cs.cs_order_number, MIN(cs.cs_call_center_sk) AS call_center_sk FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_order_number) SELECT od.cs_order_number, od.bill_net_paid, od.ship_net_paid, CONCAT(cb.c_first_name, ' ', cb.c_last_name) AS bill_customer_name, CONCAT(cs.c_first_name, ' ', cs.c_last_name) AS ship_customer_name, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, CASE WHEN od.ship_net_paid - od.bill_net_paid > 1000 THEN 'LargeDifference' ELSE 'SmallDifference' END AS diff_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (od.ship_net_paid - od.bill_net_paid) DESC) AS diff_rank FROM order_discrepancy od JOIN customer cb ON od.cs_bill_customer_sk = cb.c_customer_sk JOIN customer cs ON od.cs_ship_customer_sk = cs.c_customer_sk JOIN order_cc oc ON od.cs_order_number = oc.cs_order_number JOIN call_center cc ON oc.call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY (od.ship_net_paid - od.bill_net_paid) DESC LIMIT 20

WITH sales_detail AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, cp.cp_department, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk DESC) AS rn_latest, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk WHERE cs.cs_net_paid IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.c_customer_id, CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS customer_name, sd.call_center_name, sd.cp_department, sd.cs_order_number, sd.cs_sold_date_sk, sd.cs_net_paid, sd.cum_net_paid, sd.cs_net_profit, CASE WHEN sd.cs_net_profit / NULLIF(sd.cs_net_paid, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'HighProfitMargin' WHEN sd.cs_net_profit / NULLIF(sd.cs_net_paid, 0) BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.2 THEN 'MediumProfitMargin' ELSE 'LowProfitMargin' END AS profit_margin_category FROM sales_detail sd JOIN customer c ON sd.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE sd.rn_latest = 1 ORDER BY sd.cum_net_paid DESC LIMIT 30

WITH page_sales AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, AVG(c.c_birth_year) AS avg_customer_birth_year FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cc.cc_name) SELECT ps.cp_department, ps.cp_catalog_page_id, ps.cp_catalog_number, ps.cp_catalog_page_number, ps.call_center_name, ps.total_quantity, ps.total_net_paid, ps.avg_discount, ps.total_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department ORDER BY ps.total_quantity DESC) AS dept_page_rank, CASE WHEN DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department ORDER BY ps.total_quantity DESC) <= 3 THEN 'Top3' ELSE 'Other' END AS rank_category FROM page_sales ps WHERE ps.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ps.cp_department, dept_page_rank LIMIT 40

WITH cs_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_bill_customers FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk), dept_best AS (SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, cp.cp_department, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS dept_profit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_call_center_sk ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS dept_rn FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, cp.cp_department), top_customer AS (SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS cust_paid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_call_center_sk ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS cust_rn FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, agg.total_net_profit, agg.total_net_paid, agg.avg_discount, agg.distinct_bill_customers, CASE WHEN agg.total_net_profit > 500000 THEN 'High' WHEN agg.total_net_profit BETWEEN 200000 AND 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY agg.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, db.cp_department AS top_department, db.dept_profit AS top_department_profit, CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS top_billing_customer, tc.cust_paid AS top_customer_paid FROM cs_agg agg JOIN call_center cc ON agg.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN dept_best db ON agg.cs_call_center_sk = db.cs_call_center_sk AND db.dept_rn = 1 LEFT JOIN top_customer tc ON agg.cs_call_center_sk = tc.cs_call_center_sk AND tc.cust_rn = 1 LEFT JOIN customer c ON tc.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 100 GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender ), ranked_reason AS ( SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, avg_net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_id ORDER BY avg_net_loss DESC) AS rn_loss FROM reason_agg ) SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN rn_loss <= 2 THEN 'Top Loss' ELSE 'Other' END AS loss_category FROM ranked_reason WHERE total_quantity > 10 ORDER BY avg_net_loss DESC, cp_id

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender ), loss_stats AS ( SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, return_count, total_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amt_rank FROM reason_agg ) SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, return_count, total_amount, amt_rank FROM loss_stats WHERE amt_rank <= 5 ORDER BY cp_id, amt_rank

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(cr.cr_net_loss) AS max_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender ), top_losses AS ( SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, max_net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_id ORDER BY max_net_loss DESC) AS rn_max FROM reason_agg ) SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, max_net_loss, CASE WHEN max_net_loss > 8000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN max_net_loss > 4000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Moderate' END AS loss_level FROM top_losses WHERE rn_max <= 2 ORDER BY cp_id, max_net_loss DESC

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cp.cp_department = 'Electronics' GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender ), ranked AS ( SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, avg_return_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_id ORDER BY total_quantity ASC) AS low_qty_rank FROM reason_agg ) SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, total_quantity, avg_return_amount, low_qty_rank FROM ranked WHERE low_qty_rank <= 3 ORDER BY cp_id, low_qty_rank
