        AVG(c.c_birth_year) AS avg_birth_year
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk
),
ranked_items AS (
    SELECT
        ss_store_sk,
        ss_item_sk,
        total_qty,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        avg_birth_year,
        CASE
            WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE total_profit / total_sales
        END AS profit_margin,
        CASE
            WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN 'No Sales'
            WHEN (total_profit / total_sales) > 0.2 THEN 'High'
            WHEN (total_profit / total_sales) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS item_rank
    FROM sales_customer
)
SELECT
    ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
    ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
    total_qty,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    profit_margin,
    profit_category,
    item_rank,
    avg_birth_year
FROM ranked_items
WHERE item_rank <= 5
ORDER BY store_sk, item_rank

SELECT
    wp.wp_web_page_id,
    wp.wp_url,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk) AS distinct_return_customers,
    AVG(c.c_birth_year) AS avg_returning_customer_birth_year,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 10000 THEN 'High Return'
        WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 5000 THEN 'Medium Return'
        ELSE 'Low Return'
    END AS return_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) DESC) AS return_rank
FROM web_page wp
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c
    ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url
ORDER BY return_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
returns_agg_raw AS (
    SELECT wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return
    FROM web_returns
    WHERE wr_refunded_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY wr_refunded_customer_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return
    FROM web_returns
    WHERE wr_returning_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT customer_sk,
           SUM(total_return) AS total_return
    FROM returns_agg_raw
    GROUP BY customer_sk
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(r.total_return, 0) AS total_return,
    COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return, 0) AS net_revenue,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return, 0) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return, 0) > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS revenue_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return, 0) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN sales_agg s
    ON c.c_customer_sk = s.ss_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r
    ON c.c_customer_sk = r.customer_sk
WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
ORDER BY revenue_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH daily_brand AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date, i.i_brand AS brand, td.t_hour AS hour_of_day, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_brand_net_loss, cust.c_customer_id AS refunded_customer_id FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN customer cust ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, i.i_brand, td.t_hour, cust.c_customer_id ) SELECT returned_date, brand, hour_of_day, daily_brand_net_loss, SUM(daily_brand_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY returned_date, brand ORDER BY hour_of_day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_brand_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(daily_brand_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY returned_date, brand ORDER BY hour_of_day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) > 2000 THEN 'Alert' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_flag FROM daily_brand ORDER BY returned_date, brand, hour_of_day

SELECT t.customer_id, t.c_first_name, t.c_last_name, t.total_net_loss, t.total_return_qty, t.avg_return_amount, t.loss_category, t.loss_rank FROM ( SELECT agg.customer_id, agg.c_first_name, agg.c_last_name, agg.total_net_loss, agg.total_return_qty, agg.avg_return_amount, agg.loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY agg.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM ( SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High Loss' ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss' END AS loss_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name ) agg ) t WHERE t.loss_rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.loss_rank

WITH sales_site AS ( SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_net_profit FROM web_sales ws ), daily_profit AS ( SELECT ss.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk, ss.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date, SUM(ss.ws_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit FROM sales_site ss GROUP BY ss.ws_web_site_sk, ss.ws_sold_date_sk ), cumulative AS ( SELECT dp.site_sk, dp.sale_date, dp.daily_net_profit, SUM(dp.daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dp.site_sk ORDER BY dp.sale_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit FROM daily_profit dp ) SELECT c.site_sk, w.web_name, c.sale_date, c.daily_net_profit, c.cumulative_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sale_date ORDER BY c.daily_net_profit DESC) AS site_daily_rank, CASE WHEN c.daily_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN c.daily_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'Average' END AS performance_category FROM cumulative c JOIN web_site w ON c.site_sk = w.web_site_sk ORDER BY c.sale_date DESC, c.daily_net_profit DESC LIMIT 20

WITH bill_agg AS ( SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_bill_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ), ship_agg AS ( SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_ship_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ) SELECT b.cd_gender, b.cd_marital_status, b.avg_bill_profit, s.avg_ship_profit, (s.avg_ship_profit - b.avg_bill_profit) AS profit_diff, CASE WHEN (s.avg_ship_profit - b.avg_bill_profit) > 1000 THEN 'Significant Positive' WHEN (s.avg_ship_profit - b.avg_bill_profit) BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN 'Slight Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS profit_diff_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.avg_ship_profit - b.avg_bill_profit) DESC) AS profit_diff_rank FROM bill_agg b JOIN ship_agg s ON b.cd_gender = s.cd_gender AND b.cd_marital_status = s.cd_marital_status ORDER BY profit_diff_rank LIMIT 15

WITH combined_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, 'catalog' AS channel, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AS bill_demo_sk FROM catalog_sales cs UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_net_profit, 'web' AS channel, ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk FROM web_sales ws ), sales_with_demo AS ( SELECT cs.item_sk, cs.channel, cs.net_profit, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_education_status FROM combined_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.bill_demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ), aggregated AS ( SELECT item_sk, channel, cd_gender, cd_education_status, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(net_profit) > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM sales_with_demo GROUP BY item_sk, channel, cd_gender, cd_education_status ) SELECT item_sk, channel, cd_gender, cd_education_status, total_net_profit, profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS channel_rank FROM aggregated ORDER BY channel, channel_rank LIMIT 10

WITH combined_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, 'catalog' AS channel, CAST(NULL AS integer) AS web_site_sk FROM catalog_sales cs UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_promo_sk, ws.ws_net_profit, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, 'web' AS channel, ws.ws_web_site_sk FROM web_sales ws ), promo_agg AS ( SELECT cs.promo_sk, cs.channel, COALESCE(MAX(cs.web_site_sk), -1) AS web_site_sk, SUM(cs.net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.discount_amt) AS total_discount_amt, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.net_profit) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cs.discount_amt) / SUM(cs.net_profit) END AS discount_ratio, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(cs.net_profit) BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM combined_sales cs GROUP BY cs.promo_sk, cs.channel ) SELECT pa.promo_sk, pa.channel, pa.total_net_profit, pa.total_discount_amt, pa.discount_ratio, pa.profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.channel ORDER BY pa.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, w.web_name FROM promo_agg pa LEFT JOIN web_site w ON pa.web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk WHERE pa.total_net_profit > 0 ORDER BY pa.channel, profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH monthly_customer_returns AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk, c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, cd_ret.cd_gender AS returning_gender, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_count, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, cd_ret.cd_gender ), monthly_ranked AS ( SELECT mcr.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mcr.return_date_sk ORDER BY mcr.total_return_amt DESC) AS return_rank FROM monthly_customer_returns mcr ) SELECT mr.return_date_sk, mr.c_customer_sk, mr.c_first_name, mr.c_last_name, mr.ca_city, mr.ca_state, mr.returning_gender, mr.total_return_amt, mr.return_count, mr.avg_return_amt, mr.total_net_loss, CASE WHEN mr.avg_return_amt > 500 THEN 'Large Avg Return' ELSE 'Small Avg Return' END AS avg_return_category, mr.return_rank FROM monthly_ranked mr WHERE mr.return_rank <= 5 ORDER BY mr.return_date_sk, mr.return_rank

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country AS ca_country, cd.cd_gender AS cd_gender, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_country, cr.cd_gender, cr.total_return_amt, cr.total_return_qty, cr.total_net_loss, CASE WHEN cr.total_return_amt > 10000 THEN 'High Return' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_category, SUM(cr.total_return_amt) OVER (ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.ca_country ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC) AS country_return_rank FROM customer_returns cr ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 100

WITH demographic_zip_agg AS ( SELECT cd.cd_gender, ca.ca_zip, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS zip_total_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS zip_avg_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS zip_return_cnt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, ca.ca_zip ) SELECT dza.cd_gender, dza.ca_zip, dza.zip_total_return_amt, dza.zip_avg_return_amt, dza.zip_return_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dza.cd_gender ORDER BY dza.zip_avg_return_amt DESC) AS zip_rank_within_gender, CASE WHEN dza.zip_avg_return_amt > 1000 THEN 'High Avg Return Zip' WHEN dza.zip_avg_return_amt > 500 THEN 'Medium Avg Return Zip' ELSE 'Low Avg Return Zip' END AS zip_return_category, AVG(dza.zip_avg_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY dza.cd_gender) AS gender_avg_return_amt FROM demographic_zip_agg dza ORDER BY dza.cd_gender, zip_rank_within_gender

WITH city_daily_returns AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender, ANY_VALUE(c.c_customer_id) AS any_customer_id, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS city_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS city_return_qty, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS city_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ), date_totals AS ( SELECT return_date_sk, SUM(city_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(city_return_qty) AS total_return_qty, SUM(city_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM city_daily_returns GROUP BY return_date_sk ), city_rankings AS ( SELECT cdr.return_date_sk, cdr.ca_city, cdr.cd_gender, cdr.any_customer_id, cdr.city_return_amt, cdr.city_return_qty, cdr.city_net_loss, dt.total_return_amt, dt.total_return_qty, dt.total_net_loss, (cdr.city_return_amt / dt.total_return_amt) * 100 AS city_return_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cdr.return_date_sk ORDER BY cdr.city_return_amt DESC) AS city_return_rank, CASE WHEN cdr.city_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss City' ELSE 'Profit City' END AS city_type FROM city_daily_returns cdr JOIN date_totals dt ON cdr.return_date_sk = dt.return_date_sk ) SELECT cr.return_date_sk, cr.ca_city, cr.cd_gender, cr.any_customer_id, cr.city_return_amt, cr.city_return_qty, cr.city_net_loss, cr.total_return_amt, cr.total_return_qty, cr.total_net_loss, cr.city_return_pct, cr.city_return_rank, cr.city_type FROM city_rankings cr ORDER BY cr.return_date_sk, cr.city_return_rank

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_addr_sk AS addr_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sold_amount FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_addr_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_addr_sk AS addr_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS return_qty, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amount FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_addr_sk) SELECT ca.ca_state, COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0) AS total_sold_qty, COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) AS DOUBLE) / s.sold_qty END AS return_rate, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 'No Sales' WHEN CAST(COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) AS DOUBLE) / s.sold_qty > 0.2 THEN 'High Return Rate' ELSE 'Low Return Rate' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) AS DOUBLE) / s.sold_qty END DESC) AS return_rate_rank FROM sales_agg s FULL JOIN returns_agg r ON s.addr_sk = r.addr_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON COALESCE(s.addr_sk, r.addr_sk) = ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY return_rate_rank LIMIT 20

WITH return_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_ticket_number) SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(ra.total_return_amt, 0) AS net_profit_after_return, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(ra.total_return_amt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(ra.total_return_amt, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) < 0 THEN 'Negative Cumulative' ELSE 'Positive Cumulative' END AS profit_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk DESC) AS recent_transaction_rank FROM store_sales ss LEFT JOIN return_agg ra ON ss.ss_ticket_number = ra.sr_ticket_number JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk LIMIT 200

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_addr_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_addr_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city) SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_addr_sk, i_item_id, i_product_name, ca_state, ca_city, total_profit, total_sales, CASE WHEN total_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS profit_indicator, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg ORDER BY ss_store_sk, profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH sales_month AS (SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ca.ca_gmt_offset) AS avg_gmt_offset FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk, i.i_category), returns_month AS (SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, i.i_category), combined AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.date_sk, r.date_sk) AS date_sk, COALESCE(s.i_category, r.i_category) AS i_category, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) AS total_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS net_revenue, COALESCE(s.avg_gmt_offset, 0) AS avg_gmt_offset FROM sales_month s FULL JOIN returns_month r ON s.date_sk = r.date_sk AND s.i_category = r.i_category) SELECT date_sk, i_category, total_sales, total_profit, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, net_revenue, avg_gmt_offset, CASE WHEN net_revenue > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS revenue_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY date_sk ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS category_dense_rank_by_revenue FROM combined ORDER BY date_sk, category_dense_rank_by_revenue LIMIT 100

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS daily_quantity, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS daily_discount FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential ), store_item_total AS ( SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, SUM(daily_net_paid) AS total_net_paid_per_store_item FROM daily_sales GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk ) SELECT ds.ss_item_sk, ds.ss_store_sk, ds.ss_sold_date_sk, ds.hd_buy_potential, ds.daily_quantity, ds.daily_net_paid, ds.daily_discount, AVG(ds.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ss_item_sk ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7_day_net_paid, sit.total_net_paid_per_store_item, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ss_item_sk ORDER BY sit.total_net_paid_per_store_item DESC) AS store_rank_for_item, CASE WHEN ds.daily_discount / NULLIF(ds.daily_net_paid,0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN ds.daily_discount / NULLIF(ds.daily_net_paid,0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category FROM daily_sales ds JOIN store_item_total sit ON ds.ss_item_sk = sit.ss_item_sk AND ds.ss_store_sk = sit.ss_store_sk WHERE ds.daily_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ds.ss_item_sk, store_rank_for_item LIMIT 200

WITH customer_sales AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential ) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.ib_lower_bound, cs.ib_upper_bound, cs.hd_buy_potential, cs.total_net_paid, cs.total_net_profit, cs.avg_discount, CASE WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 15000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 8000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 3000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer_sales cs WHERE cs.total_net_paid > 0 ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 100

WITH profit_per_customer AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, c.c_birth_year FROM customer c JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential, c.c_birth_year ), ranked_customers AS ( SELECT ppc.c_customer_id, ppc.c_first_name, ppc.c_last_name, ppc.ib_lower_bound, ppc.ib_upper_bound, ppc.hd_buy_potential, ppc.total_profit, CASE WHEN (2026 - ppc.c_birth_year) >= 60 THEN 'Senior' WHEN (2026 - ppc.c_birth_year) BETWEEN 40 AND 59 THEN 'Middle Age' WHEN (2026 - ppc.c_birth_year) BETWEEN 25 AND 39 THEN 'Young Adult' ELSE 'Youth' END AS age_group, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ppc.ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY ppc.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_band, ppc.ib_income_band_sk FROM profit_per_customer ppc ) SELECT rc.c_customer_id, rc.c_first_name, rc.c_last_name, rc.ib_lower_bound, rc.ib_upper_bound, rc.hd_buy_potential, rc.total_profit, rc.age_group, rc.profit_rank_in_band FROM ranked_customers rc WHERE rc.profit_rank_in_band <= 5 ORDER BY rc.ib_lower_bound, rc.profit_rank_in_band

WITH item_sales AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax), 0) AS total_return_amt, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss FROM web_sales ws JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_brand, i_category, total_sales, total_profit - total_return_loss AS net_profit, total_return_amt, CASE WHEN (total_profit - total_return_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN (total_profit - total_return_loss) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (total_profit - total_return_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY i_brand) AS brand_rank FROM item_sales ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_returns AS ( SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sold_qty, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax), 0) AS total_return_amount FROM web_sales ws LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk ) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, w.w_warehouse_name, sr.total_sold_qty, sr.total_return_qty, CASE WHEN sr.total_sold_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(sr.total_return_qty AS DOUBLE) / sr.total_sold_qty END AS return_rate, CASE WHEN (CAST(sr.total_return_qty AS DOUBLE) / sr.total_sold_qty) > 0.2 THEN 'High Return Rate' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_flag, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.warehouse_sk ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.total_sold_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(sr.total_return_qty AS DOUBLE) / sr.total_sold_qty END DESC) AS return_rate_rank FROM sales_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN warehouse w ON sr.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE sr.total_sold_qty > 0 ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, return_rate_rank LIMIT 50

SELECT
    ca.ca_state,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
    COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS net_profit,
    CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE' ELSE 'NEGATIVE' END AS profit_flag,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
    ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    AND ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
GROUP BY ca.ca_state, p.p_promo_name
ORDER BY net_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_name,
        ca.ca_state,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_name, ca.ca_state
),
returns AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_name,
        ca.ca_state,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS return_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = p.p_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_name, ca.ca_state
)
SELECT
    s.p_promo_name,
    s.ca_state,
    s.sales_profit,
    COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS return_loss,
    s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS net_profit,
    CASE WHEN s.sales_cnt > 0 THEN s.sales_profit / s.sales_cnt END AS profit_per_sale,
    CASE WHEN r.return_cnt > 0 THEN r.return_loss / r.return_cnt END AS loss_per_return,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) AS profit_percentile,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN returns r
    ON s.p_promo_name = r.p_promo_name
    AND s.ca_state = r.ca_state
ORDER BY net_profit DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH cust_agg AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_year, CASE WHEN c.c_birth_year <= 1960 THEN 'Senior' WHEN c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1961 AND 1980 THEN 'Middle' ELSE 'Young' END AS age_segment, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_year ) SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_birth_year, age_segment, total_returns, total_return_amount, avg_return_amount, total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY age_segment ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS segment_customer_rank FROM cust_agg WHERE total_return_amount > 0 ORDER BY age_segment, segment_customer_rank

SELECT wp_web_page_id, wp_creation_date_sk, total_refunded_cash, CASE WHEN total_refunded_cash > 5000 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_segment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_creation_date_sk ORDER BY total_refunded_cash DESC) AS page_rank FROM ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_creation_date_sk, SUM(wr.wr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_creation_date_sk ) agg WHERE total_refunded_cash > 0 ORDER BY wp_creation_date_sk, page_rank

WITH hourly_stats AS ( SELECT td.t_meal_time, wp.wp_type, td.t_hour, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS hour_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS hour_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY td.t_meal_time, wp.wp_type, td.t_hour ), with_moving AS ( SELECT t_meal_time, wp_type, t_hour, hour_return_amt, hour_net_loss, LAG(hour_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY t_meal_time, wp_type ORDER BY t_hour) AS prev_hour_return_amt, AVG(hour_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY t_meal_time, wp_type ORDER BY t_hour ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_return_amt FROM hourly_stats ) SELECT t_meal_time, wp_type, t_hour, hour_return_amt, hour_net_loss, prev_hour_return_amt, moving_avg_return_amt, CASE WHEN hour_return_amt > 1.5 * moving_avg_return_amt THEN 'Spike' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_spike_flag FROM with_moving ORDER BY t_meal_time, wp_type, t_hour

SELECT t_hour, wp_type, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 2000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS hour_rank FROM ( SELECT td.t_hour AS t_hour, wp.wp_type AS wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c_ref.c_customer_sk GROUP BY td.t_hour, wp.wp_type ) t ORDER BY wp_type, hour_rank

WITH unified_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr.cr_return_quantity AS qty, cr.cr_return_amount AS amount, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk, wr.wr_return_quantity, wr.wr_return_amt, wr.wr_net_loss FROM web_returns wr ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, SUM(ur.qty) AS total_return_quantity, SUM(ur.amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(ur.net_loss) AS total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ur.net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(ur.net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS loss_category FROM unified_returns ur JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ur.cust_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ur.demo_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender ORDER BY net_loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH combined AS ( SELECT COALESCE(cr.cr_order_number, wr.wr_order_number) AS order_number, COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0) AS catalog_return_qty, COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0) AS web_return_qty, COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0) AS catalog_net_loss, COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0) AS web_net_loss, COALESCE(cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, wr.wr_returning_customer_sk) AS returning_cust_sk, COALESCE(cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk, wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk) AS returning_demo_sk FROM catalog_returns cr FULL OUTER JOIN web_returns wr ON cr.cr_order_number = wr.wr_order_number ) SELECT c.order_number, c.catalog_return_qty, c.web_return_qty, c.catalog_net_loss, c.web_net_loss, (c.catalog_net_loss - c.web_net_loss) AS net_loss_diff, ABS(c.catalog_net_loss - c.web_net_loss) AS net_loss_diff_abs, CASE WHEN ABS(c.catalog_net_loss - c.web_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Significant' ELSE 'Minor' END AS diff_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(c.catalog_net_loss - c.web_net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_diff_rank, cust.c_customer_id AS returning_customer_id, cd.cd_gender AS returning_gender FROM combined c LEFT JOIN customer cust ON cust.c_customer_sk = c.returning_cust_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.returning_demo_sk WHERE c.order_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY net_loss_diff_rank LIMIT 20

WITH combined AS ( SELECT 'Catalog' AS src, cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr UNION ALL SELECT 'Web' AS src, wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk, wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk, wr.wr_return_amt FROM web_returns wr ) SELECT src, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, COUNT(*) AS return_count, AVG(return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, CASE WHEN AVG(return_amount) < 50 THEN 'Low' WHEN AVG(return_amount) BETWEEN 50 AND 200 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS amount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY src ORDER BY AVG(return_amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM combined comb JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = comb.demo_sk JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = comb.cust_sk GROUP BY src, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ORDER BY src, amount_rank

WITH daily_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk FROM catalog_returns cr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_net_loss, wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk FROM web_returns wr ), daily_agg AS ( SELECT dr.date_sk, SUM(dr.net_loss) AS daily_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.cust_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM daily_returns dr GROUP BY dr.date_sk ), gender_counts AS ( SELECT dr.date_sk, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS gender_cnt FROM daily_returns dr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON dr.demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY dr.date_sk, cd.cd_gender ), gender_rank AS ( SELECT gc.date_sk, gc.cd_gender, gc.gender_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gc.date_sk ORDER BY gc.gender_cnt DESC) AS gender_rank FROM gender_counts gc ), preferred_flag AS ( SELECT dr.date_sk, MAX(CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_preferred_flag FROM daily_returns dr JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = dr.cust_sk GROUP BY dr.date_sk ) SELECT a.date_sk, a.daily_net_loss, a.distinct_customers, SUM(a.daily_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY a.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(a.daily_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY a.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > 5000 THEN 'ALERT' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS alert_flag, pf.has_preferred_flag, gr.cd_gender AS top_gender, gr.gender_cnt AS top_gender_count, gr.gender_rank AS top_gender_rank FROM daily_agg a LEFT JOIN gender_rank gr ON gr.date_sk = a.date_sk AND gr.gender_rank = 1 LEFT JOIN preferred_flag pf ON pf.date_sk = a.date_sk ORDER BY a.date_sk

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_id,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS daily_gross_paid,
        MAX(ws.ws_net_paid) AS max_net_paid
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    d.sale_date,
    d.web_page_id,
    d.daily_gross_paid,
    d.max_net_paid,
    LAG(d.daily_gross_paid, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.web_page_id ORDER BY d.sale_date) AS prev_day_gross,
    CASE WHEN d.daily_gross_paid > COALESCE(LAG(d.daily_gross_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY d.web_page_id ORDER BY d.sale_date), 0) THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease' END AS trend,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promo') AS promo_name,
    CASE
        WHEN d.daily_gross_paid > 12000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN d.daily_gross_paid BETWEEN 6000 AND 12000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS revenue_tier
FROM daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON d.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY d.sale_date, d.web_page_id

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_id,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_txn_count
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk >= 20230101
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    d.sale_date,
    d.web_page_id,
    d.daily_net_profit,
    d.daily_txn_count,
    SUM(d.daily_net_profit) OVER (
        PARTITION BY d.web_page_id
        ORDER BY d.sale_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_sum_14d,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.sale_date ORDER BY d.daily_txn_count DESC) AS txn_rank,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promo') AS promo_name,
    CASE
        WHEN d.daily_net_profit > 15000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN d.daily_net_profit BETWEEN 8000 AND 15000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON d.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY d.sale_date DESC, d.web_page_id

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_id,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS daily_total_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS daily_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_promo_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    d.sale_date,
    d.web_page_id,
    d.daily_total_paid,
    d.daily_orders,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.web_page_id ORDER BY d.daily_total_paid) AS pct_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.sale_date ORDER BY d.daily_orders DESC) AS order_rank,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promo') AS promo_name,
    CASE
        WHEN d.daily_total_paid > 18000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN d.daily_total_paid BETWEEN 9000 AND 18000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS performance_category
FROM daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON d.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY d.sale_date, d.web_page_id

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_id,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_ext_sales,
        AVG(ws.ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20230101 AND 20231231
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    d.sale_date,
    d.web_page_id,
    d.daily_ext_sales,
    d.avg_quantity,
    AVG(d.daily_ext_sales) OVER (
        PARTITION BY d.web_page_id
        ORDER BY d.sale_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_4d,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.sale_date ORDER BY d.avg_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank,
    COALESCE(p.p_promo_name, 'No Promo') AS promo_name,
    CASE
        WHEN d.daily_ext_sales > 20000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN d.daily_ext_sales BETWEEN 10000 AND 20000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS sales_category
FROM daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON d.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
WHERE d.daily_ext_sales IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.sale_date, d.web_page_id

WITH sales_union AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
           cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
           cs.cs_quantity AS quantity,
           cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
           'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
           ws.ws_net_profit,
           ws.ws_quantity,
           ws.ws_promo_sk,
           'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
),
sales_enriched AS (
    SELECT su.sold_date_sk,
           t.t_hour,
           su.channel,
           su.net_profit,
           su.quantity,
           p.p_promo_name,
           p.p_discount_active
    FROM sales_union su
    JOIN time_dim t ON su.sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN promotion p ON su.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT sold_date_sk,
       channel,
       SUM(net_profit) AS daily_profit,
       SUM(quantity) AS daily_quantity,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY SUM(net_profit)) AS profit_percentile,
       MAX(SUM(net_profit)) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS max_daily_profit,
       CASE WHEN SUM(net_profit) > 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS profit_indicator
FROM sales_enriched
GROUP BY sold_date_sk, channel
ORDER BY profit_percentile ASC

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk, w.web_name, sm.sm_type, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit, SUM(SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)) OVER (PARTITION BY w.web_name, sm.sm_type ORDER BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS cumulative_net_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.web_name, sm.sm_type ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_day_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_level FROM web_sales ws JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, w.web_name, sm.sm_type ) SELECT ws_sold_date_sk, web_name, sm_type, daily_net_profit, cumulative_net_profit, profit_day_rank, profit_level FROM daily_profit WHERE profit_day_rank <= 3 ORDER BY web_name, sm_type, profit_day_rank

SELECT w.web_name, hd.hd_income_band_sk, sm.sm_type, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.web_name ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_within_site, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 200000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_tier FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY w.web_name, hd.hd_income_band_sk, sm.sm_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY w.web_name, profit_rank_within_site

WITH page_sales AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, AVG(c.c_birth_year) AS avg_customer_birth_year FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_birth_year >= 1970 GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cc.cc_name) SELECT ps.cp_department, ps.cp_catalog_page_id, ps.cp_catalog_number, ps.cp_catalog_page_number, ps.call_center_name, ps.total_quantity, ps.total_net_paid, ps.avg_discount, ps.total_profit, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department ORDER BY ps.total_profit DESC) AS profit_quartile FROM page_sales ps WHERE ps.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ps.cp_department, profit_quartile LIMIT 50

WITH month_division AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cc.cc_division, cc.cc_division_name, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS division_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_count, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_pages FROM call_center cc JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cc.cc_division, cc.cc_division_name ), month_total AS ( SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, SUM(division_return_amt) AS month_total_return_amt FROM month_division GROUP BY d_year, d_month_seq ) SELECT md.d_year, md.d_month_seq, md.cc_division, md.cc_division_name, md.division_return_amt, mt.month_total_return_amt, CASE WHEN mt.month_total_return_amt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE md.division_return_amt / mt.month_total_return_amt * 100 END AS return_pct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY md.d_year, md.d_month_seq ORDER BY md.division_return_amt DESC) AS division_rank FROM month_division md JOIN month_total mt ON md.d_year = mt.d_year AND md.d_month_seq = mt.d_month_seq ORDER BY md.d_year, md.d_month_seq, division_rank

WITH profit_by_cc AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d.d_year, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d.d_year) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, d_year, total_net_profit, CASE WHEN total_net_profit < 100000 THEN 'Low' WHEN total_net_profit BETWEEN 100000 AND 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM profit_by_cc ORDER BY d_year, profit_rank

WITH daily_discount AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d.d_date, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt, AVG(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d.d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, d_date, ROUND(avg_discount_amt / NULLIF(avg_sales_price, 0), 4) AS avg_discount_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY avg_discount_amt DESC) AS discount_rank, CASE WHEN avg_discount_amt > 1000 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Standard Discount' END AS discount_category FROM daily_discount ORDER BY cc_call_center_sk, d_date

WITH combined AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit, COALESCE(SUM(cs.cs_net_profit), 0) AS catalog_net_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND cs.cs_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq) SELECT ss_store_sk, d_year, d_month_seq, store_net_profit, catalog_net_profit, CASE WHEN store_net_profit > catalog_net_profit THEN 'Store Better' ELSE 'Catalog Better' END AS performance_indicator, SUM(store_net_profit + catalog_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit FROM combined ORDER BY ss_store_sk, d_year, d_month_seq

WITH store_monthly AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq), catalog_monthly AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cc.cc_division_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cc.cc_division_name) SELECT cm.cc_division_name, cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq, cm.catalog_net_profit, sm.store_net_profit, CASE WHEN sm.store_net_profit = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cm.catalog_net_profit / sm.store_net_profit END AS catalog_to_store_profit_ratio, LAG(cm.catalog_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.cc_division_name ORDER BY cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_catalog_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(cm.catalog_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.cc_division_name ORDER BY cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (cm.catalog_net_profit - LAG(cm.catalog_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.cc_division_name ORDER BY cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq)) / LAG(cm.catalog_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.cc_division_name ORDER BY cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq) > 0.10 THEN 'Significant Increase' ELSE 'Normal' END AS profit_growth_category FROM catalog_monthly cm JOIN store_monthly sm ON cm.d_year = sm.d_year AND cm.d_month_seq = sm.d_month_seq ORDER BY cm.cc_division_name, cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq

WITH hourly_agg AS (
 SELECT d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        t.t_hour,
        sm.sm_type,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS hour_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS hour_net_profit
 FROM catalog_sales cs
 JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
 JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
 JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
 GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, t.t_hour, sm.sm_type
)
SELECT d_date,
       d_year,
       t_hour,
       sm_type,
       hour_net_paid,
       hour_net_profit,
       SUM(hour_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY d_date, t_hour ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_paid,
       LAG(hour_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY d_date, t_hour) AS prev_hour_net_paid,
       CASE WHEN hour_net_paid > COALESCE(LAG(hour_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY d_date, t_hour), 0) THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease' END AS net_paid_trend
FROM hourly_agg
WHERE d_year = 2001
ORDER BY sm_type, d_date, t_hour

WITH daily_profit AS (
 SELECT d.d_date,
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        t.t_hour,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit
 FROM catalog_sales cs
 JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
 JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
 JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
 GROUP BY d.d_date, sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, t.t_hour
)
SELECT d_date,
       sm_type,
       sm_carrier,
       t_hour,
       daily_net_profit,
       CASE WHEN t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
            WHEN t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon'
            WHEN t_hour BETWEEN 18 AND 21 THEN 'Evening'
            ELSE 'Night' END AS time_of_day,
       CASE WHEN daily_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN daily_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_date ORDER BY daily_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM daily_profit
ORDER BY d_date, profit_rank

WITH sales_delay AS (
 SELECT cs.cs_order_number,
        sd.d_date AS sold_date,
        sh.d_date AS ship_date,
        DATE_DIFF('day', sd.d_date, sh.d_date) AS ship_delay_days,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        t.t_hour
 FROM catalog_sales cs
 JOIN date_dim sd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk
 JOIN date_dim sh ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = sh.d_date_sk
 JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
 JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
)
SELECT sm_type,
       sm_carrier,
       ship_delay_days,
       cs_net_profit,
       AVG(ship_delay_days) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type) AS avg_delay,
       approx_percentile(ship_delay_days, 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type) AS median_delay,
       CASE WHEN ship_delay_days > AVG(ship_delay_days) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type) THEN 'Longer than Avg' ELSE 'Shorter or Equal to Avg' END AS delay_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_delay
WHERE ship_delay_days IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sm_type, profit_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH page_customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_creation_date_sk,
        wp.wp_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_customer_sk) AS visitors,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_store_sk) AS distinct_stores
    FROM web_page wp
    LEFT JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_creation_date_sk, wp.wp_type
),
page_rankings AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank,
        SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY wp_creation_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid,
        CASE
            WHEN visitors > 1000 THEN 'High Traffic'
            WHEN visitors BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium Traffic'
            ELSE 'Low Traffic'
        END AS traffic_category
    FROM page_customer_sales
)
SELECT
    wp_web_page_sk,
    wp_url,
    wp_type,
    visitors,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    avg_discount,
    distinct_items_sold,
    distinct_stores,
    traffic_category,
    net_paid_rank,
    cumulative_net_paid
FROM page_rankings
WHERE total_net_paid > 0
ORDER BY net_paid_rank
LIMIT 25

WITH promo_store_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_web_pages
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON c.c_customer_sk = wp.wp_customer_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name
),
promo_rankings AS (
    SELECT
        ss_promo_sk,
        s_store_sk,
        s_store_name,
        total_sales_price,
        total_profit,
        distinct_customers,
        distinct_web_pages,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_sk ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_store,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS global_profit_rank
    FROM promo_store_metrics
)
SELECT
    ss_promo_sk AS promo_id,
    s_store_name,
    total_sales_price,
    total_profit,
    distinct_customers,
    distinct_web_pages,
    profit_rank_in_store,
    global_profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN total_profit > 50000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_profit > 20000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM promo_rankings
WHERE profit_rank_in_store <= 3
ORDER BY s_store_name, profit_rank_in_store

WITH store_customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_number_employees,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        AVG(2023 - c.c_birth_year - CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_customer_age,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (2023 - c.c_birth_year) < 30 THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit_young,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (2023 - c.c_birth_year) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit_mid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (2023 - c.c_birth_year) > 50 THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit_senior,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS total_web_pages
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_sales ss ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON c.c_customer_sk = wp.wp_customer_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_number_employees
)
SELECT
    s_store_sk,
    s_store_name,
    total_net_profit,
    total_net_paid,
    distinct_customers,
    avg_customer_age,
    profit_young,
    profit_mid,
    profit_senior,
    total_web_pages,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > 200000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN total_net_profit > 50000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_tier,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_customer_age) AS age_density_rank
FROM store_customer_stats
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH customer_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, ss.ss_store_sk
),
customer_top_store AS (
    SELECT
        c_customer_sk,
        ss_store_sk,
        store_net_paid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_sk ORDER BY store_net_paid DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_store_sales
),
customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_store_sk) AS distinct_stores,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_web_pages,
        MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS first_purchase_date,
        MAX(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS last_purchase_date
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON c.c_customer_sk = wp.wp_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        ts.ss_store_sk AS top_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS top_store_name,
        cs.total_net_paid * (1 + COALESCE(cs.total_net_profit / NULLIF(cs.total_net_paid, 0), 0)) AS ltv_estimate,
        CASE
            WHEN cs.total_net_paid > 50000 THEN 'VIP'
            WHEN cs.total_net_paid > 20000 THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN cs.total_net_paid > 5000 THEN 'Regular'
            ELSE 'Occasional'
        END AS customer_segment
    FROM customer_sales cs
    LEFT JOIN customer_top_store ts ON cs.c_customer_sk = ts.c_customer_sk AND ts.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN store s ON ts.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
)
SELECT
    c_customer_sk,
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    avg_discount,
    distinct_stores,
    distinct_web_pages,
    top_store_name,
    ltv_estimate,
    customer_segment,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ltv_estimate DESC) AS ltv_rank,
    SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY first_purchase_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_paid_to_date
FROM customer_ltv
WHERE distinct_stores > 0
ORDER BY ltv_rank
LIMIT 15

WITH customer_warehouse_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_ship_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    cs.total_profit,
    cs.total_quantity,
    COALESCE(i.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS inventory_on_hand,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(i.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) < cs.total_quantity * 0.5 THEN 'Low Stock'
        ELSE 'Sufficient Stock'
    END AS stock_status,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY cs.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM customer_warehouse_sales cs
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON cs.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
) i
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk
WHERE cs.total_profit > 0
ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, profit_rank

WITH profit_by_birth AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country
),
inventory_by_birth_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        i.inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS warehouse_stock
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c
        ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN inventory i
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country, i.inv_warehouse_sk
),
top_warehouse_per_birth AS (
    SELECT
        birth_year,
        birth_country,
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        warehouse_stock,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY birth_year, birth_country ORDER BY warehouse_stock DESC) AS rn
    FROM inventory_by_birth_warehouse
)
SELECT
    pb.birth_year,
    pb.birth_country,
    pb.total_profit,
    pb.avg_discount,
    COALESCE(twb.warehouse_stock, 0) AS total_inventory,
    w.w_warehouse_name AS top_warehouse_name,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pb.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(pb.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY pb.birth_year ORDER BY pb.total_profit ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN pb.total_profit > 100000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN pb.total_profit > 50000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN pb.total_profit > 10000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_tier,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(twb.warehouse_stock, 0) < pb.total_profit / 10 THEN 'Potential Shortage'
        ELSE 'Adequate Inventory'
    END AS inventory_status
FROM profit_by_birth pb
LEFT JOIN top_warehouse_per_birth twb
    ON pb.birth_year = twb.birth_year
    AND pb.birth_country = twb.birth_country
    AND twb.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN warehouse w
    ON twb.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS daily_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
 daily_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        i.inv_warehouse_sk,
        i.inv_date_sk,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS daily_stock
    FROM inventory i
    GROUP BY i.inv_warehouse_sk, i.inv_date_sk
),
 shipping_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_customer_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS ship_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_ship_customer_sk
),
 shipping_customers AS (
    SELECT
        sc.ws_warehouse_sk,
        sc.ws_sold_date_sk,
        sc.ws_ship_customer_sk,
        sc.ship_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.ws_warehouse_sk, sc.ws_sold_date_sk ORDER BY sc.ship_cnt DESC) AS rn
    FROM shipping_counts sc
),
 top_ship_customer AS (
    SELECT
        ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws_ship_customer_sk
    FROM shipping_customers
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    ds.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
    ds.daily_net_paid,
    ds.daily_profit,
    di.daily_stock,
    LAG(di.daily_stock) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY ds.ws_sold_date_sk) AS prev_stock,
    LEAD(di.daily_stock) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY ds.ws_sold_date_sk) AS next_stock,
    c.c_first_name || ' ' || c.c_last_name AS top_ship_customer_name,
    CASE
        WHEN di.daily_stock < COALESCE(LAG(di.daily_stock) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY ds.ws_sold_date_sk), 0) THEN 'Decreasing Stock'
        WHEN di.daily_stock > COALESCE(LAG(di.daily_stock) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY ds.ws_sold_date_sk), 0) THEN 'Increasing Stock'
        ELSE 'Stable Stock'
    END AS stock_trend,
    CASE
        WHEN ds.daily_profit > 0 AND di.daily_stock > 0 THEN 'Profitable & Stocked'
        WHEN ds.daily_profit > 0 AND di.daily_stock = 0 THEN 'Profitable but Out of Stock'
        ELSE 'Loss or No Stock'
    END AS profit_stock_status
FROM daily_sales ds
JOIN daily_inventory di
    ON ds.ws_warehouse_sk = di.inv_warehouse_sk
    AND ds.ws_sold_date_sk = di.inv_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON ds.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN top_ship_customer tsc
    ON ds.ws_warehouse_sk = tsc.ws_warehouse_sk
    AND ds.ws_sold_date_sk = tsc.ws_sold_date_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c
    ON tsc.ws_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, ds.ws_sold_date_sk

WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk, ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk
),
 item_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        i.inv_item_sk,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock
    FROM inventory i
    GROUP BY i.inv_item_sk
),
 promo_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        ps.ws_promo_sk,
        ps.ws_item_sk,
        ps.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ps.total_profit,
        ps.total_quantity,
        ps.avg_discount,
        ps.distinct_customers,
        COALESCE(ii.total_stock, 0) AS total_stock,
        CASE
            WHEN ps.total_quantity > COALESCE(ii.total_stock, 0) THEN 'Shortage'
            ELSE 'Sufficient'
        END AS stock_status,
        CASE
            WHEN ps.total_quantity = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ps.total_profit / NULLIF(ps.total_quantity, 0)
        END AS profit_per_unit
    FROM promo_sales ps
    LEFT JOIN item_inventory ii
        ON ps.ws_item_sk = ii.inv_item_sk
),
 top_bill_customer_per_promo AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.ws_promo_sk ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_quantity) DESC) AS rn
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
),
 promo_with_customer AS (
    SELECT
        pa.*,
        tbc.ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM promo_analysis pa
    LEFT JOIN top_bill_customer_per_promo tbc
        ON pa.ws_promo_sk = tbc.ws_promo_sk
        AND tbc.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    pwp.ws_promo_sk,
    pwp.ws_item_sk,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    pwp.total_profit,
    pwp.total_quantity,
    pwp.avg_discount,
    pwp.total_stock,
    pwp.stock_status,
    pwp.profit_per_unit,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pwp.profit_per_unit DESC) AS profit_per_unit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN pwp.avg_discount > 0.20 THEN 'High Discount'
        WHEN pwp.avg_discount > 0.10 THEN 'Medium Discount'
        ELSE 'Low Discount'
    END AS discount_category,
    c.c_first_name || ' ' || c.c_last_name AS top_bill_customer_name,
    pwp.distinct_customers
FROM promo_with_customer pwp
LEFT JOIN warehouse w
    ON pwp.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN customer c
    ON pwp.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE pwp.total_quantity > 0
ORDER BY profit_per_unit_rank

SELECT w.web_name, hd.hd_dep_count, sm.sm_type, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid, AVG(ws.ws_ext_tax) AS avg_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.hd_dep_count ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) ASC) AS low_paid_rank FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE ws.ws_quantity > 10 GROUP BY w.web_name, hd.hd_dep_count, sm.sm_type HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 3 AND 20 ORDER BY low_paid_rank DESC, w.web_name

SELECT w.web_name, hd.hd_income_band_sk, sm.sm_type, SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0) AS discounted_orders, MIN(ws.ws_net_profit) AS min_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) > 50000 THEN 'High Shipping' ELSE 'Low Shipping' END AS shipping_category FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY w.web_name, hd.hd_income_band_sk, sm.sm_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY total_ship_cost DESC

SELECT w.web_name, hd.hd_vehicle_count, sm.sm_carrier, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, MAX(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS max_discount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.web_name ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE w.web_state = 'CA' GROUP BY w.web_name, hd.hd_vehicle_count, sm.sm_carrier HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 100000 ORDER BY sales_rank, w.web_name

WITH size_hour_stats AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_size,
        td.t_hour,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
        SUM(wp.wp_char_count) AS total_char_count
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_size, td.t_hour
)
SELECT
    i_size,
    t_hour,
    avg_return_amt,
    total_char_count,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_return_amt > 500 THEN 'LARGE_RETURN'
        WHEN avg_return_amt > 200 THEN 'MEDIUM_RETURN'
        ELSE 'SMALL_RETURN'
    END AS return_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_hour ORDER BY avg_return_amt DESC) AS size_rank_in_hour
FROM size_hour_stats
ORDER BY t_hour, size_rank_in_hour
LIMIT 20

WITH brand_shift_agg AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_brand,
        td.t_shift,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
        AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_page_char_count
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_brand, td.t_shift
)
SELECT
    i_brand,
    i_brand_id,
    t_shift,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_qty,
    avg_return_amt,
    avg_page_char_count,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS loss_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_shift ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS brand_rank_in_shift
FROM brand_shift_agg
ORDER BY t_shift, brand_rank_in_shift

WITH page_brand_shift_qty AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_type,
        i.i_brand AS brand,
        td.t_shift,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_type, i.i_brand, td.t_shift
)
SELECT
    wp_type,
    brand,
    t_shift,
    total_return_qty,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_shift ORDER BY total_return_qty) AS pct_rank_in_shift,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY t_shift ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS cum_dist_desc_in_shift,
    CASE WHEN total_return_qty > 2000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS activity_level
FROM page_brand_shift_qty
ORDER BY t_shift, total_return_qty DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT p.p_promo_id, d_start.d_date AS promo_start_date, d_end.d_date AS promo_end_date, DATE_DIFF('day', d_start.d_date, d_end.d_date) AS promo_duration_days, p.p_cost, s.s_store_id, d_closed.d_date AS store_closed_date, CASE WHEN d_closed.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date THEN 'Overlap' ELSE 'No Overlap' END AS closure_overlap, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_start.d_year ORDER BY p.p_cost DESC) AS cost_rank_in_year FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN store s ON TRUE LEFT JOIN date_dim d_closed ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closed.d_date_sk WHERE d_start.d_year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d_start.d_year, cost_rank_in_year

WITH market_daily AS ( SELECT s.s_market_id, s.s_market_desc, d.d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_sk) AS closed_stores_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost), 0) AS total_promo_cost, COALESCE(AVG(p.p_cost), 0) AS avg_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(wp.wp_char_count), 0) AS total_char_count FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY s.s_market_id, s.s_market_desc, d.d_date ) SELECT s_market_id, s_market_desc, d_date, closed_stores_cnt, total_promo_cost, avg_promo_cost, pages_created_cnt, total_char_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_market_id ORDER BY total_promo_cost DESC) AS promo_cost_rank_in_market, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_market_id ORDER BY pages_created_cnt DESC) AS pages_created_rank_in_market, CASE WHEN total_promo_cost > 10000 THEN 'High Promo Cost' WHEN total_promo_cost > 0 THEN 'Moderate Promo Cost' ELSE 'No Promo Cost' END AS promo_cost_category FROM market_daily WHERE s_market_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s_market_id, promo_cost_rank_in_market

WITH wp_data AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, wp.wp_char_count, d_creation.d_date AS creation_date, d_creation.d_date_sk AS creation_date_sk, d_access.d_date AS access_date, DATE_DIFF('day', d_creation.d_date, d_access.d_date) AS latency_days FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d_creation ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_creation.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_access.d_date_sk ) SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, wp.creation_date, wp.access_date, wp.latency_days, CASE WHEN wp.latency_days <= 1 THEN 'Immediate' WHEN wp.latency_days <= 7 THEN 'Within Week' ELSE 'Delayed' END AS latency_category, s.s_store_id, CASE WHEN s.s_store_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'StoreClosedSameDay' ELSE 'NoStoreClosure' END AS store_closure_flag, p.p_promo_id, CASE WHEN p.p_promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PromoStartedSameDay' ELSE 'NoPromoStart' END AS promo_start_flag, LAG(wp.wp_char_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_type ORDER BY wp.creation_date) AS prev_char_count, LEAD(wp.wp_char_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_type ORDER BY wp.creation_date) AS next_char_count, (wp.wp_char_count - COALESCE(LAG(wp.wp_char_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_type ORDER BY wp.creation_date), wp.wp_char_count)) AS char_count_change_from_prev, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_type ORDER BY wp.latency_days DESC) AS latency_rank FROM wp_data wp LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = wp.creation_date_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_start_date_sk = wp.creation_date_sk ORDER BY wp.wp_type, wp.latency_days DESC

WITH daily_stats AS ( SELECT d.d_date AS d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p_start.p_promo_sk) AS promos_started, COUNT(DISTINCT p_end.p_promo_sk) AS promos_ended, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_sk) AS stores_closed, COUNT(DISTINCT wp_create.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created, COUNT(DISTINCT wp_access.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_accessed, COALESCE(SUM(p_start.p_cost), 0) AS total_promo_cost_started, COALESCE(AVG(wp_create.wp_char_count), 0) AS avg_char_count_created FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN promotion p_start ON p_start.p_start_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p_end ON p_end.p_end_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp_create ON wp_create.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp_access ON wp_access.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ) SELECT d_date, promos_started, promos_ended, stores_closed, pages_created, pages_accessed, total_promo_cost_started, avg_char_count_created, (promos_started + promos_ended + stores_closed + pages_created + pages_accessed) AS total_events, SUM(total_promo_cost_started) OVER (ORDER BY d_date) AS cumulative_promo_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (promos_started + promos_ended + stores_closed + pages_created + pages_accessed) DESC) AS event_rank, CASE WHEN (promos_started + promos_ended + stores_closed + pages_created + pages_accessed) > 10 THEN 'High Activity' ELSE 'Normal Activity' END AS activity_level FROM daily_stats ORDER BY d_date

WITH order_profit AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, cs.cs_catalog_page_sk, cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0) AS net_profit_per_order, i.i_category, i.i_brand, hd.hd_income_band_sk FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_call_center_sk = cr.cr_call_center_sk AND cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk ), order_with_ma AS ( SELECT op.*, AVG(op.net_profit_per_order) OVER (PARTITION BY op.cs_call_center_sk ORDER BY op.cs_order_number ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_profit_last_3_orders FROM order_profit op ), page_agg AS ( SELECT owma.cs_call_center_sk, owma.cs_catalog_page_sk, SUM(owma.net_profit_per_order) AS total_net_profit, AVG(owma.net_profit_per_order) AS avg_net_profit, MAX(owma.moving_avg_profit_last_3_orders) AS max_moving_avg_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT owma.i_category) AS distinct_category_count, COUNT(DISTINCT owma.i_brand) AS distinct_brand_count FROM order_with_ma owma GROUP BY owma.cs_call_center_sk, owma.cs_catalog_page_sk ), ranked_pages AS ( SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.cs_call_center_sk ORDER BY p.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM page_agg p ) SELECT rp.cs_call_center_sk, rp.cs_catalog_page_sk, rp.total_net_profit, rp.avg_net_profit, rp.max_moving_avg_profit, rp.distinct_category_count, rp.distinct_brand_count, rp.profit_rank, CASE WHEN rp.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN rp.total_net_profit > 2000 THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS profit_category FROM ranked_pages rp WHERE rp.profit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rp.cs_call_center_sk, rp.profit_rank
