        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales ws
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        MAX(sold_date_sk) AS latest_sold_date
    FROM unified_sales
    GROUP BY customer_sk
),
latest_detail AS (
    SELECT
        us.customer_sk,
        us.sold_date_sk,
        us.call_center_sk,
        us.promo_sk,
        us.source,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY us.customer_sk ORDER BY us.sold_date_sk DESC) AS rn
    FROM unified_sales us
    JOIN customer_agg ca ON us.customer_sk = ca.customer_sk AND us.sold_date_sk = ca.latest_sold_date
)
SELECT
    ca.customer_sk,
    ca.total_net_profit,
    ld.sold_date_sk AS latest_purchase_date,
    ld.source AS latest_source,
    cc.cc_name AS call_center_name,
    p.p_promo_name AS promotion_name,
    CASE
        WHEN ca.total_net_profit >= 100000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN ca.total_net_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN ca.total_net_profit >= 10000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS customer_tier
FROM customer_agg ca
LEFT JOIN latest_detail ld ON ca.customer_sk = ld.customer_sk AND ld.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON ld.call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ld.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY ca.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) / SUM(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)) OVER () * 100 AS pct_of_total_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_dense_rank
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_dim d
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2022
GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH daily_loss AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_holiday,
        COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS web_net_loss,
        COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS total_net_loss
    FROM date_dim d
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_holiday
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    catalog_net_loss,
    web_net_loss,
    total_net_loss,
    CASE WHEN d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Non-Holiday' END AS holiday_flag,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_percent_rank
FROM daily_loss
WHERE total_net_loss > 0
ORDER BY loss_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH cc_dates AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_division,
        cc.cc_division_name,
        d_open.d_year AS open_year,
        d_close.d_year AS close_year,
        cc.cc_employees,
        cc.cc_sq_ft,
        cc.cc_tax_percentage,
        cc.cc_name,
        (cc.cc_employees * 1.0 / NULLIF(cc.cc_sq_ft, 0)) AS emp_per_sqft
    FROM call_center cc
    JOIN date_dim d_open
        ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_close
        ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk
    WHERE cc.cc_employees IS NOT NULL
      AND cc.cc_sq_ft IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_cc AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cc_tax_percentage DESC) AS tax_percentage_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_division ORDER BY cc_tax_percentage DESC) AS rn_div,
        AVG(emp_per_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_division) AS avg_emp_per_sqft_div
    FROM cc_dates
)
SELECT
    cc_division,
    cc_division_name,
    open_year,
    close_year,
    emp_per_sqft,
    cc_tax_percentage,
    tax_percentage_rank,
    avg_emp_per_sqft_div,
    CASE
        WHEN close_year - open_year > 5 THEN 'Long-lived'
        WHEN close_year - open_year BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Mid-lived'
        ELSE 'Short-lived'
    END AS lifespan_category
FROM ranked_cc
WHERE rn_div = 1
ORDER BY tax_percentage_rank

WITH returns_by_page_month AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_id,
        wp.wp_url,
        d_ret.d_year,
        d_ret.d_month_seq,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        MAX(cc.cc_city) AS closed_city
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        wp_web_page_id,
        wp_url,
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        total_return_amt,
        return_cnt,
        closed_city,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS month_rank,
        SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_return_amt,
        CASE
            WHEN total_return_amt > 5000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN total_return_amt BETWEEN 2000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS return_category
    FROM returns_by_page_month
) t
WHERE month_rank <= 3
ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, month_rank

WITH returns_by_cc AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_city,
        cc.cc_name,
        d_open.d_date AS open_date,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM call_center cc
    JOIN date_dim d_open
        ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_ret.d_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY cc.cc_city, cc.cc_name, d_open.d_date
)
SELECT
    cc_city,
    cc_name,
    open_date,
    total_return_amt,
    distinct_orders,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_city ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amount_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN total_return_amt > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_return_amt BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_level
FROM returns_by_cc
WHERE total_return_amt > 0
ORDER BY cc_city, return_amount_rank

WITH daily_returns AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_id,
        d_ret.d_date,
        d_ret.d_year,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amt,
        cc.cc_name,
        d_open.d_year AS cc_open_year
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp
        ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc
        ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_open
        ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_ret.d_year = 2020
    GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, d_ret.d_date, d_ret.d_year, cc.cc_name, d_open.d_year
)
SELECT
    wp_web_page_id,
    d_date,
    daily_return_amt,
    LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_id ORDER BY d_date) AS prev_day_return_amt,
    daily_return_amt - LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_id ORDER BY d_date) AS return_change,
    CASE
        WHEN daily_return_amt - LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_id ORDER BY d_date) > 1000 THEN 'Spike'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS change_flag,
    cc_name,
    cc_open_year
FROM daily_returns
ORDER BY wp_web_page_id, d_date

WITH brand_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_price, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt FROM item i INNER JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand ), brand_inventory AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand FROM item i INNER JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand ), store_brand AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, sr.sr_store_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS store_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_tax) AS store_return_tax FROM item i INNER JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, sr.sr_store_sk ) SELECT sb.i_brand, sb.sr_store_sk, sb.store_return_amt, sb.store_return_tax, ba.avg_price, CASE WHEN ba.avg_price > 100 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END AS brand_category, (sb.store_return_amt / ba.total_return_amt) * 100 AS pct_of_brand_return, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sb.i_brand ORDER BY sb.store_return_amt DESC) AS return_amount_percent_rank, bi.total_qty_on_hand FROM store_brand sb INNER JOIN brand_agg ba ON sb.i_brand = ba.i_brand INNER JOIN brand_inventory bi ON sb.i_brand = bi.i_brand ORDER BY sb.i_brand, sb.sr_store_sk

WITH returns_with_inventory AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_return_tax, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_reason_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, ca.ca_state, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand FROM store_returns sr INNER JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk ) SELECT srwi.sr_store_sk, srwi.sr_returned_date_sk, srwi.i_item_id, srwi.i_product_name, srwi.inv_quantity_on_hand, srwi.sr_return_amt, SUM(srwi.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY srwi.sr_store_sk ORDER BY srwi.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_return_amt, SUM(srwi.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY srwi.sr_store_sk ORDER BY srwi.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_net_loss, CASE WHEN srwi.sr_return_amt > 500 THEN 'High Value Return' WHEN srwi.sr_return_amt BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 'Medium Value Return' ELSE 'Low Value Return' END AS return_value_category, CASE WHEN srwi.sr_reason_sk IN (1,2,3) THEN 'Defective' WHEN srwi.sr_reason_sk IN (4,5) THEN 'Unsatisfied' ELSE 'Other' END AS return_reason_category FROM returns_with_inventory srwi ORDER BY srwi.sr_store_sk, srwi.sr_returned_date_sk

WITH inventory_latest AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_quantity_on_hand, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv_item_sk ORDER BY inv_date_sk DESC) AS rn FROM inventory ) SELECT it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, ca.ca_state, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, il.inv_quantity_on_hand, CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS net_loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) DESC) AS state_item_rank FROM inventory_latest il INNER JOIN item it ON il.inv_item_sk = it.i_item_sk INNER JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = it.i_item_sk INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE il.rn = 1 GROUP BY it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, ca.ca_state, il.inv_quantity_on_hand

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, cd.cd_gender, d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 20000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_volume_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq, cd.cd_gender ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) DESC) AS page_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, cd.cd_gender, d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq ) t WHERE t.page_rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.d_year DESC, t.d_month_seq DESC, t.cd_gender, t.page_rank

WITH daily_page_returns AS ( SELECT d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS daily_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS distinct_gender_count FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type ) SELECT d_date, wp_type, daily_return_amt, daily_return_qty, distinct_gender_count, LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date) AS prev_day_return_amt, CASE WHEN LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (daily_return_amt - LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date)) / LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date) * 100 END AS pct_change_vs_prev_day, CASE WHEN daily_return_amt > 5000 THEN 'Spike' WHEN daily_return_amt < 1000 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_level FROM daily_page_returns WHERE d_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' ORDER BY d_date DESC, wp_type LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d_ret.d_year, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_ret.d_year ORDER BY AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank, CASE WHEN AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) > 2000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_severity FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_year, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, wp.wp_type ) t WHERE t.loss_rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.d_year DESC, t.loss_rank, t.cd_gender

WITH demo_month_page AS ( SELECT d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq, cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) > 100 THEN 'High Volume' WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) > 50 THEN 'Medium Volume' ELSE 'Low Volume' END AS quantity_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq, cd.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) DESC) AS rn_page FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq, cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url ) SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, wp_web_page_sk, wp_url, total_return_qty, total_return_amt, quantity_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS demo_rank FROM demo_month_page WHERE rn_page = 1 AND total_return_qty IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d_year DESC, d_month_seq DESC, demo_rank LIMIT 5

WITH sales_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         wp.wp_url,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url
),
returns_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                  AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk
)
SELECT s.d_year,
       s.d_week_seq,
       s.wp_url,
       s.total_sales,
       COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
       s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_weekly_profit,
       CASE WHEN s.txn_count >= 100 THEN 'High Volume' ELSE 'Low Volume' END AS volume_category,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rownum,
       AVG(s.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.wp_url) AS avg_sales_per_page
FROM sales_week s
LEFT JOIN returns_week r
  ON s.d_year = r.d_year
 AND s.d_week_seq = r.d_week_seq
 AND s.ws_web_page_sk = r.ws_web_page_sk
ORDER BY s.d_year ASC, s.d_week_seq ASC, sales_rownum

WITH sales_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         wp.wp_url,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_ext_sales,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_tax) AS total_tax
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE wp.wp_type = 'Article'
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url
),
returns_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         SUM(wr.wr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                  AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk
)
SELECT s.d_year,
       s.d_week_seq,
       s.wp_url,
       s.total_ext_sales,
       s.total_tax,
       COALESCE(r.total_refunded_cash, 0) AS total_refunded_cash,
       (s.total_ext_sales - s.total_tax) - COALESCE(r.total_refunded_cash, 0) AS net_revenue,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY s.total_ext_sales DESC) AS revenue_percentile,
       FIRST_VALUE(s.wp_url) OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY s.total_ext_sales DESC) AS top_page_url
FROM sales_week s
LEFT JOIN returns_week r
  ON s.d_year = r.d_year
 AND s.d_week_seq = r.d_week_seq
 AND s.ws_web_page_sk = r.ws_web_page_sk
ORDER BY s.d_year DESC, revenue_percentile

WITH sales_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         wp.wp_url,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE wp.wp_url LIKE 'https://%news%'
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url
),
returns_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         SUM(wr.wr_account_credit) AS total_account_credit
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                  AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk
)
SELECT s.d_year,
       s.d_week_seq,
       s.wp_url,
       s.total_discount,
       s.distinct_items_sold,
       COALESCE(r.total_account_credit, 0) AS total_account_credit,
       (s.total_discount - COALESCE(r.total_account_credit, 0)) AS net_discount,
       NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY s.total_discount DESC) AS discount_quartile,
       MAX(s.distinct_items_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY s.wp_url) AS max_items_per_page
FROM sales_week s
LEFT JOIN returns_week r
  ON s.d_year = r.d_year
 AND s.d_week_seq = r.d_week_seq
 AND s.ws_web_page_sk = r.ws_web_page_sk
ORDER BY s.d_year DESC, discount_quartile, s.wp_url

WITH mismatched AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_bill_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_addr_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_bill_addr_sk <> ws.ws_ship_addr_sk
),
customer_mismatch_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca_bill.ca_city AS bill_city,
        ca_ship.ca_city AS ship_city,
        COUNT(m.ws_order_number) AS mismatched_order_cnt,
        AVG(m.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
        SUM(m.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM mismatched m
    JOIN customer c
        ON m.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill
        ON m.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship
        ON m.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_ship.ca_city
)
SELECT
    cm.c_customer_id,
    cm.bill_city,
    cm.ship_city,
    cm.mismatched_order_cnt,
    cm.avg_net_profit,
    cm.total_net_profit,
    CASE 
        WHEN cm.total_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'High Profit Mismatch'
        WHEN cm.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Medium Profit Mismatch'
        ELSE 'Low Profit Mismatch'
    END AS profit_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM customer_mismatch_agg cm
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH store_city AS (
    SELECT ca.ca_city,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_city
),
web_city AS (
    SELECT ca.ca_city,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_city
),
city_profit AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(st.ca_city, wc.ca_city) AS city,
           COALESCE(st.store_profit, 0) AS store_profit,
           COALESCE(wc.web_profit, 0) AS web_profit,
           COALESCE(st.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wc.web_profit, 0) AS total_profit
    FROM store_city st
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_city wc
        ON st.ca_city = wc.ca_city
)
SELECT
    cp.city,
    cp.store_profit,
    cp.web_profit,
    cp.total_profit,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN cp.total_profit >= 500000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN cp.total_profit >= 200000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN cp.total_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    SUM(cp.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY cp.total_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit
FROM city_profit cp
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 5

WITH store_totals AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_totals AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_paid) AS web_net_paid
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_customer_id,
           ca.ca_city,
           ca.ca_state,
           COALESCE(st.store_net_paid, 0) AS store_net_paid,
           COALESCE(wt.web_net_paid, 0) AS web_net_paid,
           COALESCE(st.store_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(wt.web_net_paid, 0) AS total_net_paid
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca
        ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_totals st
        ON st.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_totals wt
        ON wt.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.ca_city,
    c.ca_state,
    c.store_net_paid,
    c.web_net_paid,
    c.total_net_paid,
    CASE WHEN c.total_net_paid > 100000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_segment,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM customer_agg c
ORDER BY revenue_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_profit,
           SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_paid
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_profit,
           SUM(ws_net_paid) AS web_paid
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_customer_id,
           ca.ca_state,
           COALESCE(st.store_profit, 0) AS store_profit,
           COALESCE(wt.web_profit, 0) AS web_profit,
           COALESCE(st.store_paid, 0) AS store_paid,
           COALESCE(wt.web_paid, 0) AS web_paid
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca
        ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_agg st
        ON st.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_agg wt
        ON wt.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    cust.c_customer_id,
    cust.ca_state,
    cust.store_profit,
    cust.web_profit,
    cust.store_paid,
    cust.web_paid,
    (cust.store_profit + cust.web_profit) AS total_profit,
    (cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid) AS total_paid,
    CASE 
        WHEN (cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (cust.store_profit + cust.web_profit) / (cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid)
    END AS profit_margin,
    CASE 
        WHEN (cust.store_profit + cust.web_profit) / NULLIF((cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid), 0) > 0.20 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN (cust.store_profit + cust.web_profit) / NULLIF((cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid), 0) > 0.10 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN (cust.store_profit + cust.web_profit) / NULLIF((cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid), 0) > 0.05 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS margin_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN (cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (cust.store_profit + cust.web_profit) / (cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid)
        END DESC
    ) AS margin_rank,
    SUM(cust.store_profit + cust.web_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cust.ca_state) AS state_total_profit
FROM customer_agg cust
WHERE (cust.store_paid + cust.web_paid) > 0
ORDER BY margin_rank
LIMIT 15

WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS daily_quantity,
        MAX(c.c_preferred_cust_flag) AS preferred_cust_flag
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    ws.w_warehouse_name,
    ws.cs_item_sk,
    ws.cs_sold_date_sk,
    ws.daily_net_profit,
    ws.daily_quantity,
    ws.preferred_cust_flag,
    CASE
        WHEN ws.daily_quantity > 100 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME'
        WHEN ws.daily_quantity BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'MEDIUM_VOLUME'
        ELSE 'LOW_VOLUME'
    END AS volume_category,
    AVG(ws.daily_net_profit) OVER (
        PARTITION BY ws.cs_warehouse_sk, ws.cs_item_sk
        ORDER BY ws.cs_sold_date_sk
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_3_days_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.cs_warehouse_sk ORDER BY ws.daily_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_within_wh
FROM item_sales ws
ORDER BY ws.w_warehouse_name, profit_rank_within_wh
LIMIT 200

WITH cust_ship AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS web_pages_visited
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_birth_country, w.w_warehouse_name
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 1000
)
SELECT
    cs.c_customer_id,
    cs.c_birth_country,
    cs.w_warehouse_name,
    cs.total_net_paid,
    cs.total_ship_cost,
    cs.total_ship_cost / NULLIF(SUM(cs.total_ship_cost) OVER (), 0) * 100 AS ship_cost_pct_of_total,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.total_ship_cost / NULLIF(cs.total_net_paid, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'HIGH_SHIP_COST_RATIO'
        WHEN cs.total_ship_cost / NULLIF(cs.total_net_paid, 0) BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.2 THEN 'MEDIUM_SHIP_COST_RATIO'
        ELSE 'LOW_SHIP_COST_RATIO'
    END AS ship_cost_ratio_category,
    cs.web_pages_visited,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS customer_sales_rank
FROM cust_ship cs
ORDER BY customer_sales_rank
LIMIT 50

WITH customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_birth_country
),
customer_pages AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS page_visits
    FROM web_page wp
    GROUP BY wp.wp_customer_sk
),
customer_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit_by_warehouse
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, w.w_warehouse_name
),
top_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        cw.c_customer_sk,
        cw.w_warehouse_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cw.c_customer_sk ORDER BY cw.profit_by_warehouse DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_warehouse cw
)
SELECT
    cs.c_customer_id,
    cs.c_birth_country,
    cs.total_net_profit,
    cs.total_net_paid,
    cs.order_cnt,
    cp.page_visits,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.total_net_profit > 50000 THEN 'VIP'
        WHEN cs.total_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'PREMIUM'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS customer_tier,
    tw.w_warehouse_name AS top_warehouse,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.c_birth_country ORDER BY cs.total_net_profit DESC) AS country_profit_rank
FROM customer_sales cs
LEFT JOIN customer_pages cp ON cs.c_customer_sk = cp.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN top_warehouse tw ON cs.c_customer_sk = tw.c_customer_sk AND tw.rn = 1
WHERE cs.order_cnt >= 5
ORDER BY cs.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH warehouse_profit AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_id AS w_id,
        w.w_warehouse_name AS w_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) > 10
)
SELECT
    w_id,
    w_name,
    total_net_profit,
    total_sales,
    avg_discount,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN total_net_profit BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM warehouse_profit
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH mismatched AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_bill_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_bill_addr_sk <> ws.ws_ship_addr_sk
      AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2453650
),
customer_mismatch_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca_bill.ca_city AS bill_city,
        ca_ship.ca_city AS ship_city,
        COUNT(m.ws_order_number) AS mismatched_order_cnt,
        MIN(m.ws_net_profit) AS min_net_profit,
        MAX(m.ws_net_profit) AS max_net_profit,
        AVG(m.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
        SUM(m.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM mismatched m
    JOIN customer c ON m.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON m.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON m.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_ship.ca_city
)
SELECT
    cm.c_customer_id,
    cm.bill_city,
    cm.ship_city,
    cm.mismatched_order_cnt,
    cm.avg_net_profit,
    cm.total_net_profit,
    CASE 
        WHEN cm.total_net_profit > 30000 THEN 'Very High Profit Mismatch'
        WHEN cm.total_net_profit > 15000 THEN 'High Profit Mismatch'
        WHEN cm.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Medium Profit Mismatch'
        ELSE 'Low Profit Mismatch'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM customer_mismatch_agg cm
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 5

WITH mismatched AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_bill_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_bill_addr_sk <> ws.ws_ship_addr_sk
      AND ws.ws_quantity > 5
),
customer_mismatch_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        COUNT(*) AS mismatched_order_cnt,
        SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(m.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
        SUM(m.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM mismatched m
    JOIN customer c ON m.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON m.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON m.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, ca_bill.ca_state, ca_ship.ca_state
)
SELECT
    cma.c_customer_id,
    cma.bill_state,
    cma.ship_state,
    cma.mismatched_order_cnt,
    cma.total_quantity,
    cma.avg_net_profit,
    cma.total_net_profit,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cma.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_quartile
FROM customer_mismatch_agg cma
WHERE cma.total_quantity > 20
ORDER BY profit_quartile, cma.total_net_profit DESC

WITH mismatched AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_bill_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_addr_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_net_paid
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_bill_addr_sk <> ws.ws_ship_addr_sk
      AND ws.ws_net_paid BETWEEN 0 AND 5000
),
customer_mismatch_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca_bill.ca_city AS bill_city,
        ca_ship.ca_city AS ship_city,
        COUNT(*) AS mismatched_order_cnt,
        SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(m.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
        SUM(m.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        MAX(m.ws_net_profit) AS max_net_profit,
        MIN(m.ws_net_profit) AS min_net_profit,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(m.ws_net_profit)) AS profit_percentile
    FROM mismatched m
    JOIN customer c ON m.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON m.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON m.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_ship.ca_city
)
SELECT
    cm.c_customer_id,
    cm.bill_city,
    cm.ship_city,
    cm.mismatched_order_cnt,
    cm.total_net_paid,
    cm.avg_net_profit,
    cm.total_net_profit,
    cm.max_net_profit,
    cm.min_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN cm.profit_percentile > 0.9 THEN 'Top 10% Profit' ELSE 'Below Top 10%' END AS profit_tier
FROM customer_mismatch_agg cm
ORDER BY cm.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS return_events, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity >= 5 AND cd.cd_gender = 'F' GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cp_id, cp_department, r_reason_desc, cd_gender, return_events, total_return_amount, avg_return_tax, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_amount) AS quartile FROM reason_agg WHERE return_events BETWEEN 2 AND 10 ORDER BY quartile, total_return_amount DESC

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS return_events, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity >= 5 AND cp.cp_type = 'Online' GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cd.cd_gender ), agg_by_dept AS ( SELECT cp_department, SUM(return_events) AS dept_return_events, SUM(total_return_amount) AS dept_total_amount FROM reason_agg GROUP BY cp_department ) SELECT d.cp_department, d.dept_return_events, d.dept_total_amount, r.r_reason_desc, r.cd_gender, r.return_events, r.total_return_amount FROM agg_by_dept d JOIN reason_agg r ON d.cp_department = r.cp_department WHERE r.return_events > 3 ORDER BY d.dept_total_amount DESC, r.total_return_amount DESC

WITH vehicle_bucket AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN '0 Vehicles' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1-2 Vehicles' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN '3-4 Vehicles' ELSE '5+ Vehicles' END AS vehicle_bucket, ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_net_paid, ib.ib_lower_bound AS income_lower FROM store_sales ss JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk ) SELECT vb.p_promo_name, vb.vehicle_bucket, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt, SUM(vb.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(vb.ss_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, AVG(vb.income_lower) AS avg_income_lower, SUM(SUM(vb.ss_quantity)) OVER (PARTITION BY vb.p_promo_name ORDER BY vb.vehicle_bucket ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity_by_bucket FROM vehicle_bucket vb GROUP BY vb.p_promo_name, vb.vehicle_bucket ORDER BY vb.p_promo_name, vb.vehicle_bucket

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_dmail, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, AVG(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower_bound FROM store_sales ss JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_dmail ) SELECT p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y' THEN 'Direct Mail' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_channel, p.total_net_profit, p.total_sales, p.avg_discount, p.avg_income_lower_bound, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y' THEN 'Direct Mail' ELSE 'Other' END ORDER BY p.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_by_channel FROM promo_sales p ORDER BY primary_channel, profit_rank_by_channel

WITH cust_spend AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS order_cnt, cs.cs_call_center_sk FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y' WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2453650 GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cs.cs_call_center_sk ) SELECT t.cs_bill_customer_sk, t.cd_gender, t.cd_marital_status, t.cd_education_status, t.total_net_paid, t.total_net_profit, t.order_cnt, CASE WHEN t.total_net_paid > 200000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN t.total_net_paid > 100000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Silver' END AS customer_tier, t.gender_marital_rank FROM ( SELECT csbk.cs_bill_customer_sk, csbk.cd_gender, csbk.cd_marital_status, csbk.cd_education_status, csbk.total_net_paid, csbk.total_net_profit, csbk.order_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY csbk.cd_gender, csbk.cd_marital_status ORDER BY csbk.total_net_paid DESC) AS gender_marital_rank FROM cust_spend csbk ) t WHERE t.gender_marital_rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.cd_gender, t.cd_marital_status, t.gender_marital_rank

WITH call_center_perf AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS orders_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y' WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2453650 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name ) SELECT cc_perf.cc_call_center_id, cc_perf.cc_name, cc_perf.total_net_profit, cc_perf.total_sales, cc_perf.orders_cnt, CASE WHEN cc_perf.total_net_profit > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN cc_perf.total_net_profit > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cc_perf.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM call_center_perf cc_perf ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH cc_metrics AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN cs.cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS female_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'M' THEN cs.cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS male_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name ) SELECT cm.cc_call_center_id, cm.cc_name, cm.avg_net_profit, cm.avg_discount, CASE WHEN cm.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cm.female_sales / cm.total_sales END AS female_sales_ratio, (cm.avg_net_profit * 0.5) + (cm.avg_discount * -0.3) + (CASE WHEN cm.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cm.female_sales / cm.total_sales END * 0.2 * 100) AS composite_score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cm.avg_net_profit * 0.5) + (cm.avg_discount * -0.3) + (CASE WHEN cm.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cm.female_sales / cm.total_sales END * 0.2 * 100) DESC) AS score_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (cm.avg_net_profit * 0.5) + (cm.avg_discount * -0.3) + (CASE WHEN cm.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cm.female_sales / cm.total_sales END * 0.2 * 100) DESC) AS quartile FROM cc_metrics cm ORDER BY composite_score DESC

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS return_count, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 1 GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_country, cr.cd_gender, cr.return_count, cr.avg_return_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cd_gender ORDER BY cr.avg_return_amt DESC) AS gender_avg_rank FROM customer_returns cr WHERE cr.ca_country = 'United States' ORDER BY cr.return_count ASC

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.ca_city, cr.cd_gender, SUM(cr.total_return_amt) AS city_gender_return_total, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.c_customer_sk) AS unique_customers FROM customer_returns cr WHERE cr.total_return_amt BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000 GROUP BY cr.ca_city, cr.cd_gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.c_customer_sk) > 5 ORDER BY city_gender_return_total DESC

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, MAX(wr.wr_return_tax) AS max_return_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_country, cr.cd_gender, cr.total_return_amt, cr.total_return_qty, cr.max_return_tax, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.ca_country ORDER BY cr.max_return_tax DESC) AS country_tax_rank FROM customer_returns cr WHERE cr.total_return_amt > 2000 AND cr.cd_gender IN ('F', 'M') ORDER BY cr.ca_country, country_tax_rank

SELECT store_id, store_name, total_sales_paid, total_sales_profit, total_refunded_cash, total_return_loss, distinct_customer_cnt, return_loss_pct, return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, SUM(total_sales_profit) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit FROM (SELECT s.s_store_id AS store_id, s.s_store_name AS store_name, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash), 0) AS total_refunded_cash, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customer_cnt, (COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 0)) * 100 AS return_loss_pct, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_net_paid), 0)) > 5 THEN 'High Return' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_category FROM store s JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name) t ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ss.ss_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ss.ss_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name), customer_ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_store FROM customer_sales) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.s_store_id, cs.s_store_name, cs.purchase_count, cs.total_quantity, cs.total_paid, cs.total_profit, cs.avg_discount, cs.total_return_loss, CASE WHEN cs.total_profit >= 20000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cs.total_profit >= 10000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN cs.total_profit >= 5000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS loyalty_tier, cr.profit_rank_in_store FROM customer_sales cs JOIN customer_ranked cr ON cs.c_customer_sk = cr.c_customer_sk AND cs.ss_store_sk = cr.ss_store_sk WHERE cr.profit_rank_in_store <= 3 ORDER BY cs.s_store_id, cr.profit_rank_in_store

SELECT c.c_customer_id, s.s_store_id, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) > 10000 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_segment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_store FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, s.s_store_id HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) <> 0 ORDER BY s.s_store_id, net_revenue DESC

WITH item_store_sales AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, s.s_store_id AS store_id, s.s_store_name AS store_name, ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS cust_qty, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS cust_sales_amount FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_customer_sk), item_store_top_customer AS (SELECT item_sk, store_sk, store_id, store_name, customer_sk, cust_qty, cust_sales_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk, store_sk ORDER BY cust_qty DESC) AS rn FROM item_store_sales), item_store_aggregates AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, s.s_store_sk AS store_sk, s.s_store_id AS store_id, s.s_store_name AS store_name, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax), 0) AS total_return_amount FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name), ranked_items AS (SELECT a.item_sk, a.store_id, a.store_name, a.total_sales_qty, a.total_sales_amount, a.total_return_qty, a.total_return_amount, a.total_sales_qty - a.total_return_qty AS net_quantity, a.total_sales_amount - a.total_return_amount AS net_amount, CASE WHEN a.total_sales_amount - a.total_return_amount >= 50000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN a.total_sales_amount - a.total_return_amount >= 20000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Silver' END AS revenue_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_sales_amount - a.total_return_amount DESC) AS revenue_rank, tc.customer_sk, tc.cust_qty AS top_customer_quantity, tc.cust_sales_amount AS top_customer_sales FROM item_store_aggregates a JOIN item_store_top_customer tc ON a.item_sk = tc.item_sk AND a.store_sk = tc.store_sk AND tc.rn = 1 WHERE a.total_sales_amount - a.total_return_amount > 0) SELECT ri.item_sk, ri.store_id, ri.store_name, ri.total_sales_qty, ri.total_sales_amount, ri.total_return_qty, ri.total_return_amount, ri.net_quantity, ri.net_amount, ri.revenue_tier, ri.revenue_rank, c.c_customer_id AS top_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ri.top_customer_quantity, ri.top_customer_sales FROM ranked_items ri JOIN customer c ON ri.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE ri.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ri.revenue_rank

WITH item_discount AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) AS total_list_price, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) / SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) END AS discount_rate FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 0 ) SELECT cs_item_sk, total_quantity, total_discount, total_list_price, discount_rate, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY discount_rate) AS discount_percentile, CASE WHEN discount_rate > 0.30 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN discount_rate > 0.15 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category FROM item_discount ORDER BY discount_rate DESC LIMIT 100

WITH monthly_profit AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name AS w_name, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT w_name, d_year, d_month_seq, total_net_profit, CASE WHEN total_net_profit >= 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_profit >= 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS yearly_warehouse_rank, SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY w_name ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit FROM monthly_profit ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, yearly_warehouse_rank

WITH sales_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_sales_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ), returns_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT COALESCE(s.d_date, r.d_date) AS date, COALESCE(s.daily_sales_profit, 0) AS sales_net_profit, COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0) AS return_net_loss, COALESCE(s.daily_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0) AS net_balance, SUM(COALESCE(s.daily_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.d_date, r.d_date)) AS cumulative_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.daily_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_day_rank FROM sales_daily s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_daily r ON s.d_date = r.d_date ORDER BY date

WITH daily_page_returns AS ( SELECT d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS daily_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type ) SELECT d_date, wp_type, daily_return_amt, daily_return_qty, AVG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seven_day_avg, CASE WHEN daily_return_amt > AVG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS trend FROM daily_page_returns WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2023-01-31' ORDER BY d_date, wp_type

WITH daily_page_returns AS ( SELECT d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS daily_return_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type ) SELECT d_date, wp_type, daily_return_amt, daily_return_qty, LAG(daily_return_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date) AS prev_day_qty, CASE WHEN LAG(daily_return_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE daily_return_qty - LAG(daily_return_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY d_date) END AS qty_change FROM daily_page_returns WHERE d_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND daily_return_amt BETWEEN 1000 AND 8000 ORDER BY wp_type, d_date ASC

WITH daily_page_returns AS ( SELECT d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS daily_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_education_status) AS distinct_edu_count FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type ) SELECT d_date, wp_type, daily_return_amt, daily_return_qty, distinct_edu_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY daily_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank FROM daily_page_returns WHERE daily_return_qty > 0 AND d_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' ORDER BY qty_rank, d_date DESC LIMIT 75

WITH daily_page_returns AS ( SELECT d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS daily_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS distinct_gender_count FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE d_ret.d_year = 2023 GROUP BY d_ret.d_date, wp.wp_type HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 0 ) SELECT d_date, wp_type, daily_return_amt, daily_return_qty, distinct_gender_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY daily_return_amt DESC) AS rn_by_type FROM daily_page_returns WHERE distinct_gender_count >= 2 ORDER BY daily_return_amt DESC LIMIT 50

WITH ss_joined AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax, ss.ss_net_profit, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt, p.p_promo_id FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'), daily_agg AS (SELECT ss_store_sk, s_store_name, ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS daily_total_paid, AVG(ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM ss_joined GROUP BY ss_store_sk, s_store_name, ss_sold_date_sk), ranked AS (SELECT da.ss_store_sk, da.s_store_name, da.ss_sold_date_sk, da.daily_total_paid, da.avg_profit, da.txn_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY da.ss_store_sk ORDER BY da.daily_total_paid DESC) AS store_daily_rank FROM daily_agg da) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE store_daily_rank <= 2 ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk DESC, store_daily_rank

WITH ship_mode_stats AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid_sum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS rn FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk, sm.sm_ship_mode_id), top_ship_mode AS (SELECT hd_sk, sm_ship_mode_id, net_paid_sum FROM ship_mode_stats WHERE rn = 1), cat_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk, AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS avg_cat_qty FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk), store_sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk, AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_store_qty FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_hdemo_sk) SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, ts.sm_ship_mode_id AS top_ship_mode, ts.net_paid_sum AS top_mode_net_paid, COALESCE(cs.avg_cat_qty, 0) AS avg_cat_quantity, COALESCE(ss.avg_store_qty, 0) AS avg_store_quantity, (COALESCE(cs.avg_cat_qty, 0) + COALESCE(ss.avg_store_qty, 0)) / 2.0 AS avg_total_quantity, CASE WHEN ts.net_paid_sum > 50000 THEN 'HIGH_SPEND' ELSE 'LOW_SPEND' END AS spend_category FROM household_demographics hd LEFT JOIN cat_sales cs ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.hd_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales_agg ss ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.hd_sk LEFT JOIN top_ship_mode ts ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ts.hd_sk WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2 ORDER BY spend_category DESC, ts.net_paid_sum DESC LIMIT 20

WITH ship_mode_stats AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, COUNT(*) AS mode_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS rn FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk, sm.sm_ship_mode_id), least_ship_mode AS (SELECT hd_sk, sm_ship_mode_id FROM ship_mode_stats WHERE rn = 1), cat_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS cat_qty FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk), store_sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_qty FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_hdemo_sk) SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, lsm.sm_ship_mode_id AS least_used_ship_mode, COALESCE(cs.cat_qty, 0) AS cat_quantity, COALESCE(ss.store_qty, 0) AS store_quantity, (COALESCE(cs.cat_qty, 0) + COALESCE(ss.store_qty, 0)) AS total_quantity, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(cs.cat_qty, 0) + COALESCE(ss.store_qty, 0))) AS quantity_quartile FROM household_demographics hd LEFT JOIN cat_sales cs ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.hd_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales_agg ss ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.hd_sk LEFT JOIN least_ship_mode lsm ON hd.hd_demo_sk = lsm.hd_sk WHERE hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 3 AND 5 ORDER BY quantity_quartile, total_quantity DESC LIMIT 20

WITH sales_demo AS ( SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_education_status, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt, cs.cs_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT cd_gender, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS num_sales, SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt, CASE WHEN AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) > 100 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY SUM(cs_net_paid) DESC) AS gender_net_paid_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs_net_paid) DESC) AS overall_net_paid_rank FROM sales_demo GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_education_status HAVING SUM(cs_net_paid) > 0 ORDER BY overall_net_paid_rank LIMIT 10

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cd.cd_gender ), promo_rank AS ( SELECT ps.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.warehouse_sk ORDER BY ps.total_profit DESC) AS warehouse_promo_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_profit DESC) AS overall_promo_rank, CASE WHEN ps.total_profit > 100000 THEN 'High Profit' WHEN ps.total_profit BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category FROM promo_sales ps ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, pr.cs_promo_sk, pr.cd_gender, pr.total_profit, pr.avg_discount, pr.sales_count, pr.total_quantity, pr.profit_category, pr.warehouse_promo_rank, pr.overall_promo_rank FROM promo_rank pr JOIN warehouse w ON pr.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE pr.total_profit IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pr.overall_promo_rank LIMIT 25

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT cs_warehouse_sk, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty FROM catalog_sales GROUP BY cs_warehouse_sk ), inv_agg AS ( SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, COALESCE(s.total_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(s.total_sales_qty, 0) AS total_sales_qty, COALESCE(i.total_inventory_qty, 0) AS total_inventory_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_net_profit, 0) > 0 THEN 'Profit' WHEN COALESCE(s.total_net_profit, 0) < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Break-even' END AS profit_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_net_profit, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON w.w_warehouse_sk = s.cs_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN inv_agg i ON w.w_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH item_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_value FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk ), item_inventory AS ( SELECT inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory inv GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk ), item_stats AS ( SELECT s.cs_item_sk, s.cs_warehouse_sk, s.total_sales_qty, s.total_sales_value, i.total_inventory_qty, CASE WHEN i.total_inventory_qty IS NULL OR i.total_inventory_qty = 0 THEN NULL ELSE s.total_sales_qty / i.total_inventory_qty END AS turnover_ratio, CASE WHEN i.total_inventory_qty IS NOT NULL AND s.total_sales_qty > i.total_inventory_qty * 2 THEN 'Fast Moving' WHEN i.total_inventory_qty IS NOT NULL AND s.total_sales_qty < i.total_inventory_qty * 0.5 THEN 'Slow Moving' ELSE 'Normal' END AS turnover_category FROM item_sales s LEFT JOIN item_inventory i ON s.cs_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk AND s.cs_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, i.cs_item_sk, i.total_sales_qty, i.total_inventory_qty, i.turnover_ratio, i.turnover_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.cs_warehouse_sk ORDER BY i.turnover_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) AS turnover_rank FROM item_stats i JOIN warehouse w ON i.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE i.turnover_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.cs_warehouse_sk, turnover_rank LIMIT 50

WITH sr_ordered AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity, sr.sr_return_amt, cd.cd_gender AS gender, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk) AS rn, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amt FROM store_returns sr LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk) SELECT item_sk, returned_date_sk, return_quantity, return_amt, gender, cumulative_amt, CASE WHEN cumulative_amt > 10000 THEN 'BIG_SPENDER' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS spend_flag, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cumulative_amt DESC) AS cum_rank FROM (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity, sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr.gender, sr.cumulative_amt, sr.rn FROM sr_ordered sr) t WHERE rn BETWEEN 1 AND 15 ORDER BY cum_rank, returned_date_sk

WITH sr_ordered AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity, sr.sr_return_amt, cd.cd_gender AS gender, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk) AS rn, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_return_amt) AS amt_percentile FROM store_returns sr LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk) SELECT item_sk, returned_date_sk, return_quantity, return_amt, gender, amt_percentile, CASE WHEN amt_percentile > 0.9 THEN 'TOP_10_PERCENT' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS tier_flag, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_item_return_amt DESC) AS quartile FROM (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity, sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr.gender, sr.amt_percentile, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk) AS total_item_return_amt, sr.rn FROM sr_ordered sr) t WHERE rn <= 20 ORDER BY quartile, item_sk

WITH sr_ordered AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity, sr.sr_return_amt, cd.cd_gender AS gender, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk) AS rn, LAG(sr.sr_return_amt, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk) AS prev_amt FROM store_returns sr LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk) SELECT item_sk, returned_date_sk, return_quantity, return_amt, gender, prev_amt, CASE WHEN prev_amt IS NOT NULL AND return_amt > prev_amt * 1.2 THEN 'INCREASED' ELSE 'STABLE' END AS change_flag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank FROM (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity, sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr.gender, sr.prev_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk) AS total_return_qty, sr.rn FROM sr_ordered sr) t WHERE rn <= 8 ORDER BY qty_rank, returned_date_sk

WITH sales_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         wp.wp_url,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold,
         MAX(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS max_sale_price
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE wp.wp_url LIKE 'https://%news%'
    AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 250 AND 260  -- specific month range
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url
),
returns_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         SUM(wr.wr_account_credit) AS total_account_credit,
         COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_reason_sk) AS distinct_return_reasons
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                  AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk
)
SELECT s.d_year,
       s.d_week_seq,
       s.wp_url,
       s.total_discount,
       s.distinct_items_sold,
       s.max_sale_price,
       COALESCE(r.total_account_credit, 0) AS total_account_credit,
       (s.total_discount - COALESCE(r.total_account_credit, 0)) AS net_discount,
       CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY s.max_sale_price DESC) AS cum_dist_max_price,
       AVG(r.distinct_return_reasons) OVER (PARTITION BY s.wp_url) AS avg_return_reasons_per_page
FROM sales_week s
LEFT JOIN returns_week r
  ON s.d_year = r.d_year
 AND s.d_week_seq = r.d_week_seq
 AND s.ws_web_page_sk = r.ws_web_page_sk
ORDER BY s.d_year ASC, cum_dist_max_price DESC, s.wp_url

WITH sales_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         wp.wp_url,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE wp.wp_url LIKE 'https://%news%'
    AND wp.wp_type = 'article'
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url
),
returns_week AS (
  SELECT d.d_year,
         d.d_week_seq,
         ws.ws_web_page_sk,
         SUM(wr.wr_account_credit) AS total_account_credit,
         SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
                  AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, ws.ws_web_page_sk
)
SELECT s.d_year,
       s.d_week_seq,
       s.wp_url,
       s.total_discount,
       s.distinct_items_sold,
       s.total_sales_price,
       COALESCE(r.total_account_credit, 0) AS total_account_credit,
       COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
       (s.total_discount - COALESCE(r.total_account_credit, 0)) AS net_discount,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY s.total_sales_price DESC) AS sales_price_percentile,
       FIRST_VALUE(s.distinct_items_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY s.wp_url ORDER BY s.d_week_seq) AS first_week_items
FROM sales_week s
LEFT JOIN returns_week r
  ON s.d_year = r.d_year
 AND s.d_week_seq = r.d_week_seq
 AND s.ws_web_page_sk = r.ws_web_page_sk
ORDER BY s.d_year DESC, sales_price_percentile, s.wp_url

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_day_name,
        d.d_weekend,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales_amount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend
),
daily_returns AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date
),
 daily_net AS (
    SELECT
        s.d_date,
        s.d_day_name,
        s.d_weekend,
        s.daily_sales_amount,
        COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0) AS daily_return_loss,
        (s.daily_sales_amount - COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0)) AS net_revenue
    FROM daily_sales s
    LEFT JOIN daily_returns r ON s.d_date = r.d_date
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    d_day_name,
    CASE WHEN d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
    daily_sales_amount,
    daily_return_loss,
    net_revenue,
    LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY d_date) AS previous_day_revenue,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY d_date) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE (net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY d_date)) / LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY d_date)
    END AS revenue_growth_ratio
FROM daily_net
WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-01-31'
ORDER BY d_date

WITH sales_qtr AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_sales_price,
        ss.ss_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_quarter_seq = (
        SELECT d_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2022 AND d_quarter_name = 'Q2' LIMIT 1
    )
),
returns_qtr AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_refunded_cash,
        sr.sr_return_quantity
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_quarter_seq = (
        SELECT d_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2022 AND d_quarter_name = 'Q2' LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT
    cust.customer_sk,
    cust.total_sales_qty,
    cust.total_sales_amount,
    ret.total_returns_qty,
    ret.total_returns_amount,
    cust.avg_sale_price,
    ret.avg_return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN cust.avg_sale_price = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ret.avg_return_amount / cust.avg_sale_price
    END AS return_to_sale_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN ret.total_returns_qty > 20 THEN 'Heavy Returner'
        WHEN ret.total_returns_qty BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'Moderate Returner'
        ELSE 'Light Returner'
    END AS return_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ret.total_returns_qty DESC) AS return_qty_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(s.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
        SUM(s.ss_sales_price * s.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_amount,
        AVG(s.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sale_price
    FROM sales_qtr s
    GROUP BY s.ss_customer_sk
) cust
JOIN (
    SELECT
        r.sr_customer_sk,
        SUM(r.sr_return_quantity) AS total_returns_qty,
        SUM(r.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_returns_amount,
        AVG(r.sr_refunded_cash) AS avg_return_amount
    FROM returns_qtr r
    GROUP BY r.sr_customer_sk
) ret ON cust.customer_sk = ret.sr_customer_sk
WHERE ret.total_returns_qty > 0
ORDER BY return_qty_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH store_return_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_id,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS returned_qty,
        (SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_quantity), 0)) AS return_rate
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_quarter_seq = (
        SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = 2022
    )
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, i.i_category
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) > 0
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    i_category,
    sold_qty,
    returned_qty,
    return_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN return_rate > 0.2 THEN 'High Return'
        WHEN return_rate BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.2 THEN 'Medium Return'
        ELSE 'Low Return'
    END AS return_level,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_rate DESC) AS return_rate_rank,
    SUM(return_rate) OVER (ORDER BY return_rate DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_rate
FROM store_return_stats
ORDER BY return_rate_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH inv_on_open AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_site_sk,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS qty_on_open,
        SUM(i.i_current_price * inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS avg_price_on_open
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim od ON ws.web_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_sk
),
inv_on_close AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_site_sk,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS qty_on_close,
        SUM(i.i_current_price * inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand), 0) AS avg_price_on_close
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim cd ON ws.web_close_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
    JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_sk
),
site_combined AS (
    SELECT
        o.web_site_sk,
        o.qty_on_open,
        o.avg_price_on_open,
        COALESCE(c.qty_on_close, 0) AS qty_on_close,
        COALESCE(c.avg_price_on_close, 0) AS avg_price_on_close,
        CASE
            WHEN o.qty_on_open = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (c.qty_on_close - o.qty_on_open) * 100.0 / o.qty_on_open
        END AS pct_qty_change,
        CASE
            WHEN o.avg_price_on_open = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (c.avg_price_on_close - o.avg_price_on_open) * 100.0 / o.avg_price_on_open
        END AS pct_price_change
    FROM inv_on_open o
    LEFT JOIN inv_on_close c
        ON o.web_site_sk = c.web_site_sk
)
SELECT
    ws.web_site_id,
    ws.web_name,
    ws.web_market_manager,
    sc.qty_on_open,
    sc.qty_on_close,
    ROUND(sc.pct_qty_change, 2) AS pct_qty_change,
    ROUND(sc.pct_price_change, 2) AS pct_price_change,
    CASE
        WHEN sc.pct_qty_change IS NULL THEN 'No Opening Inventory'
        WHEN sc.pct_qty_change > 50 THEN 'High Quantity Growth'
        WHEN sc.pct_qty_change > 0 THEN 'Moderate Quantity Growth'
        WHEN sc.pct_qty_change = 0 THEN 'Quantity No Change'
        ELSE 'Quantity Decline'
    END AS qty_growth_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.pct_qty_change DESC NULLS LAST) AS qty_growth_rank
FROM site_combined sc
JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_site_sk = sc.web_site_sk
ORDER BY qty_growth_rank

WITH daily_qty AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        d.d_year,
        inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
