WITH cust_ship_discount AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS ship_discount_total, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS ship_sales_total, COUNT(*) AS ship_orders FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, hd.hd_buy_potential ) SELECT csd.c_customer_id, csd.sm_ship_mode_id, csd.hd_buy_potential, csd.ship_orders, csd.ship_sales_total, csd.ship_discount_total, (csd.ship_discount_total / NULLIF(csd.ship_sales_total, 0)) * 100 AS discount_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY csd.c_customer_id ORDER BY csd.ship_discount_total DESC) AS ship_mode_discount_rank, CASE WHEN (csd.ship_discount_total / NULLIF(csd.ship_sales_total, 0)) > 0.15 THEN 'HighDiscount' ELSE 'NormalDiscount' END AS discount_flag FROM cust_ship_discount csd WHERE csd.ship_orders >= 3 ORDER BY csd.c_customer_id, ship_mode_discount_rank LIMIT 30

WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_response_target,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_web_site_sk) AS site_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_discount_flag,
        AVG(cd_bill.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate,
        MIN(ws.ws_ship_date_sk) AS earliest_ship_date_sk
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target
)
SELECT
    p_promo_id,
    p_promo_name,
    total_quantity,
    total_sales,
    avg_discount_amt,
    site_count,
    earliest_ship_date_sk,
    CASE WHEN p_response_target > 0 THEN total_sales / p_response_target ELSE NULL END AS revenue_per_target,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    CASE WHEN has_discount_flag = 1 THEN 'Has Discount' ELSE 'No Discount' END AS discount_flag,
    avg_purchase_estimate
FROM promo_sales
ORDER BY sales_rank

SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       s.s_store_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold,
       SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_paid,
       COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash), 0) AS total_refunds,
       SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash), 0) AS net_cash_flow,
       CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash), 0) > 5000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS spend_category,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash), 0) DESC) AS cash_flow_rank
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                         AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
                         AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                         AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
WHERE s.s_state = 'TX' AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1990
GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, s.s_store_id
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 1000
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, net_cash_flow DESC

SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       s.s_store_id,
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS net_sales_amount,
       AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_sale,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) DESC) AS customer_rank_by_spend
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                         AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
                         AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                         AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
WHERE s.s_market_id = 7
GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, s.s_store_id
ORDER BY net_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH high_loss_per_store_brand AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, i.i_brand, SUM(CASE WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_loss_returns, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, (SUM(CASE WHEN sr.sr_net_loss > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS high_loss_pct FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, i.i_brand ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, s_state, i_brand, high_loss_returns, total_returns, high_loss_pct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_state ORDER BY high_loss_returns DESC) AS state_brand_high_loss_rank, SUM(high_loss_returns) OVER (ORDER BY s_state, i_brand) AS cumulative_high_loss_returns FROM high_loss_per_store_brand WHERE high_loss_returns > 0 ORDER BY state_brand_high_loss_rank

WITH store_item_loss AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, i_item_id, i_product_name, total_net_loss, return_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM store_item_loss ) t WHERE loss_rank <= 5 ORDER BY s_store_id, loss_rank

WITH store_item_qty AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, i_item_id, i_product_name, i_brand, i_category, total_return_qty, total_return_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS item_rank_within_store, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS global_item_qty_rank, SUM(total_return_qty) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_qty FROM store_item_qty WHERE total_return_qty > 0 ORDER BY s_store_id, item_rank_within_store LIMIT 20

WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS monthly_net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT ms.ss_store_sk, ms.d_year, ms.d_month_seq, ms.monthly_net_paid, AVG(ms.monthly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ms.ss_store_sk ORDER BY ms.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3m, CASE WHEN ms.monthly_net_paid > 1.2 * AVG(ms.monthly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ms.ss_store_sk ORDER BY ms.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) THEN 'Above Threshold' ELSE 'Normal' END AS performance_flag FROM monthly_sales ms ORDER BY ms.ss_store_sk, ms.d_month_seq

WITH sales_per_item AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, d.d_year, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_revenue FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, d.d_year ), returns_per_item AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, d.d_year, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, d.d_year ) SELECT s.i_item_sk, s.i_product_name, s.i_category, s.d_year, s.total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, CASE WHEN s.total_sales_revenue = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) / s.total_sales_revenue END AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) / s.total_sales_revenue >= 0.20 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) / s.total_sales_revenue >= 0.10 THEN 'Gold' WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) / s.total_sales_revenue >= 0.05 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profitability_tier, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_per_item s LEFT JOIN returns_per_item r ON s.i_item_sk = r.i_item_sk AND s.d_year = r.d_year ORDER BY s.d_year, profit_rank LIMIT 100

WITH sales_by_store_year AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ss.ss_store_sk) = 1 THEN -1 ELSE ss.ss_store_sk END AS store_sk, d.d_year, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS yearly_net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_category = 'Furniture' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year), (d.d_year)) ), returns_by_year AS ( SELECT d.d_year, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS yearly_return_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year ) SELECT s.store_sk, s.d_year, s.yearly_net_paid, r.yearly_return_loss, LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) AS prev_year_net_paid, CASE WHEN LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE s.yearly_net_paid - LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) END AS net_paid_change, CASE WHEN LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) IS NULL OR LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (s.yearly_net_paid - LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year)) / LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) * 100 END AS pct_change, CASE WHEN LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN s.yearly_net_paid > 1.5 * LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) THEN 'Strong Growth' WHEN s.yearly_net_paid < 0.75 * LAG(s.yearly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_sk ORDER BY s.d_year) THEN 'Decline' ELSE 'Stable' END AS growth_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY s.yearly_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_by_store_year s LEFT JOIN returns_by_year r ON s.d_year = r.d_year ORDER BY s.store_sk, s.d_year

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id ) SELECT s.d_year, s.i_brand, (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 500000 AND 1000000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_year ORDER BY (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_dense_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.d_year = r.d_year AND s.i_brand_id = r.i_brand_id ORDER BY s.d_year, profit_rank

SELECT
  i.i_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS catalog_return_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS store_return_tickets,
  SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_web_sales,
  SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk),0) AS avg_sales_per_item,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM item i
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_category IN ('Electronics','Books','Clothing')
GROUP BY i.i_category
ORDER BY sales_rank
OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY

WITH return_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 2000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS net_loss_category FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk ) SELECT r.total_return_amount, r.total_net_loss, r.return_cnt, r.avg_return_amount, r.net_loss_category, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank FROM return_summary r JOIN customer c ON r.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON r.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY return_amount_rank LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_refunds, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_refund_loss, COUNT(*) AS returns_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, sa.total_sales, ra.total_refunds, (sa.total_sales - COALESCE(ra.total_refunds,0)) AS net_sales_after_refunds, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ra.total_refunds,0) > sa.total_sales * 0.5 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN COALESCE(ra.total_refunds,0) > sa.total_sales * 0.2 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS risk_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ra.total_refunds,0) DESC) AS refund_amount_rank, SUM(sa.total_sales - COALESCE(ra.total_refunds,0)) OVER (ORDER BY (sa.total_sales - COALESCE(ra.total_refunds,0)) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_sales FROM sales_agg sa LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra ON sa.customer_sk = ra.customer_sk JOIN customer c ON sa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY refund_amount_rank LIMIT 100

WITH returns_by_date_city AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, ca.ca_city, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, ca.ca_city ), ranked_cities AS ( SELECT date_sk, ca_city, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, return_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date_sk ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS city_rank FROM returns_by_date_city ) SELECT r.date_sk, r.ca_city, r.total_return_amount, r.total_net_loss, r.return_cnt, r.city_rank, s.total_sales_amount, CASE WHEN s.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE r.total_return_amount / s.total_sales_amount END AS return_to_sales_ratio FROM ranked_cities r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk ) s ON r.date_sk = s.date_sk WHERE r.city_rank = 1 ORDER BY r.date_sk DESC LIMIT 20

WITH order_combined AS ( SELECT ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_bill_addr_sk, ws.ws_quantity, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, ws.ws_net_profit, cr.cr_return_quantity, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_return_amount, CASE WHEN ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss,0) > 1000 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss,0) > 0 THEN 'Good' WHEN ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss,0) = 0 THEN 'Break-even' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_margin_category FROM web_sales ws LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON ws.ws_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk ) SELECT oc.ws_order_number, oc.ws_item_sk, oc.ws_quantity, oc.ws_ext_sales_price, oc.ws_net_profit, COALESCE(oc.cr_net_loss,0) AS return_net_loss, oc.profit_margin_category, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (oc.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(oc.cr_net_loss,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, SUM(oc.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(oc.cr_net_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY oc.ws_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY oc.ws_order_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit_per_customer FROM order_combined oc JOIN customer c ON oc.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON oc.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH customer_sales AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_coupon_amt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_used_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential ) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.ib_lower_bound, cs.ib_upper_bound, cs.hd_buy_potential, cs.total_net_paid, cs.total_net_profit, cs.avg_discount, cs.coupon_used_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.coupon_used_count DESC, cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS coupon_rank FROM customer_sales cs WHERE cs.coupon_used_count > 0 ORDER BY cs.coupon_used_count DESC, cs.total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 100

WITH customer_sales AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 10000 ) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.ib_lower_bound, cs.ib_upper_bound, cs.hd_buy_potential, cs.purchase_count, cs.total_net_paid, cs.total_net_profit, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS quartile FROM customer_sales cs ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, i.i_current_price, (inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) AS inventory_value, CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < 100 THEN 'Low' WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS inventory_category, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, COALESCE((i.i_current_price - p.p_cost) * inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, 0) AS promo_margin, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_id ORDER BY (inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) DESC) AS item_rank_in_warehouse, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_id ORDER BY (inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_inventory_value FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y' OR p.p_discount_active IS NULL

WITH warehouse_perf AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) AS total_value, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost, 0) * inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_promo_cost FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state ) SELECT w_warehouse_id, w_warehouse_name, w_city, w_state, total_qty, total_value, total_promo_cost, (total_value - total_promo_cost) AS net_margin, CASE WHEN (total_value - total_promo_cost) < 0 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Positive' END AS margin_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (total_value - total_promo_cost) DESC) AS net_margin_rank, SUM(total_value - total_promo_cost) OVER (ORDER BY (total_value - total_promo_cost) DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_net_margin, total_promo_cost / NULLIF(total_value, 0) AS promo_cost_ratio FROM warehouse_perf

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost), 0) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.inv_warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_count, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT w.w_state) AS states_present FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_brand, i_category, total_quantity, i_current_price, (total_quantity * i_current_price) AS total_inventory_value, total_promo_cost, (total_quantity * i_current_price) - total_promo_cost AS net_value, warehouse_count, states_present, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank, CASE WHEN (total_quantity * i_current_price) - total_promo_cost > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status FROM item_agg

WITH promo_qty AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, p.p_start_date_sk, p.p_end_date_sk, p.p_cost, i.i_current_price, p.p_response_target, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT w.w_state) AS promo_states, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS promo_quantity FROM promotion p JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, p.p_start_date_sk, p.p_end_date_sk, p.p_cost, i.i_current_price, p.p_response_target ) SELECT p_promo_id, p_promo_name, i_item_id, i_product_name, p_start_date_sk, p_end_date_sk, p_cost, i_current_price, (i_current_price - p_cost) AS unit_margin, promo_quantity, promo_states, CASE WHEN p_response_target > 1000 THEN 'High Target' ELSE 'Normal Target' END AS target_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY promo_quantity DESC) AS promo_quantity_rank, SUM(promo_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY promo_quantity DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_promo_quantity FROM promo_qty

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 0 GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_state, cr.cd_gender, cr.return_count, cr.total_return_amt, CASE WHEN cr.return_count >= 5 THEN 'Frequent Returner' ELSE 'Infrequent Returner' END AS return_frequency, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.ca_state ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC) AS state_return_rank FROM customer_returns cr ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 100

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_tax > 0 GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_city, cr.cd_gender, cr.total_return_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.ca_city ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC) AS city_rank FROM customer_returns cr WHERE cr.total_return_amt > 500 ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 75

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, MIN(wr.wr_return_amt) AS min_return_amt, MAX(wr.wr_return_amt) AS max_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_country, cr.cd_gender, cr.total_return_amt, cr.avg_return_amt, cr.min_return_amt, cr.max_return_amt, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY cr.ca_country ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC) AS quartile FROM customer_returns cr ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT
    i.i_item_sk,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_size,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_revenue,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS discount_total,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS txn_count,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN p.p_promo_name END) AS latest_active_promo,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_quartile
FROM item i
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_brand IN ('BrandA', 'BrandB', 'BrandC')
GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_size
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 5000
ORDER BY profit_quartile, sales_revenue DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
    i.i_item_sk,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_brand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS sales_txn_cnt,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS net_sales_amount,
    AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit_per_sale,
    MAX(p.p_promo_name) FILTER (WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y') AS active_promo_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM item i
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_rec_end_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' YEAR
GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_category, i.i_brand
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 1000
ORDER BY net_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    i.i_item_sk,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid_inc_tax,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_ext_sales_price * 0.1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_discount_estimate,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_percentile
FROM item i
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 10 AND 50
GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_brand, i.i_category
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0
ORDER BY profit_percentile ASC
LIMIT 12

SELECT ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_item_sk, hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk AS bill_income_band, hd_ship.hd_income_band_sk AS ship_income_band, ws.ws_quantity, ws.ws_sales_price, ws.ws_net_paid, ws.ws_net_profit, CASE WHEN ws.ws_net_profit < 0 THEN 'LOSS' ELSE 'PROFIT' END AS profit_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.ws_item_sk ORDER BY ws.ws_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_item, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hd_bill.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_profit_by_income FROM web_sales ws JOIN household_demographics hd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd_ship ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2453650 ORDER BY ws.ws_order_number, profit_rank_item

WITH combined AS ( SELECT 'REFUNDED' AS role, cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, cr.cr_return_quantity, cr.cr_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr UNION ALL SELECT 'RETURNING' AS role, cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk, cr.cr_return_quantity, cr.cr_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr ) SELECT role, hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(combined.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(combined.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_records, CASE WHEN SUM(combined.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(combined.cr_net_loss) > 2000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY role ORDER BY SUM(combined.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank FROM combined JOIN household_demographics hd ON combined.hd_demo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY role, hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential ORDER BY role, loss_rank

WITH catalog_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_loss, COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk ), web_return_agg AS ( SELECT wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_web_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk ), web_sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk ) SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_loss, 0) AS catalog_loss, COALESCE(wra.total_web_return_loss, 0) AS web_return_loss, COALESCE(ws_agg.total_sales_profit, 0) AS sales_profit, COALESCE(ws_agg.total_sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount, (COALESCE(ws_agg.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_loss,0) - COALESCE(wra.total_web_return_loss,0)) AS net_effect, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(ws_agg.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_loss,0) - COALESCE(wra.total_web_return_loss,0)) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH_NET' WHEN (COALESCE(ws_agg.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_loss,0) - COALESCE(wra.total_web_return_loss,0)) BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM_NET' ELSE 'LOW_NET' END AS net_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY (COALESCE(ws_agg.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_loss,0) - COALESCE(wra.total_web_return_loss,0)) DESC) AS net_rank_income, SUM(COALESCE(ws_agg.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_loss,0) - COALESCE(wra.total_web_return_loss,0)) OVER () AS total_net_effect_all_demo FROM household_demographics hd LEFT JOIN catalog_agg ca ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ca.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN web_return_agg wra ON hd.hd_demo_sk = wra.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN web_sales_agg ws_agg ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ws_agg.hd_demo_sk ORDER BY net_rank_income, hd.hd_demo_sk LIMIT 50

WITH returns_by_cc AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, d.d_date, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, d.d_date ) SELECT cr_call_center_sk, cr_ship_mode_sk, d_date, daily_net_loss, SUM(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cr_call_center_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, CASE WHEN daily_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss' WHEN daily_net_loss < 0 THEN 'Gain' ELSE 'Break-even' END AS daily_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr_ship_mode_sk ORDER BY daily_net_loss DESC) AS ship_mode_rank FROM returns_by_cc ORDER BY cr_call_center_sk, d_date

WITH daily_dept AS ( SELECT d.d_date, cp.cp_department, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, cp.cp_department ) SELECT d_date, cp_department, total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS dept_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_dense_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category FROM daily_dept ORDER BY d_date, cp_department

WITH page_dates AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, start_d.d_date AS start_date, end_d.d_date AS end_date, cp.cp_description FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim start_d ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = start_d.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim end_d ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = end_d.d_date_sk ), page_returns AS ( SELECT pd.cp_catalog_page_sk, pd.cp_catalog_page_id, pd.cp_department, pd.start_date, pd.end_date, COUNT(cr.cr_order_number) AS total_returns, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_date > pd.end_date THEN cr.cr_return_amount ELSE 0 END) AS late_return_amount FROM page_dates pd JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = pd.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY pd.cp_catalog_page_sk, pd.cp_catalog_page_id, pd.cp_department, pd.start_date, pd.end_date ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, start_date, end_date, total_returns, total_return_amount, late_return_amount, CASE WHEN late_return_amount > 0 THEN 'Late Returns' ELSE 'On-time Returns' END AS return_timing, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS dept_rank, LAG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS previous_return_amount, COALESCE(total_return_amount - LAG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC), 0) AS return_amount_diff FROM page_returns ORDER BY cp_department, dept_rank

WITH monthly_item_returns AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name ), ranked_items AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS rn FROM monthly_item_returns ) SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, i_item_sk, i_product_name, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, rn, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 5000 THEN 'Very High Returns' WHEN total_return_amount > 2000 THEN 'High Returns' ELSE 'Moderate Returns' END AS return_category FROM ranked_items WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, rn

WITH order_profit AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs.cs_sales_price * cs.cs_quantity AS gross_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_ship_mode_sk IN (1, 2, 3)
)
SELECT
    ship_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS total_orders,
    SUM(gross_sales) AS total_gross_sales,
    SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bill_state <> ship_state THEN net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS cross_state_profit,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN bill_state <> ship_state THEN net_profit ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(net_profit), 0)) AS cross_state_ratio,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(gross_sales) DESC) AS sales_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(gross_sales) > 1000000 THEN 'Top Tier'
        WHEN SUM(gross_sales) BETWEEN 500000 AND 1000000 THEN 'High Tier'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS sales_category
FROM order_profit
GROUP BY ship_state
ORDER BY sales_rank
LIMIT 8

WITH order_profit AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_tax AS tax_amount,
        cs.cs_ext_ship_cost AS ship_cost
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_ext_tax > 0
)
SELECT
    ship_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS total_orders,
    SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    AVG(tax_amount) AS avg_tax,
    AVG(ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bill_state <> ship_state THEN net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS cross_state_profit,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN bill_state <> ship_state THEN net_profit ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(net_profit), 0)) AS cross_state_ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ship_state ORDER BY SUM(net_profit) DESC) AS state_order_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(net_profit) > 150000 THEN 'Elite'
        WHEN SUM(net_profit) BETWEEN 75000 AND 150000 THEN 'Strong'
        ELSE 'Weak'
    END AS profit_tier
FROM order_profit
GROUP BY ship_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY state_order_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH order_profit AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs.cs_quantity AS quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 5
)
SELECT
    bill_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_number) AS total_orders,
    AVG(net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bill_state = ship_state THEN net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS intra_state_profit,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN bill_state = ship_state THEN net_profit ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(net_profit), 0)) AS intra_state_ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(net_profit) DESC) AS profit_state_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN AVG(net_profit) BETWEEN 25000 AND 50000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN AVG(net_profit) BETWEEN 10000 AND 25000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM order_profit
GROUP BY bill_state
ORDER BY profit_state_rank
LIMIT 5

WITH address_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_location_type, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_return_quantity, hd.hd_vehicle_count, i.i_brand FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk ), city_agg AS ( SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, AVG(hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i_brand) AS distinct_brands FROM address_returns GROUP BY ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type HAVING SUM(sr_return_quantity) > 50 ) SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_qty, cnt_returns, avg_vehicle_count, distinct_brands, CASE WHEN total_return_amt / NULLIF(total_qty,0) > 100 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Normal' END AS price_category, LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS previous_net_loss FROM city_agg ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 25

WITH address_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_location_type, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_return_quantity, hd.hd_vehicle_count, i.i_brand FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk ), city_agg AS ( SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, AVG(hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i_brand) AS distinct_brands FROM address_returns WHERE sr_return_amt > 0 GROUP BY ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type ) SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_qty, cnt_returns, avg_vehicle_count, distinct_brands, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_quartile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS state_rank FROM city_agg WHERE cnt_returns BETWEEN 3 AND 20 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH address_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_location_type, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_return_quantity, hd.hd_vehicle_count, i.i_brand FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk ), city_agg AS ( SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, AVG(hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i_brand) AS distinct_brands FROM address_returns GROUP BY ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type ) SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_qty, cnt_returns, avg_vehicle_count, distinct_brands, MAX(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS state_max_return_amt, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_percentile FROM city_agg WHERE ca_location_type = 'Urban' AND cnt_returns >= 2 ORDER BY net_loss_percentile ASC LIMIT 30

SELECT ranked.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ranked.d_year, ranked.d_month_seq ORDER BY ranked.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT sd_month.d_year, sd_month.d_month_seq, ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name, ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_returns, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) / SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price)) * 100 END AS return_rate_percent, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt), 0) / SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price)) > 0.10 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS risk_category FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim sd_month ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = sd_month.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk WHERE sd_month.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002 GROUP BY sd_month.d_year, sd_month.d_month_seq, ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name, ws.ws_item_sk HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 0) ranked ORDER BY ranked.d_year, ranked.d_month_seq, sales_rank

SELECT d.d_date, d.web_site_id, d.web_name, d.daily_net_profit, SUM(d.daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY d.web_site_id ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, AVG(d.daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY d.web_site_id ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d, CASE WHEN d.daily_net_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss Day' ELSE 'Profit Day' END AS profit_indicator FROM (SELECT ds.d_date, ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS daily_net_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim ds ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = ds.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk WHERE ds.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-01-01' AND DATE '2001-12-31' GROUP BY ds.d_date, ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name) d ORDER BY d.web_site_id, d.d_date

SELECT site_rank.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY site_rank.net_margin DESC) AS profit_rank FROM (SELECT ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name, sd_sales.d_year AS sales_year, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS total_net_loss, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) AS net_margin, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss), 0) > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS margin_category, DATE_DIFF('day', open_date.d_date, close_date.d_date) AS site_age_days, CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', open_date.d_date, close_date.d_date) > 3650 THEN 'Legacy' ELSE 'Recent' END AS site_age_category FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim sd_sales ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = sd_sales.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk JOIN date_dim open_date ON ws_site.web_open_date_sk = open_date.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim close_date ON ws_site.web_close_date_sk = close_date.d_date_sk WHERE sd_sales.d_year = 2001 GROUP BY ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name, sd_sales.d_year, open_date.d_date, close_date.d_date) site_rank ORDER BY net_margin DESC

SELECT t.web_site_id, t.web_name, t.d_year, t.total_sales, t.total_orders, CASE WHEN t.total_orders = 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_sales / t.total_orders END AS aov, t.total_quantity, CASE WHEN t.total_quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (t.total_return_qty / t.total_quantity) * 100 END AS return_rate_percent, CASE WHEN t.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_net_profit / t.total_sales END AS profit_margin, LAG(CASE WHEN t.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_net_profit / t.total_sales END) OVER (PARTITION BY t.web_site_id ORDER BY t.d_year) AS prev_year_profit_margin, (CASE WHEN t.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_net_profit / t.total_sales END) - LAG(CASE WHEN t.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_net_profit / t.total_sales END) OVER (PARTITION BY t.web_site_id ORDER BY t.d_year) AS profit_margin_change, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN t.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_net_profit / t.total_sales END) > 0.2 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END AS site_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.d_year ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.total_orders = 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_sales / t.total_orders END DESC) AS aov_rank_year FROM (SELECT ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name, sd_year.d_year, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim sd_year ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = sd_year.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk WHERE sd_year.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002 GROUP BY ws_site.web_site_id, ws_site.web_name, sd_year.d_year) t ORDER BY t.d_year, aov_rank_year

SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk, ca.ca_location_type, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) AS total_return_loss, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)-COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)-COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)-COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_segment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)-COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) DESC) AS global_customer_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_location_type ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)-COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) DESC) AS loc_type_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS promo_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ca.ca_location_type ORDER BY net_profit_after_returns DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ca.ca_state, ss.ss_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax),0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0) AS total_return_loss, (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)-COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0))/NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price),0) AS profitability_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_store_sk ORDER BY (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)-COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss),0))/NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price),0) DESC) AS promo_rank FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ca.ca_state, ss.ss_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active ORDER BY ss.ss_store_sk, promo_rank

WITH daily_returns AS (SELECT ca.ca_state AS state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amount FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk) SELECT state, return_date, daily_return_amount, LAG(daily_return_amount,1) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY return_date) AS prev_day_return, AVG(daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY return_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d, CASE WHEN daily_return_amount > COALESCE(LAG(daily_return_amount,1) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY return_date),0)*1.5 THEN 'Spike' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_spike_flag FROM daily_returns ORDER BY state, return_date

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items, AVG(hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS avg_income_band FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 5000 ) SELECT p_promo_sk, p_promo_name, p_channel_tv, total_sales, total_discount, total_profit, distinct_items, avg_income_band, total_sales / NULLIF(p_response_target,0) AS response_ratio, CASE WHEN total_sales > p_response_target THEN 'Exceeds' ELSE 'Below' END AS target_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_channel_tv ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM promo_sales ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items, AVG(hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS avg_income_band FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2400000 AND 2420000 GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv ) SELECT p_promo_sk, p_promo_name, p_channel_email, p_channel_tv, total_sales, total_discount, total_profit, distinct_items, avg_income_band, total_sales / NULLIF(p_response_target,0) AS response_ratio, CASE WHEN p_response_target = 0 THEN 'No Target' WHEN total_sales > p_response_target THEN 'Exceeds' ELSE 'Below' END AS target_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p_channel_email ORDER BY total_discount DESC) AS discount_rank FROM promo_sales WHERE total_discount > 0 ORDER BY p_channel_email, discount_rank

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items, AVG(hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS avg_income_band FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE p.p_channel_email = 'Y' GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv ) SELECT p_promo_sk, p_promo_name, total_sales, total_discount, total_profit, distinct_items, avg_income_band, total_sales / NULLIF(p_response_target,0) AS response_ratio, CASE WHEN total_sales > p_response_target THEN 'Exceeds' ELSE 'Below' END AS target_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS overall_sales_rank FROM promo_sales WHERE total_sales BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000 ORDER BY overall_sales_rank

WITH item_month_sales AS (
   SELECT
       i.i_item_sk,
       i.i_product_name,
       cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
   FROM catalog_sales cs
   JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
   im.cs_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_key,
   im.i_product_name,
   im.total_net_paid,
   im.total_sales,
   im.total_discount,
   CASE
       WHEN im.total_discount / NULLIF(im.total_sales, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'HIGH_DISCOUNT'
       WHEN im.total_discount / NULLIF(im.total_sales, 0) BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.2 THEN 'MEDIUM_DISCOUNT'
       ELSE 'LOW_DISCOUNT'
   END AS discount_tier,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.cs_sold_date_sk ORDER BY im.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_month
FROM item_month_sales im
WHERE im.total_sales > 0
ORDER BY im.cs_sold_date_sk, profit_rank_in_month
LIMIT 20

WITH sales_per_item_month AS (
   SELECT
       i.i_item_sk,
       i.i_product_name,
       cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_key,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS month_net_profit,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales
   FROM catalog_sales cs
   JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
returns_per_item_month AS (
   SELECT
       i.i_item_sk,
       i.i_product_name,
       sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_key,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS month_net_loss,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS month_return_amt
   FROM store_returns sr
   JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, sr.sr_returned_date_sk
)
SELECT
   s.i_product_name,
   s.date_key,
   s.month_net_profit,
   r.month_net_loss,
   (s.month_net_profit - COALESCE(r.month_net_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_after_returns,
   LAG(s.month_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s.i_item_sk ORDER BY s.date_key) AS prev_month_profit,
   CASE
       WHEN (s.month_net_profit - COALESCE(r.month_net_loss, 0)) > COALESCE(LAG(s.month_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s.i_item_sk ORDER BY s.date_key), 0) THEN 'PROFIT_INCREASE'
       ELSE 'PROFIT_DECREASE_OR_SAME'
   END AS profit_trend,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.i_item_sk ORDER BY s.date_key DESC) AS recent_month_rank
FROM sales_per_item_month s
LEFT JOIN returns_per_item_month r
   ON s.i_item_sk = r.i_item_sk AND s.date_key = r.date_key
WHERE s.month_net_profit IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY net_profit_after_returns DESC
LIMIT 30

WITH promo_metrics AS (
   SELECT
       p.p_promo_sk,
       p.p_promo_name,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
       SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
   FROM promotion p
   JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name
),
promo_returns AS (
   SELECT
       p.p_promo_sk,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount
   FROM promotion p
   JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT
   pm.p_promo_name,
   pm.total_sales,
   pm.total_discount,
   pm.total_promo_cost,
   COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
   (pm.total_sales - pm.total_discount - pm.total_promo_cost - COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_gain,
   NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (pm.total_sales - pm.total_discount - pm.total_promo_cost - COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS gain_quartile,
   CASE
       WHEN (pm.total_sales - pm.total_discount - pm.total_promo_cost - COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH'
       WHEN (pm.total_sales - pm.total_discount - pm.total_promo_cost - COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
       ELSE 'LOW'
   END AS performance_tier
FROM promo_metrics pm
LEFT JOIN promo_returns pr ON pm.p_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY net_gain DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH promo_sales AS (
   SELECT
       p.p_promo_sk,
       p.p_promo_name,
       i.i_category,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount
   FROM promotion p
   JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
   JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, i.i_category
),
promo_returns AS (
   SELECT
       p.p_promo_sk,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount
   FROM promotion p
   JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT
   ps.p_promo_name,
   ps.i_category,
   ps.total_net_profit,
   COALESCE(pr.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
   ps.total_discount_amount,
   CASE
       WHEN ps.total_net_profit - COALESCE(pr.total_net_loss, 0) > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE'
       ELSE 'NEGATIVE'
   END AS net_gain_status,
   DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ps.total_net_profit - COALESCE(pr.total_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM promo_sales ps
LEFT JOIN promo_returns pr ON ps.p_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH loss_summary AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id AS call_center_id, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, MAX(cr.cr_net_loss) AS max_loss, MIN(cr.cr_net_loss) AS min_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, sm.sm_type, w.w_warehouse_name ) SELECT call_center_id, call_center_name, ship_mode_type, warehouse_name, total_net_loss, max_loss, min_loss, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Severe' ELSE 'Moderate' END AS overall_category FROM loss_summary ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 10

WITH loss_by_center AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id AS call_center_id, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, cc.cc_employees AS employee_count, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, sm.sm_type, w.w_warehouse_name, cc.cc_employees ) SELECT call_center_id, call_center_name, ship_mode_type, warehouse_name, avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN avg_net_loss > 200 THEN 'Critical' WHEN avg_net_loss > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category FROM loss_by_center WHERE return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY avg_net_loss DESC

WITH recent_losses AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id AS call_center_id, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100 ) SELECT call_center_id, call_center_name, ship_mode_type, warehouse_name, SUM(cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY call_center_id ORDER BY cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loss FROM recent_losses WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(cr_returned_date_sk) FROM recent_losses) ORDER BY cumulative_loss DESC

WITH profit_by_birth AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        MIN(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS min_discount,
        MAX(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS max_discount
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk >= 2451545 -- filter to recent sales
    GROUP BY c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country
),
inventory_by_birth_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        i.inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS warehouse_stock,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.inv_item_sk) AS distinct_items
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN inventory i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country, i.inv_warehouse_sk
),
ranked_warehouses AS (
    SELECT
        birth_year,
        birth_country,
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        warehouse_stock,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY birth_year, birth_country ORDER BY warehouse_stock DESC) AS dr
    FROM inventory_by_birth_warehouse
)
SELECT
    pb.birth_year,
    pb.birth_country,
    pb.total_profit,
    pb.min_discount,
    pb.max_discount,
    rw.warehouse_stock,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pb.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(pb.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY pb.birth_country ORDER BY pb.total_profit ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_profit_by_country,
    CASE WHEN rw.dr = 1 THEN 'Top Warehouse' ELSE 'Other Warehouse' END AS warehouse_category,
    CASE WHEN pb.total_profit > 200000 THEN 'Elite' WHEN pb.total_profit > 80000 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END AS profit_segment
FROM profit_by_birth pb
LEFT JOIN ranked_warehouses rw ON pb.birth_year = rw.birth_year AND pb.birth_country = rw.birth_country AND rw.dr = 1
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON rw.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
ORDER BY profit_rank DESC

WITH profit_by_birth AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        MAX(ws.ws_net_paid) AS max_paid
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ship_mode_sk IN (1,2,3) -- focus on specific ship modes
    GROUP BY c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country
),
inventory_by_birth_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        c.c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        i.inv_warehouse_sk,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS warehouse_stock,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) * 0.8 AS adjusted_stock
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN inventory i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_birth_year, c.c_birth_country, i.inv_warehouse_sk
),
best_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        birth_year,
        birth_country,
        inv_warehouse_sk,
        warehouse_stock,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY birth_year, birth_country ORDER BY adjusted_stock DESC) AS rn
    FROM inventory_by_birth_warehouse
)
SELECT
    pb.birth_year,
    pb.birth_country,
    pb.total_profit,
    pb.avg_discount,
    pb.max_paid,
    bw.warehouse_stock AS best_stock,
    w.w_warehouse_name AS best_warehouse_name,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pb.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(pb.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY pb.birth_country ORDER BY pb.total_profit ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit_by_country,
    CASE WHEN pb.total_profit > 180000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN pb.total_profit > 90000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN pb.total_profit > 30000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_tier,
    CASE WHEN bw.warehouse_stock < pb.total_profit / 8 THEN 'Potential Shortage' ELSE 'Adequate Inventory' END AS inventory_status
FROM profit_by_birth pb
LEFT JOIN best_warehouse bw ON pb.birth_year = bw.birth_year AND pb.birth_country = bw.birth_country AND bw.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON bw.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
ORDER BY profit_rank

SELECT
    hd.hd_demo_sk,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
    COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_quantity) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) / SUM(cs.cs_quantity)
    END AS return_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0) > 0.2 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0) DESC) AS return_rate_rank
FROM household_demographics hd
JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    AND cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, w.w_warehouse_name

SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS net_contribution,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END AS contribution_flag,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    AVG(hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS avg_income_band,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS sales_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_orders
FROM warehouse w
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_warehouse_sk

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_id,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_profit,
        COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS return_loss,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS net_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) > 1000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS profit_category,
        AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0)) DESC) AS rn
    FROM warehouse w
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, cs.cs_item_sk, w.w_warehouse_sk
) t
WHERE t.rn <= 5
ORDER BY t.w_warehouse_id, t.rn

WITH unified AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        cs.cs_net_paid AS amount,
        1 AS sign,
        cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk AS demo_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_cash AS amount,
        -1 AS sign,
        cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk AS demo_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
),
 daily AS (
    SELECT
        u.warehouse_sk,
        u.date_sk,
        SUM(CASE WHEN u.sign = 1 THEN u.amount ELSE 0 END) AS daily_sales_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN u.sign = -1 THEN u.amount ELSE 0 END) AS daily_return_amount,
        SUM(u.sign * u.amount) AS daily_net_amount,
        u.demo_sk
    FROM unified u
    GROUP BY u.warehouse_sk, u.date_sk, u.demo_sk
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_id,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    d.date_sk,
    d.daily_sales_amount,
    d.daily_return_amount,
    d.daily_net_amount,
    CASE WHEN d.daily_net_amount >= 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS day_status,
    SUM(d.daily_net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY d.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_amount,
    AVG(hd.hd_income_band_sk) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk, d.date_sk) AS avg_income_band
FROM daily d
JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = d.warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = d.demo_sk
ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_id, d.date_sk

WITH date_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax,
        SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_return_hour
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year
),
ranked_dates AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank,
        LAG(total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS previous_return_amount
    FROM date_agg
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    d_year,
    total_returns,
    total_return_amount,
    avg_return_tax,
    total_fee,
    total_net_loss,
    avg_return_hour,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS'
        WHEN total_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS'
        ELSE 'LOW_LOSS'
    END AS loss_category,
    amount_rank,
    previous_return_amount,
    total_return_amount - COALESCE(previous_return_amount, 0) AS amount_diff_from_prev
FROM ranked_dates
WHERE amount_rank <= 10
ORDER BY amount_rank

WITH daily_hourly AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        t.t_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date, t.t_hour
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    t_hour,
    total_returns,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    avg_return_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN total_return_amount > 10000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN total_return_amount > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS return_amount_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY d_date ORDER BY t_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss_by_hour
FROM daily_hourly
ORDER BY d_date, t_hour

WITH demo_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        'REFUNDED' AS demo_type
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        'RETURNING' AS demo_type
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
)
SELECT
    d.d_year,
    dr.demo_type,
    dr.cd_gender,
    dr.cd_marital_status,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    SUM(dr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(dr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    AVG(dr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(dr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_rank_in_year
FROM demo_returns dr
JOIN date_dim d ON dr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
GROUP BY d.d_year, dr.demo_type, dr.cd_gender, dr.cd_marital_status
ORDER BY d.d_year, net_loss_rank_in_year

WITH page_returns AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, d_ret.d_year AS return_year, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) AS avg_amount_per_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS amount_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, d_ret.d_year ) SELECT pr.cp_catalog_page_id, pr.cp_department, pr.cp_type, pr.return_year, pr.total_return_amount, pr.total_net_loss, pr.return_cnt, pr.avg_quantity, pr.avg_amount_per_qty, pr.amount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.return_year ORDER BY pr.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.return_year, pr.cp_department ORDER BY pr.total_return_amount DESC) AS dept_amount_rank FROM page_returns pr WHERE pr.return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY pr.return_year DESC, net_loss_rank ASC LIMIT 20

WITH page_return_detail AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_end.d_date AS end_date, d_ret.d_date AS return_date, cr.cr_return_quantity, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_net_loss, DATE_DIFF('day', d_start.d_date, d_ret.d_date) AS days_from_start, DATE_DIFF('day', d_end.d_date, d_ret.d_date) AS days_from_end, CASE WHEN d_ret.d_date < d_start.d_date THEN 'EARLY' WHEN d_ret.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND d_end.d_date THEN 'ON_TIME' ELSE 'LATE' END AS return_timing FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk ) SELECT prd.cp_catalog_page_id, prd.cp_department, prd.cp_type, prd.start_date, prd.end_date, prd.return_date, prd.return_timing, SUM(prd.cr_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY prd.cp_catalog_page_id ORDER BY prd.return_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prd.cp_catalog_page_id ORDER BY prd.return_date) AS return_seq, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY prd.cp_catalog_page_id, prd.return_timing) AS cnt_by_timing FROM page_return_detail prd WHERE prd.return_timing = 'LATE' ORDER BY prd.cp_catalog_page_id, prd.return_date LIMIT 100

WITH daily_agg AS ( SELECT d_ret.d_date AS return_date, d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq, d_ret.d_day_name, t.t_hour, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS num_returns FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_date, d_ret.d_year, d_ret.d_month_seq, d_ret.d_day_name, t.t_hour ) SELECT da.return_date, da.d_year, da.d_month_seq, da.d_day_name, CASE WHEN da.t_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'Night' WHEN da.t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning' WHEN da.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon' ELSE 'Evening' END AS time_of_day, da.num_returns, da.total_return_amount, da.total_quantity, AVG(da.total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.d_year, da.d_month_seq ORDER BY da.return_date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS moving_avg_3d, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY da.return_date ORDER BY da.total_return_amount DESC) AS hour_amount_rank FROM daily_agg da WHERE da.num_returns > 10 ORDER BY da.d_year DESC, da.d_month_seq, da.return_date, hour_amount_rank LIMIT 50

WITH promo_store AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_quantity), 0) AS profit_per_unit,
        'store' AS channel
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk
),
promo_web AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ws.ws_quantity), 0) AS profit_per_unit,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk
),
promo_combined AS (
    SELECT
