WITH daily_store_profit AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS daily_quantity FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ) SELECT dsp.s_store_id, dsp.s_store_name, dsp.sold_date, dsp.daily_profit, dsp.daily_sales, LAG(dsp.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.s_store_id ORDER BY dsp.sold_date) AS prev_day_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(dsp.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.s_store_id ORDER BY dsp.sold_date) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LAG(dsp.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.s_store_id ORDER BY dsp.sold_date) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((dsp.daily_profit - LAG(dsp.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.s_store_id ORDER BY dsp.sold_date)) / LAG(dsp.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.s_store_id ORDER BY dsp.sold_date) * 100, 2) END AS profit_change_pct, CASE WHEN dsp.daily_profit > 0 AND (dsp.daily_profit - COALESCE(LAG(dsp.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.s_store_id ORDER BY dsp.sold_date), 0)) > 0 THEN 'Increasing' WHEN dsp.daily_profit > 0 AND (dsp.daily_profit - COALESCE(LAG(dsp.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.s_store_id ORDER BY dsp.sold_date), 0)) < 0 THEN 'Decreasing' ELSE 'Stable/Negative' END AS profit_trend FROM daily_store_profit dsp WHERE dsp.daily_sales > 0 ORDER BY dsp.s_store_id, dsp.sold_date

WITH income_stats AS ( SELECT ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk GROUP BY ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT ibs.ib_income_band_sk, ibs.ib_lower_bound, ibs.ib_upper_bound, ibs.total_quantity, ibs.total_net_profit, ibs.avg_sales_price, CASE WHEN ibs.total_quantity > 100000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN ibs.total_quantity BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN ibs.total_quantity BETWEEN 10000 AND 49999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS quantity_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ibs.total_net_profit DESC) AS net_profit_dense_rank, SUM(ibs.total_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY ibs.ib_income_band_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity FROM income_stats ibs ORDER BY ibs.ib_income_band_sk

WITH item_sales AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price), 0) > 0.20 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price), 0) > 0.10 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_sk ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) DESC) AS rn FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_item_sk ) SELECT isub.s_store_id, isub.s_store_name, isub.ss_item_sk, isub.total_quantity, isub.total_net_paid, isub.total_net_profit, isub.discount_category, CASE WHEN isub.total_net_paid = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(isub.total_net_profit / isub.total_net_paid, 4) END AS profit_margin FROM item_sales isub WHERE isub.rn <= 5 ORDER BY isub.s_store_id, isub.total_net_paid DESC

WITH store_income_profit AS ( SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS income_band_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS income_band_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ), store_total AS ( SELECT s_store_sk, SUM(income_band_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(income_band_sales) AS total_sales FROM store_income_profit GROUP BY s_store_sk ) SELECT sip.s_store_id, sip.s_store_name, sip.ib_income_band_sk, sip.ib_lower_bound, sip.ib_upper_bound, sip.income_band_profit, sip.income_band_sales, CASE WHEN sip.income_band_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss' WHEN sip.income_band_profit BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN 'Low' WHEN sip.income_band_profit BETWEEN 10001 AND 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY st.total_profit DESC) AS store_overall_profit_rank FROM store_income_profit sip JOIN store_total st ON sip.s_store_sk = st.s_store_sk ORDER BY st.total_profit DESC, sip.ib_income_band_sk

WITH pair_reason AS ( SELECT ca_ref.ca_state AS refunded_state, ca_ret.ca_state AS returning_state, MIN(ca_ref.ca_gmt_offset) AS refunded_gmt_offset, MIN(ca_ret.ca_gmt_offset) AS returning_gmt_offset, i.i_category AS item_category, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_ref.ca_state, ca_ret.ca_state, i.i_category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY ca_ref.ca_state, ca_ret.ca_state, i.i_category, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT pr.refunded_state, pr.returning_state, pr.item_category, pr.total_net_loss, pr.return_count, pr.r_reason_desc AS most_common_reason, CASE WHEN ABS(pr.refunded_gmt_offset - pr.returning_gmt_offset) > 3 THEN 'LARGE_GMT_DIFF' ELSE 'SMALL_GMT_DIFF' END AS gmt_offset_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pr.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.refunded_state ORDER BY pr.total_net_loss DESC) AS rank_within_refunded_state FROM pair_reason pr WHERE pr.rn = 1 ORDER BY net_loss_rank

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT r.r_reason_id, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_id, r.r_reason_desc ), state_reason_agg AS ( SELECT r.r_reason_id, ca.ca_state, i.i_category, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS state_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS state_return_qty, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_reason_id ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS state_dense_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_id, ca.ca_state, i.i_category ) SELECT ra.r_reason_id, ra.r_reason_desc, ra.total_net_loss, ra.total_return_qty, ra.avg_return_amt, sra.ca_state, sra.i_category, sra.state_net_loss, sra.state_return_qty, sra.state_dense_rank, CASE WHEN sra.state_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'HIGH_STATE_LOSS' ELSE 'NORMAL_STATE_LOSS' END AS state_loss_category FROM reason_agg ra JOIN state_reason_agg sra ON ra.r_reason_id = sra.r_reason_id WHERE ra.total_return_qty > 0 ORDER BY ra.r_reason_id, sra.state_dense_rank

WITH item_returns AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_return_quantity, wr.wr_net_loss, r.r_reason_desc, ca.ca_state FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ) SELECT ir.i_item_id, ir.i_product_name, ir.i_category, ir.wr_returned_date_sk, ir.wr_return_quantity, ir.wr_net_loss, SUM(ir.wr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.i_item_id ORDER BY ir.wr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(ir.wr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.i_item_id ORDER BY ir.wr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > 5000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS loss_flag, rr.most_common_reason, rr.reason_count, ir.ca_state AS refunded_state FROM item_returns ir LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.i_item_id, t.r_reason_desc AS most_common_reason, t.reason_cnt AS reason_count FROM ( SELECT i.i_item_id, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, r.r_reason_desc ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ) rr ON ir.i_item_id = rr.i_item_id WHERE ir.wr_return_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ir.i_item_id, ir.wr_returned_date_sk

WITH state_category_agg AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state, i.i_category, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, i.i_category ), reason_rank AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state, i.i_category, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state, i.i_category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, i.i_category, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT a.ca_state, a.i_category, a.total_net_loss, a.total_return_qty, a.avg_return_amt, CASE WHEN a.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN a.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS net_loss_bucket, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.i_category ORDER BY a.total_net_loss DESC) AS state_rank_in_category, rr.r_reason_desc AS most_common_reason, rr.reason_cnt AS most_common_reason_cnt FROM state_category_agg a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ca_state, i_category, r_reason_desc, reason_cnt FROM reason_rank WHERE rn = 1 ) rr ON a.ca_state = rr.ca_state AND a.i_category = rr.i_category ORDER BY a.i_category, state_rank_in_category

WITH page_sales AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM web_page wp JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) > 0) SELECT ps.wp_web_page_id, ps.wp_url, ps.ca_city, ps.ca_state, ps.distinct_customers, ps.total_net_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN ps.total_net_profit >= 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN ps.total_net_profit >= 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM page_sales ps ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH cust_sales AS (SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS total_transactions, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS web_pages_visited FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.ca_city, cs.ca_state, cs.total_transactions, cs.total_net_paid, cs.net_paid_percentile, CASE WHEN cs.net_paid_percentile <= 0.10 THEN 'Top Performer' WHEN cs.net_paid_percentile <= 0.30 THEN 'High Performer' ELSE 'Standard' END AS performance_tier, cs.web_pages_visited FROM (SELECT c.*, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_percentile FROM cust_sales c) cs ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 20

WITH cust_sales AS (SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS web_page_visits FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 0) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.ca_state, cs.total_net_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.ca_state ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS state_rank, CASE WHEN cs.total_net_paid > 100000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cs.total_net_paid > 50000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN cs.total_net_paid > 20000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier, cs.web_page_visits FROM cust_sales cs ORDER BY cs.ca_state, state_rank

SELECT site_id, site_name, ship_mode_id, ship_type, orders_count, avg_ship_cost, CASE WHEN avg_ship_cost > 50 THEN 'High Cost' WHEN avg_ship_cost BETWEEN 20 AND 50 THEN 'Medium Cost' ELSE 'Low Cost' END AS ship_cost_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY avg_net_profit DESC) AS profit_density_rank FROM ( SELECT w.web_site_id AS site_id, w.web_name AS site_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type AS ship_type, COUNT(*) AS orders_count, AVG(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY w.web_site_id, w.web_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ) sub ORDER BY site_id, profit_density_rank

SELECT site_id, site_name, promo_id, promo_name, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM ( SELECT w.web_site_id AS site_id, w.web_name AS site_name, p.p_promo_id AS promo_id, p.p_promo_name AS promo_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY w.web_site_id, w.web_name, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name ) sub ORDER BY site_id, profit_rank

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_net_profit, w.web_site_id, w.web_name, p.p_discount_active, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.web_site_id ORDER BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk DESC) AS rn FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk ) SELECT web_site_id, web_name, ws_sold_date_sk, SUM(ws_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, CASE WHEN p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS promo_active_flag FROM ranked_sales WHERE rn <= 30 ORDER BY web_site_id, ws_sold_date_sk

SELECT site_id, site_name, promo_id, promo_name, ship_mode_id, ship_type, sales_transactions, avg_discount_amt, avg_list_price, discount_ratio, promo_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY discount_ratio DESC) AS discount_efficiency_rank FROM ( SELECT w.web_site_id AS site_id, w.web_name AS site_name, p.p_promo_id AS promo_id, p.p_promo_name AS promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type AS ship_type, COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt, AVG(ws.ws_ext_list_price) AS avg_list_price, CASE WHEN AVG(ws.ws_ext_list_price) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) / AVG(ws.ws_ext_list_price) END AS discount_ratio, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk INNER JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY w.web_site_id, w.web_name, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, p.p_discount_active HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) sub ORDER BY site_id, discount_efficiency_rank

WITH ranked_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_order_number, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_net_loss, returning_ca.ca_address_sk, returning_ca.ca_city, returning_ca.ca_state, refunded_ca.ca_city AS refunded_city, refunded_ca.ca_state AS refunded_state, CASE WHEN cr.cr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'LOSS' WHEN cr.cr_net_loss < 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'BREAKEVEN' END AS net_loss_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY returning_ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_return_amount DESC) AS rn, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY returning_ca.ca_address_sk) AS total_return_amount_by_addr, LAG(cr.cr_return_amount,1) OVER (PARTITION BY returning_ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_return_amount DESC) AS prev_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address returning_ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = returning_ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address refunded_ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = refunded_ca.ca_address_sk ) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, cr_order_number, cr_return_amount, prev_return_amount, cr_net_loss, net_loss_type, total_return_amount_by_addr, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount_by_addr DESC) AS address_return_amount_rank, refunded_city, refunded_state FROM ranked_returns WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY total_return_amount_by_addr DESC, rn

WITH ranked_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_order_number, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_net_loss, returning_ca.ca_address_sk, returning_ca.ca_city, returning_ca.ca_state, refunded_ca.ca_city AS refunded_city, refunded_ca.ca_state AS refunded_state, CASE WHEN cr.cr_net_loss > 0 THEN 'LOSS' WHEN cr.cr_net_loss < 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'BREAKEVEN' END AS net_loss_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY returning_ca.ca_state ORDER BY cr.cr_return_amount DESC) AS rn, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY returning_ca.ca_state) AS total_return_amount_by_state FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address returning_ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = returning_ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address refunded_ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = refunded_ca.ca_address_sk ) SELECT ca_state, COUNT(DISTINCT cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, SUM(cr_return_amount) AS sum_return_amount, AVG(cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr_return_amount) DESC) AS state_return_rank FROM ranked_returns WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY ca_state ORDER BY state_return_rank, ca_state

WITH store_daily AS (
    SELECT sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
           COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt,
           SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS store_return_qty
    FROM store_returns
    GROUP BY sr_returned_date_sk
),
web_daily AS (
    SELECT wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
           COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
           SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS web_return_qty
    FROM web_returns
    GROUP BY wr_returned_date_sk
),
page_metrics AS (
    SELECT wp_creation_date_sk AS date_sk,
           COUNT(DISTINCT wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created,
           AVG(wp_char_count) AS avg_char_count,
           AVG(wp_link_count) AS avg_link_count
    FROM web_page
    GROUP BY wp_creation_date_sk
)
SELECT
    d.d_date AS report_date,
    d.d_year,
    d.d_month_seq,
    d.d_day_name,
    COALESCE(sd.store_net_loss, 0) AS store_net_loss,
    COALESCE(wd.web_net_loss, 0) AS web_net_loss,
    COALESCE(pm.pages_created, 0) AS pages_created,
    (COALESCE(sd.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wd.web_net_loss, 0)) AS total_net_loss,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(sd.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wd.web_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS loss_rank,
    SUM(COALESCE(sd.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wd.web_net_loss, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    AVG(COALESCE(sd.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wd.web_net_loss, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7day_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN d.d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 'Holiday'
        WHEN d.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend'
        ELSE 'Weekday'
    END AS day_type
FROM date_dim d
LEFT JOIN store_daily sd ON d.d_date_sk = sd.date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_daily wd ON d.d_date_sk = wd.date_sk
LEFT JOIN page_metrics pm ON d.d_date_sk = pm.date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2022
ORDER BY d.d_date

WITH store_cust AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_return_qty,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS store_return_amt
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, d.d_year
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_return_qty,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) AS distinct_page_types
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk, d.d_year
),
cust_agg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(s.d_year, w.d_year) AS year,
        COALESCE(s.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(s.store_return_qty, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty,
        COALESCE(s.store_return_amt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amt, 0) AS total_return_amt,
        COALESCE(w.distinct_page_types, 0) AS page_type_count
    FROM store_cust s
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w
        ON s.customer_sk = w.customer_sk AND s.d_year = w.d_year
)
SELECT
    ca.customer_sk,
    ca.year,
    ca.total_net_loss,
    ca.total_return_qty,
    ca.total_return_amt,
    ca.page_type_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.year ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS yearly_customer_loss_rank,
    LAG(ca.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.customer_sk ORDER BY ca.year) AS prev_year_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(ca.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.customer_sk ORDER BY ca.year) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN LAG(ca.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.customer_sk ORDER BY ca.year) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (ca.total_net_loss - LAG(ca.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.customer_sk ORDER BY ca.year)) / LAG(ca.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.customer_sk ORDER BY ca.year) * 100
    END AS net_loss_pct_change
FROM cust_agg ca
WHERE ca.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022
ORDER BY ca.year, ca.total_net_loss DESC

WITH page_returns AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_type,
        wp.wp_char_count,
        wp.wp_link_count,
        wr.wr_returned_date_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_return_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, wp.wp_char_count, wp.wp_link_count, wr.wr_returned_date_sk
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS store_return_amt
    FROM store_returns sr
    GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk
),
page_store AS (
    SELECT
        pr.wp_web_page_sk,
        SUM(COALESCE(sd.store_net_loss, 0)) AS total_store_net_loss,
        SUM(COALESCE(sd.store_return_amt, 0)) AS total_store_return_amt
    FROM page_returns pr
    LEFT JOIN store_daily sd ON pr.wr_returned_date_sk = sd.sr_returned_date_sk
    GROUP BY pr.wp_web_page_sk
),
page_creation AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
    t.wp_web_page_sk,
    t.wp_url,
    t.wp_type,
    t.total_web_net_loss,
    t.total_web_return_amt,
    t.total_web_return_qty,
    t.total_store_net_loss,
    t.total_store_return_amt,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.total_web_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN t.total_web_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High Loss'
        WHEN t.total_web_net_loss BETWEEN 2000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
        ELSE 'Low Loss'
    END AS loss_category,
    CASE
        WHEN t.total_web_return_amt = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE t.total_web_net_loss / t.total_web_return_amt
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT
        pc.wp_web_page_sk,
        pr.wp_url,
        pr.wp_type,
        SUM(pr.web_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss,
        SUM(pr.web_return_amt) AS total_web_return_amt,
        SUM(pr.web_return_qty) AS total_web_return_qty,
        ps.total_store_net_loss,
        ps.total_store_return_amt
    FROM page_returns pr
    JOIN page_creation pc ON pr.wp_web_page_sk = pc.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN page_store ps ON pr.wp_web_page_sk = ps.wp_web_page_sk
    WHERE pc.d_year = 2022
    GROUP BY pc.wp_web_page_sk, pr.wp_url, pr.wp_type, ps.total_store_net_loss, ps.total_store_return_amt
) t
ORDER BY loss_rank
LIMIT 5

WITH store_month AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_return_qty,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS store_return_amt
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
),
web_month AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS web_return_qty,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
),
page_creation_month AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created,
        AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_count_created
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
),
page_access_month AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_accessed,
        AVG(wp.wp_link_count) AS avg_link_count_accessed
    FROM web_page wp
    JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    sm.d_year,
    sm.d_month_seq,
    sm.store_net_loss,
    wm.web_net_loss,
    (sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    LAG(sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN LAG(sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) - LAG(sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq)) / LAG(sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) * 100
    END AS mom_growth_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN ((sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) - LAG(sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq)) > 0 THEN 'Increasing'
        WHEN ((sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) - LAG(sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq)) < 0 THEN 'Decreasing'
        ELSE 'Stable'
    END AS growth_trend,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sm.store_net_loss + wm.web_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank,
    COALESCE(pc.pages_created, 0) AS pages_created,
    COALESCE(pa.pages_accessed, 0) AS pages_accessed,
    COALESCE(pc.avg_char_count_created, 0) AS avg_char_count_created,
    COALESCE(pa.avg_link_count_accessed, 0) AS avg_link_count_accessed
FROM store_month sm
JOIN web_month wm ON sm.d_year = wm.d_year AND sm.d_month_seq = wm.d_month_seq
LEFT JOIN page_creation_month pc ON sm.d_year = pc.d_year AND sm.d_month_seq = pc.d_month_seq
LEFT JOIN page_access_month pa ON sm.d_year = pa.d_year AND sm.d_month_seq = pa.d_month_seq
WHERE sm.d_year >= 2020
ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq

WITH store_yearly AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_market_desc,
        d.d_fy_year,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE WHEN s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS store_status
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_market_desc, d.d_fy_year, s.s_closed_date_sk
)
SELECT
    s_store_sk,
    s_store_name,
    s_market_desc,
    d_fy_year,
    total_return_amt,
    total_net_loss,
    store_status,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_fy_year ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS store_return_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_fy_year ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS market_net_loss_rank
FROM store_yearly
ORDER BY d_fy_year, store_return_rank

WITH dept_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        d_start.d_year,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, d_start.d_year
)
SELECT
    cp_department,
    cp_type,
    d_year,
    total_return_amt,
    CASE
        WHEN total_return_amt >= 50000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN total_return_amt >= 20000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_return_amt >= 10000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_amount_bucket,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS dept_rank_within_type,
    total_return_amt * 1.0 / SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS pct_of_type_total
FROM dept_returns
ORDER BY cp_type, dept_rank_within_type

WITH daily_store_returns AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, d.d_date
)
SELECT
    s_store_sk,
    s_store_name,
    d_date,
    daily_return_amt,
    daily_net_loss,
    SUM(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amt,
    AVG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7day,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_sk ORDER BY daily_return_amt DESC) AS daily_return_rank,
    CASE WHEN daily_return_amt > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN daily_return_amt > 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_amount_category
FROM daily_store_returns
ORDER BY s_store_sk, d_date

WITH catalog_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_department,
        cp.cp_type,
        d_start.d_year,
        d_start.d_month_seq,
        COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS returns_count
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, d_start.d_year, d_start.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp_department,
    cp_type,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    returns_count,
    (returns_count * 1.0) / SUM(returns_count) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq) AS returns_ratio_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY returns_count DESC) AS rank_by_returns,
    CASE WHEN returns_count >= 100 THEN 'High' WHEN returns_count >= 50 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category
FROM catalog_returns
ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, rank_by_returns

WITH discounted_orders AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number,
           wsit.web_site_id,
           sm.sm_type,
           td.t_shift,
           ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
           ws.ws_ext_list_price,
           (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(ws.ws_ext_list_price,0)) AS discount_ratio,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id ORDER BY (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(ws.ws_ext_list_price,0)) ASC) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id) AS orders_per_site
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_ext_list_price > 0
)
SELECT ws_order_number,
       web_site_id,
       sm_type,
       t_shift,
       ws_ext_discount_amt,
       ws_ext_list_price,
       discount_ratio,
       orders_per_site,
       rn
FROM discounted_orders
WHERE rn <= 7
GROUP BY ws_order_number, web_site_id, sm_type, t_shift, ws_ext_discount_amt, ws_ext_list_price, discount_ratio, orders_per_site, rn
ORDER BY orders_per_site DESC, web_site_id

WITH discounted_orders AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number,
           wsit.web_site_id,
           sm.sm_type,
           td.t_shift,
           ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
           ws.ws_ext_list_price,
           (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(ws.ws_ext_list_price,0)) AS discount_ratio,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id ORDER BY ws.ws_ext_discount_amt DESC) AS rn,
           AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id) AS avg_discount_amt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    WHERE sm.sm_type = 'AIR'
)
SELECT ws_order_number,
       web_site_id,
       sm_type,
       t_shift,
       ws_ext_discount_amt,
       ws_ext_list_price,
       discount_ratio,
       avg_discount_amt,
       rn
FROM discounted_orders
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY avg_discount_amt DESC, web_site_id

WITH top_discounted AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_order_number,
           wsit.web_site_id,
           sm.sm_type,
           td.t_shift,
           ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
           ws.ws_ext_list_price,
           (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(ws.ws_ext_list_price,0)) AS discount_ratio,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id ORDER BY (ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(ws.ws_ext_list_price,0)) DESC) AS rn,
           SUM(ws.ws_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_id) AS total_qty_per_site
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    WHERE td.t_shift = 'Evening'
)
SELECT ws_order_number,
       web_site_id,
       sm_type,
       t_shift,
       ws_ext_discount_amt,
       ws_ext_list_price,
       discount_ratio,
       total_qty_per_site,
       rn
FROM top_discounted
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY web_site_id, discount_ratio DESC

WITH return_events AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id AS refunded_customer_id, w.w_warehouse_name, r.r_reason_desc, CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_value_flag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS seq_per_warehouse FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk ) SELECT re.cr_returned_date_sk, re.w_warehouse_name, re.r_reason_desc, re.refunded_customer_id, SUM(re.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY re.cr_warehouse_sk ORDER BY re.cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, SUM(re.high_value_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY re.cr_warehouse_sk ORDER BY re.cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_high_value_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(re.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY re.cr_warehouse_sk ORDER BY re.cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > 100000 THEN 'ALERT' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS warehouse_status FROM return_events re WHERE re.seq_per_warehouse <= 100 ORDER BY re.w_warehouse_name, re.cr_returned_date_sk

WITH refunded_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, MAX(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS last_return_date_sk FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name ) SELECT rs.cr_refunded_customer_sk, rs.c_first_name, rs.c_last_name, rs.total_net_loss, rs.return_cnt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, w.w_warehouse_name, r.r_reason_desc FROM refunded_summary rs LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk DESC) AS rn FROM catalog_returns cr ) latest ON latest.cr_refunded_customer_sk = rs.cr_refunded_customer_sk AND latest.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON latest.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN reason r ON latest.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE rs.total_net_loss > 0 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
       sm.sm_carrier,
       MIN(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS min_discount,
       SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
       CASE WHEN AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) > 1500 THEN 'HIGH_DISCOUNT' ELSE 'LOW_DISCOUNT' END AS discount_category,
       AVG(st.store_avg_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id) AS avg_store_net_paid
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ss.ss_hdemo_sk,
           AVG(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_avg_net_paid
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_hdemo_sk
) st ON hd.hd_demo_sk = st.ss_hdemo_sk
WHERE hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 2 AND 6
GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_carrier, st.store_avg_net_paid
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 20
ORDER BY min_discount ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    wp.wp_web_page_id,
    wp.wp_type,
    wp.wp_char_count,
    wp.wp_link_count,
    wp.wp_image_count,
    cd.d_date AS creation_date,
    ad.d_date AS access_date,
    date_diff('day', cd.d_date, ad.d_date) AS days_active,
    CASE
        WHEN date_diff('day', cd.d_date, ad.d_date) > 365 THEN 'Long-lived'
        ELSE 'Short-lived'
    END AS life_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_type ORDER BY wp.wp_link_count DESC) AS link_rank,
    SUM(wp.wp_char_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_type ORDER BY wp.wp_char_count ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_char_count
FROM web_page wp
JOIN date_dim cd ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim ad ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = ad.d_date_sk
WHERE wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'

WITH site_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_mkt_class,
        COUNT(*) AS site_cnt,
        AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim od ON ws.web_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws.web_mkt_class
)
SELECT
    web_mkt_class,
    site_cnt,
    avg_tax_pct,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_tax_pct DESC) AS tax_pct_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_tax_pct > 0.15 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS tax_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY site_cnt DESC) AS site_cnt_rank
FROM site_stats
ORDER BY tax_pct_rank

SELECT
    cc.cc_call_center_sk,
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_division,
    cc.cc_employees,
    cc.cc_sq_ft,
    od.d_date AS open_date,
    cd.d_date AS close_date,
    date_diff('day', od.d_date, cd.d_date) AS open_close_days,
    CASE
        WHEN cc.cc_employees > 500 THEN 'Large'
        WHEN cc.cc_employees > 200 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Small'
    END AS size_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_division ORDER BY cc.cc_employees DESC) AS emp_rank_in_division,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY date_diff('day', od.d_date, cd.d_date) DESC) AS duration_rank
FROM call_center cc
JOIN date_dim od ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim cd ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
WHERE od.d_year = 2020

WITH daily_activity AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc_open.cc_call_center_sk) AS centers_opened,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc_close.cc_call_center_sk) AS centers_closed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_open.web_site_sk) AS sites_opened,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_close.web_site_sk) AS sites_closed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp_create.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp_access.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_accessed
    FROM date_dim d
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc_open ON cc_open.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN call_center cc_close ON cc_close.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws_open ON ws_open.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws_close ON ws_close.web_close_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp_create ON wp_create.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_page wp_access ON wp_access.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    centers_opened,
    centers_closed,
    sites_opened,
    sites_closed,
    pages_created,
    pages_accessed,
    (centers_opened + centers_closed + sites_opened + sites_closed + pages_created + pages_accessed) AS total_activity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (centers_opened + centers_closed + sites_opened + sites_closed + pages_created + pages_accessed) DESC) AS activity_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN (centers_opened + centers_closed + sites_opened + sites_closed + pages_created + pages_accessed) > 100 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS activity_level
FROM daily_activity
WHERE (centers_opened + centers_closed + sites_opened + sites_closed + pages_created + pages_accessed) > 0
ORDER BY activity_rank

SELECT t_hour, t_shift, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, CASE WHEN total_return_qty > 100 THEN 'PEAK' ELSE 'OFF_PEAK' END AS demand_category, SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY t_hour) AS cumulative_net_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_hour_rank FROM ( SELECT td.t_hour, td.t_shift, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY td.t_hour, td.t_shift ) AS hourly ORDER BY t_hour

WITH agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_shift, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_shift HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 0 ) SELECT return_date, sm_ship_mode_id, sm_carrier, t_shift, total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY return_date ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS ship_mode_loss_rank FROM agg ORDER BY return_date, ship_mode_loss_rank

SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, td_c.t_shift, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_catalog_return_amount, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_store_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_catalog_net_loss, AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_store_net_loss, CASE WHEN (AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) + COALESCE(AVG(sr.sr_net_loss), 0)) > 1000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' ELSE 'LOW_LOSS' END AS loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td_c.t_shift ORDER BY (AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) + COALESCE(AVG(sr.sr_net_loss), 0)) DESC) AS shift_loss_rank FROM catalog_returns cr LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON cr.cr_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk JOIN time_dim td_c ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td_c.t_time_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_item_sk, td_c.t_shift HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY return_date, shift_loss_rank

WITH combined_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_qty, 'catalog' AS channel, td.t_shift AS shift FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk UNION ALL SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, sr.sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, NULL AS ship_mode_type, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_qty, 'store' AS channel, td.t_shift AS shift FROM store_returns sr JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk ) SELECT reason_sk, COALESCE(ship_mode_type, 'NO_SHIP_MODE') AS ship_mode_type, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'catalog' THEN net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS catalog_net_loss, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS store_net_loss, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(net_loss) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'catalog' THEN net_loss ELSE 0 END) / SUM(net_loss)) * 100 END AS catalog_loss_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(net_loss) DESC) AS loss_reason_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT return_date) AS active_days FROM combined_returns GROUP BY reason_sk, ship_mode_type HAVING SUM(net_loss) > 0 ORDER BY loss_reason_rank

WITH month_key AS (
    SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, MAX(d_date_sk) AS month_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    GROUP BY d_year, d_month_seq
),
month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid_inc_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cs.cs_coupon_amt > 0) AS coupon_orders,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS total_tax
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    ms.d_year,
    ms.d_month_seq,
    ms.total_paid_inc_tax,
    ms.total_ship_cost,
    ms.coupon_orders,
    ms.total_tax,
    CASE WHEN ms.total_ship_cost / NULLIF(ms.total_paid_inc_tax,0) > 0.15 THEN 'EXPENSIVE SHIP' ELSE 'NORMAL SHIP' END AS ship_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ms.d_year ORDER BY ms.total_tax ASC) AS tax_rank_asc,
    ws.web_name,
    ws.web_gmt_offset,
    wp.wp_url,
    wp.wp_type
FROM month_sales ms
JOIN month_key mk ON ms.d_year = mk.d_year AND ms.d_month_seq = mk.d_month_seq
LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = mk.month_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = mk.month_date_sk
ORDER BY ms.d_year, tax_rank_asc

WITH month_key AS (
    SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, MIN(d_date_sk) AS month_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year >= 2016 AND d_year <= 2021
    GROUP BY d_year, d_month_seq
),
month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS avg_tax
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2021
      AND cs.cs_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    ms.d_year,
    ms.d_month_seq,
    ms.total_profit,
    ms.total_quantity,
    ms.distinct_orders,
    ms.avg_tax,
    CASE WHEN ms.avg_tax > 5 THEN 'HIGH AVG TAX' ELSE 'LOW AVG TAX' END AS tax_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ms.d_year ORDER BY ms.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    ws.web_name,
    ws.web_gmt_offset,
    wp.wp_url,
    wp.wp_type
FROM month_sales ms
JOIN month_key mk ON ms.d_year = mk.d_year AND ms.d_month_seq = mk.d_month_seq
LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = mk.month_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = mk.month_date_sk
ORDER BY ms.d_year, profit_rank DESC

WITH store_promo_avg AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, p.p_promo_id, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 5 GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, p.p_promo_id ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, p_promo_id, avg_net_profit, CASE WHEN avg_net_profit >= 2000 THEN 'High' WHEN avg_net_profit >= 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_id ORDER BY avg_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM store_promo_avg ORDER BY profit_rank, p_promo_id

WITH latest_inv AS (
    SELECT inv_warehouse_sk,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk
),
hourly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        i.i_brand,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS hour_sales,
        COALESCE(li.total_inventory, 0) AS inventory_total,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS sales_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS hour_rank
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN latest_inv li ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = li.inv_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, td.t_hour, i.i_brand, li.total_inventory
)
SELECT
    ws_warehouse_sk,
    t_hour,
    i_brand,
    hour_sales,
    inventory_total,
    sales_flag,
    hour_rank
FROM hourly_sales
WHERE hour_rank <= 5
ORDER BY ws_warehouse_sk, hour_rank

WITH latest_inv AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk,
           inv_warehouse_sk,
           inv_quantity_on_hand
    FROM (
        SELECT inv_item_sk,
               inv_warehouse_sk,
               inv_quantity_on_hand,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv_item_sk ORDER BY inv_date_sk DESC) AS rn
        FROM inventory
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    i.i_category,
    td.t_shift,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_list_price > 0 THEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / ws.ws_ext_list_price ELSE 0 END) AS avg_discount_rate,
    MAX(li.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_on_hand_latest,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY td.t_shift ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_shift,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 1000000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 500000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_tier
FROM web_sales ws
INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN latest_inv li ON i.i_item_sk = li.inv_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_category, td.t_shift
ORDER BY i.i_category, total_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH latest_inv AS (
    SELECT inv_item_sk,
           MAX(inv_date_sk) AS latest_date,
           SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS qty_on_hand
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY inv_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_category,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_list_price > 0 THEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / ws.ws_ext_list_price ELSE 0 END) AS avg_discount_rate,
    MAX(li.qty_on_hand) AS inventory_on_hand_latest,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_dense_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) >= 100000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) >= 50000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) >= 20000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_tier,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_list_price > 0 THEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / ws.ws_ext_list_price ELSE 0 END) > 0.2 THEN 'High Discount'
        ELSE 'Low/Medium Discount'
    END AS discount_flag,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE td.t_shift = 'Evening') AS avg_evening_sales_price,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE td.t_shift = 'Morning') AS avg_morning_sales_price
FROM web_sales ws
INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN latest_inv li ON i.i_item_sk = li.inv_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, li.qty_on_hand
HAVING SUM(ws.ws_quantity) > 0
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT sw.warehouse_id, sw.brand, sw.shift, sw.total_sales, COALESCE(rw.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns, sw.total_quantity, (sw.total_sales - COALESCE(rw.total_returns, 0)) AS net_sales, SUM(sw.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY sw.warehouse_id, sw.brand ORDER BY sw.shift_hour) AS cumulative_sales_brand, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sw.warehouse_id, sw.brand ORDER BY sw.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_in_warehouse_brand, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sw.warehouse_id, sw.brand ORDER BY sw.total_sales DESC) = 1 THEN 'Peak Shift' ELSE 'Non-Peak' END AS shift_category FROM ( SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_id, i.i_brand AS brand, td.t_shift AS shift, MIN(td.t_hour) AS shift_hour, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, i.i_brand, td.t_shift ) sw LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_id, i.i_brand AS brand, td.t_shift AS shift, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, i.i_brand, td.t_shift ) rw ON sw.warehouse_id = rw.warehouse_id AND sw.brand = rw.brand AND sw.shift = rw.shift ORDER BY sw.warehouse_id, sw.brand, sw.shift_hour LIMIT 50

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_brand AS brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS sold_qty, MIN(td.t_meal_time) AS sample_meal_time FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_brand AS brand, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS returns_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS returned_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, sr.sr_returned_date_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT COALESCE(s.brand, r.brand) AS brand, COALESCE(s.date_sk, r.date_sk) AS date_sk, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS returns_amount, COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty, COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0) AS returned_qty, s.sample_meal_time FROM sales_agg s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_agg r ON s.brand = r.brand AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk ) SELECT brand, date_sk, sales_amount, returns_amount, sold_qty, returned_qty, LAG(sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY date_sk) AS prev_sales, (sales_amount - LAG(sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY date_sk)) AS sales_mom_change, CASE WHEN (sales_amount - LAG(sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY date_sk)) > 0 THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease' END AS sales_trend, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, sample_meal_time FROM combined WHERE sales_amount > 0 ORDER BY brand, date_sk

WITH sales_qty AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS sold_qty FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk ), returns_by_shift AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, td.t_shift, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS returned_qty_shift FROM store_returns sr JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk, td.t_shift ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT item_sk, returned_qty_shift AS total_returned_qty, t_shift AS top_shift FROM ( SELECT item_sk, t_shift, returned_qty_shift, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY returned_qty_shift DESC) AS rn FROM returns_by_shift ) sub WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, s.sold_qty, COALESCE(r.total_returned_qty, 0) AS returned_qty, CASE WHEN s.sold_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(r.total_returned_qty, 0) * 100.0 / s.sold_qty) END AS return_rate_percent, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(r.total_returned_qty, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.sold_qty,0)) > 20 THEN 'High Return' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(r.total_returned_qty, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.sold_qty,0)) DESC) AS return_rate_rank, r.top_shift AS shift_with_max_returns FROM sales_qty s JOIN item i ON s.item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.item_sk = r.item_sk WHERE s.sold_qty > 0 ORDER BY return_rate_percent DESC LIMIT 25

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, MIN(td.t_hour) AS sales_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_item_sk ) SELECT s.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, s.sales_hour, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns, (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_adj, CASE WHEN (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) >= 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) >= 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_sold_date_sk ORDER BY (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s JOIN item i ON s.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.cs_sold_date_sk = r.returned_date_sk AND s.cs_item_sk = r.item_sk WHERE s.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY sold_date_sk, profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS ret_cnt, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_amt, MIN(wr.wr_return_amt) AS min_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0 AND wr.wr_return_amt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_country, cr.cd_gender, cr.ret_cnt, cr.avg_amt, cr.min_amt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cd_gender ORDER BY cr.min_amt ASC) AS gender_min_rank FROM customer_returns cr WHERE cr.ca_country <> 'United States' ORDER BY cr.ret_cnt DESC

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 2 AND 5 GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_country, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_country, cr.cd_gender, cr.return_cnt, cr.total_net_loss, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.ca_country ORDER BY cr.total_net_loss DESC) AS country_net_loss_percent FROM customer_returns cr WHERE cr.return_cnt > 5 ORDER BY cr.total_net_loss ASC

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity = 1 AND ca.ca_state IN ('CA','NY') GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_gender HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) SELECT cr.c_customer_sk, cr.c_first_name, cr.c_last_name, cr.ca_state, cr.cd_gender, cr.distinct_orders, cr.avg_return_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.ca_state ORDER BY cr.avg_return_tax ASC) AS state_tax_rank FROM customer_returns cr ORDER BY cr.distinct_orders DESC

WITH sales_per_order AS (SELECT ws.ws_order_number, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS sales_profit FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_order_number), returns_per_order AS (SELECT wr.wr_order_number, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_order_number) SELECT s.ws_order_number AS order_number, s.sales_amount, COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount, s.sales_profit, COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS return_loss, s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS net_profit_post_return, CASE WHEN s.sales_profit - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS profit_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) - s.sales_profit DESC) AS loss_rank FROM sales_per_order s LEFT JOIN returns_per_order r ON s.ws_order_number = r.wr_order_number WHERE s.sales_amount > 0 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_by_item_quarter AS (SELECT d.d_quarter_name, ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS sales_qty FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name, ws.ws_item_sk), returns_by_item_quarter AS (SELECT d_ret.d_quarter_name, wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS return_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_quarter_name, wr.wr_item_sk), combined AS (SELECT s.d_quarter_name, s.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, s.sales_amount, COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount, CASE WHEN s.sales_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.sales_qty END AS return_rate, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.sales_qty > 0.2 THEN 'High Return' ELSE 'Low Return' END AS return_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.d_quarter_name ORDER BY s.sales_amount DESC) AS rn FROM sales_by_item_quarter s LEFT JOIN returns_by_item_quarter r ON s.d_quarter_name = r.d_quarter_name AND s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk) SELECT d_quarter_name, item_sk, sales_amount, return_amount, return_rate, return_category FROM combined WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY d_quarter_name, sales_amount DESC

WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT d.d_date, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), daily_returns AS (SELECT d_ret.d_date, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_returns, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk GROUP BY d_ret.d_date) SELECT ds.d_date, ds.total_sales, COALESCE(dr.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns, ds.total_sales - COALESCE(dr.total_returns, 0) AS net_gain, CASE WHEN ds.total_sales - COALESCE(dr.total_returns, 0) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS performance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ds.total_sales - COALESCE(dr.total_returns, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN daily_returns dr ON ds.d_date = dr.d_date WHERE ds.d_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' ORDER BY ds.d_date

WITH hourly_sales AS (SELECT t.t_hour, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_price FROM web_sales ws JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2023 GROUP BY t.t_hour), hourly_returns AS (SELECT t_ret.t_hour, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_returns, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN time_dim t_ret ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_ret.t_time_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk WHERE d_ret.d_year = 2023 GROUP BY t_ret.t_hour) SELECT h.t_hour, h.total_sales, COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns, h.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS net_sales, h.total_profit, CASE WHEN h.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17 THEN 'Peak' ELSE 'Off-Peak' END AS period_category, SUM(h.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY h.t_hour ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_hour_rolling_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY h.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM hourly_sales h LEFT JOIN hourly_returns r ON h.t_hour = r.t_hour ORDER BY h.t_hour

WITH reason_summary AS (SELECT r.r_reason_desc, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS catalog_net_loss, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS store_net_loss, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk), 0) AS distinct_catalog_pages, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS combined_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_catalog_return_qty, AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_store_return_qty FROM reason r LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc), total_loss AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) FROM catalog_returns cr),0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) FROM store_returns sr),0) AS grand_total_loss) SELECT rs.r_reason_desc, rs.catalog_net_loss, rs.store_net_loss, rs.combined_net_loss, rs.distinct_catalog_pages, rs.avg_catalog_return_qty, rs.avg_store_return_qty, CASE WHEN rs.combined_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_level, rs.combined_net_loss / tl.grand_total_loss AS loss_share, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN rs.combined_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END ORDER BY rs.combined_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM reason_summary rs CROSS JOIN total_loss tl WHERE rs.combined_net_loss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY loss_level, loss_rank LIMIT 12

WITH per_hour AS (SELECT r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc, td.t_meal_time AS t_meal_time, td.t_hour AS t_hour, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS hour_return_amount FROM web_returns wr JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, td.t_meal_time, td.t_hour, hd.hd_buy_potential) SELECT r_reason_desc, t_meal_time, t_hour, hd_buy_potential, hour_return_amount, CASE WHEN hour_return_amount >= 500 THEN 'Very High' WHEN hour_return_amount >= 200 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS hour_return_category, SUM(hour_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY t_hour ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_return_amount_by_reason FROM per_hour ORDER BY r_reason_desc, t_hour

WITH aggregated AS (SELECT td.t_hour AS t_hour, CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High' THEN 'High Potential' WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium Potential' ELSE 'Low Potential' END AS buy_potential_category, r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount FROM web_returns wr JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE td.t_shift = 'Evening' GROUP BY td.t_hour, hd.hd_buy_potential, r.r_reason_desc) SELECT t_hour, buy_potential_category, r_reason_desc, total_return_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_hour, buy_potential_category ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS reason_rank_in_hour FROM aggregated ORDER BY t_hour, reason_rank_in_hour

WITH net_loss_per_hh_reason AS (SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc, td.t_meal_time AS t_meal_time, CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN 'No Vehicles' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count <= 2 THEN 'Few Vehicles' ELSE 'Many Vehicles' END AS vehicle_bucket, CASE WHEN hd.hd_dep_count = 0 THEN 'No Dependents' WHEN hd.hd_dep_count <= 2 THEN 'Few Dependents' ELSE 'Many Dependents' END AS dependent_bucket, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, r.r_reason_desc, td.t_meal_time) SELECT hd_demo_sk, vehicle_bucket, dependent_bucket, r_reason_desc, t_meal_time, total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_bucket ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS rank_by_vehicle_bucket, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dependent_bucket ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS rank_by_dependent_bucket FROM net_loss_per_hh_reason WHERE total_net_loss > 0 ORDER BY overall_rank FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT
    cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp.cp_department,
    cp.cp_type,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS dept_rank
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential = 'high'
GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type
HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) > 0
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk
),
returns AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT
    s.hd_demo_sk,
    s.total_sales_qty,
    COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty,
    CASE
        WHEN s.total_sales_qty = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.total_sales_qty
    END AS return_to_sales_ratio,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN s.total_sales_qty = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.total_sales_qty
    END) AS ratio_percentile,
    CASE
        WHEN CASE
            WHEN s.total_sales_qty = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) * 1.0 / s.total_sales_qty
        END > 0.5 THEN 'High Return Rate'
        ELSE 'Low Return Rate'
    END AS return_rate_category
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN returns r ON s.hd_demo_sk = r.hd_demo_sk
ORDER BY return_to_sales_ratio DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk
)
SELECT
    s.hd_income_band_sk,
    s.total_sales_profit,
    COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
    (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_metric,
    CASE
        WHEN (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END AS net_metric_sign,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS income_band_rank
FROM sales_agg s
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.hd_income_band_sk = r.hd_income_band_sk
ORDER BY income_band_rank

WITH return_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_tax, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT r.cr_returning_customer_sk, r.total_return_amount, r.total_tax, r.return_cnt, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY r.total_tax DESC) AS tax_rank FROM return_summary r JOIN customer c ON r.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON r.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY r.total_tax DESC LIMIT 250

WITH return_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS avg_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk ) SELECT r.cr_returning_customer_sk, r.total_return_amount, r.avg_return_amount, r.return_cnt, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY r.avg_return_amount DESC) AS quartile FROM return_summary r JOIN customer c ON r.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON r.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE r.avg_return_amount > 50 ORDER BY r.avg_return_amount DESC LIMIT 180

WITH return_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk ) SELECT r.cr_returning_customer_sk, r.total_return_amount, r.total_fee, r.return_cnt, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY r.total_fee DESC) AS state_fee_rank FROM return_summary r JOIN customer c ON r.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON r.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE r.total_return_amount > 2000 ORDER BY r.total_fee DESC, r.return_cnt DESC LIMIT 100

WITH return_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 5 GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 500 AND 5000 ) SELECT r.cr_returning_customer_sk, r.total_return_amount, r.total_net_loss, r.return_cnt, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY r.total_net_loss ASC) AS state_loss_rank FROM return_summary r JOIN customer c ON r.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON r.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY r.total_net_loss ASC LIMIT 150

WITH store_return_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_id,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS returned_qty,
        (SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_quantity), 0)) AS return_rate,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_quarter_seq = (
        SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = 2022
    )
      AND ss.ss_net_paid > 0
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, i.i_category
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) >= 20
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    i_category,
    sold_qty,
    returned_qty,
    return_rate,
    total_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss'
        WHEN total_profit BETWEEN 0 AND 5000 THEN 'Low Profit'
        ELSE 'High Profit'
    END AS profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(return_rate) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_rate_by_profit
FROM store_return_stats
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 8

WITH store_return_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_id,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS returned_qty,
        (SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_quantity), 0)) AS return_rate,
        AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_quarter_seq = (
        SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = 2022
    )
      AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 202201 AND 202212
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, i.i_category
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) >= 5
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    i_category,
    sold_qty,
    returned_qty,
    return_rate,
    avg_sales_price,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_sales_price > 200 THEN 'Premium'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS price_segment,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sales_price DESC) AS price_rank,
    SUM(return_rate) OVER (ORDER BY return_rate ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS reverse_cumulative_return_rate
FROM store_return_stats
ORDER BY price_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH store_return_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_id,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS returned_qty,
