ORDER BY demographic_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH daily_inventory AS (SELECT inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_date_sk, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.inv_item_sk ORDER BY inv.inv_date_sk) AS rn FROM inventory inv), sales_daily AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sold_qty FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk), returns_daily AS (SELECT cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk), combined AS (SELECT di.inv_item_sk, di.inv_date_sk, di.inv_quantity_on_hand, LAG(di.inv_quantity_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY di.inv_item_sk ORDER BY di.inv_date_sk) AS prev_quantity, sd.total_sold_qty, rd.total_return_qty, rd.total_return_loss FROM daily_inventory di LEFT JOIN sales_daily sd ON di.inv_item_sk = sd.ws_item_sk AND di.inv_date_sk = sd.ws_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN returns_daily rd ON di.inv_item_sk = rd.cr_item_sk AND di.inv_date_sk = rd.cr_returned_date_sk) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, c.inv_date_sk, c.inv_quantity_on_hand, c.prev_quantity, COALESCE(c.total_sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty, COALESCE(c.total_return_qty, 0) AS return_qty, CASE WHEN c.prev_quantity IS NOT NULL AND c.inv_quantity_on_hand < c.prev_quantity - COALESCE(c.total_sold_qty, 0) + COALESCE(c.total_return_qty, 0) THEN 'Below Forecast' ELSE 'On Track' END AS inventory_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_sk ORDER BY c.inv_date_sk DESC) AS recent_inventory_seq FROM combined c JOIN item i ON c.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk ORDER BY i.i_item_sk, c.inv_date_sk DESC LIMIT 50

WITH brand_sales AS (SELECT i.i_brand, i.i_category, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS brand_profit, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS brand_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, i.i_category), brand_returns AS (SELECT i.i_brand, i.i_category, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS brand_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS returns_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, i.i_category), brand_inventory AS (SELECT i.i_brand, i.i_category, AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, i.i_category) SELECT bs.i_brand, bs.i_category, bs.brand_sales, COALESCE(br.brand_returns, 0) AS brand_returns, bs.brand_profit - COALESCE(br.brand_returns, 0) AS net_brand_profit, bs.orders_cnt, COALESCE(br.returns_cnt, 0) AS returns_cnt, bi.avg_inventory_qty, ROUND((bs.brand_profit - COALESCE(br.brand_returns, 0)) / NULLIF(bi.avg_inventory_qty, 0), 2) AS profit_per_inventory, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (bs.brand_profit - COALESCE(br.brand_returns, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (bs.brand_profit - COALESCE(br.brand_returns, 0)) DESC) AS profit_quartile, CASE WHEN (bs.brand_profit - COALESCE(br.brand_returns, 0)) > 50000 THEN 'Top Performer' WHEN (bs.brand_profit - COALESCE(br.brand_returns, 0)) BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 THEN 'Mid Performer' ELSE 'Low Performer' END AS performance_tier FROM brand_sales bs LEFT JOIN brand_returns br ON bs.i_brand = br.i_brand AND bs.i_category = br.i_category LEFT JOIN brand_inventory bi ON bs.i_brand = bi.i_brand AND bs.i_category = bi.i_category ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT cr.cr_item_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_returns, COUNT(*) AS returns_txn_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk), inv_agg AS (SELECT inv.inv_item_sk, AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory inv GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, s.total_sales, r.total_returns, s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS net_contribution, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 100000 THEN 'High Sales' WHEN s.total_sales BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Mid Sales' ELSE 'Low Sales' END AS sales_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, ROUND((s.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0)) / NULLIF(i.i_current_price * COALESCE(inv.avg_inventory_qty, 0), 0), 2) AS turnover_ratio FROM item i LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON i.i_item_sk = s.ws_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON i.i_item_sk = r.cr_item_sk LEFT JOIN inv_agg inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk WHERE i.i_current_price > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH daily_sales_brand AS (SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_brand, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS brand_daily_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS brand_daily_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_txn_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, i.i_brand), daily_returns_brand AS (SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_brand, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS brand_daily_returns, COUNT(*) AS returns_txn_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, i.i_brand), daily_inventory_brand AS (SELECT inv.inv_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_brand, AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS brand_avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY inv.inv_date_sk, i.i_brand), all_date_brand AS (SELECT DISTINCT date_sk, i_brand FROM (SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_brand AS i_brand FROM web_sales ws JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk UNION ALL SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_brand AS i_brand FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk UNION ALL SELECT inv.inv_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_brand AS i_brand FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk) d) SELECT d.date_sk, d.i_brand, COALESCE(s.brand_daily_sales, 0) AS brand_sales, COALESCE(r.brand_daily_returns, 0) AS brand_returns, COALESCE(s.brand_daily_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.brand_daily_returns, 0) AS net_contribution, COALESCE(i.brand_avg_inventory_qty, 0) AS avg_inventory_qty, SUM(COALESCE(s.brand_daily_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.brand_daily_returns, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.i_brand ORDER BY d.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_brand_net, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.i_brand ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.brand_daily_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.brand_daily_returns, 0)) DESC) AS daily_brand_rank, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.brand_daily_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.brand_daily_returns, 0) > 10000 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN COALESCE(s.brand_daily_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.brand_daily_returns, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'Poor' END AS performance_bucket FROM all_date_brand d LEFT JOIN daily_sales_brand s ON d.date_sk = s.date_sk AND d.i_brand = s.i_brand LEFT JOIN daily_returns_brand r ON d.date_sk = r.date_sk AND d.i_brand = r.i_brand LEFT JOIN daily_inventory_brand i ON d.date_sk = i.date_sk AND d.i_brand = i.i_brand ORDER BY d.date_sk DESC, d.i_brand LIMIT 30

WITH daily_store AS ( SELECT d.d_date, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim dc ON s.s_closed_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk WHERE (s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR d.d_date < dc.d_date) AND d.d_year = 2023 GROUP BY d.d_date, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name ) SELECT d_date, s_store_id, s_store_name, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, CASE WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_net_paid, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_net_paid, 0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_margin_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_date ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit_to_date FROM daily_store ORDER BY d_date, profit_rank

WITH catalog_cust AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2022 GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ), store_cust AS ( SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2022 GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk ), combined_cust AS ( SELECT customer_sk, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM ( SELECT * FROM catalog_cust UNION ALL SELECT * FROM store_cust ) c GROUP BY customer_sk ) SELECT customer_sk, total_net_profit, total_net_paid, CASE WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_net_paid, 0) > 0.25 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_net_paid, 0) > 0.15 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'Average' END AS profit_quality, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM combined_cust WHERE total_net_paid > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

WITH cat_monthly AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS cat_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cat_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ), store_monthly AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_quantity, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk WHERE s.s_state = 'CA' GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ), combined AS ( SELECT item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq, SUM(cat_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cat_sales) AS total_sales FROM cat_monthly GROUP BY item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq UNION ALL SELECT item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq, SUM(store_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(store_sales) AS total_sales FROM store_monthly GROUP BY item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq ) SELECT item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq, month_quantity, month_sales, CASE WHEN month_sales > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN month_sales > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY month_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM ( SELECT item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq, SUM(total_quantity) AS month_quantity, SUM(total_sales) AS month_sales FROM combined GROUP BY item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq ) t ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, sales_rank

WITH store_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date, s.s_store_id, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim dc ON s.s_closed_date_sk = dc.d_date_sk WHERE dc.d_date IS NULL OR d.d_date < dc.d_date GROUP BY d.d_date, s.s_store_id ), catalog_daily AS ( SELECT d_ship.d_date AS ship_date, AVG(date_diff('day', d_sold.d_date, d_ship.d_date)) AS avg_shipping_delay, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS catalog_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk GROUP BY d_ship.d_date ), joined_daily AS ( SELECT sd.d_date, sd.s_store_id, sd.store_net_paid, sd.store_net_profit, cd.catalog_net_paid, cd.catalog_net_profit, cd.avg_shipping_delay FROM store_daily sd JOIN catalog_daily cd ON sd.d_date = cd.ship_date WHERE sd.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2023-12-31' ) SELECT d_date, s_store_id, store_net_paid, store_net_profit, catalog_net_paid, catalog_net_profit, avg_shipping_delay, (store_net_profit + catalog_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, CASE WHEN (store_net_profit + catalog_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN (store_net_profit + catalog_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Moderate' END AS profit_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (store_net_profit + catalog_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM joined_daily ORDER BY profit_rank FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH promo_period AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_sk,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_cost,
        d_start.d_date AS start_date,
        d_end.d_date AS end_date,
        p.p_discount_active
    FROM promotion p
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_start
        ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_end
        ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk
),
promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_customer_sk END) AS preferred_customers,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk
),
promo_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        pp.p_promo_sk,
        pp.p_promo_name,
        pp.start_date,
        pp.end_date,
        pp.p_cost,
        ps.distinct_customers,
        ps.preferred_customers,
        ps.total_sales,
        ps.total_discount,
        ps.total_profit,
        CASE WHEN pp.p_cost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ps.total_sales / pp.p_cost END AS roi
    FROM promo_period pp
    LEFT JOIN promo_sales ps
        ON pp.p_promo_sk = ps.ss_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    pm.p_promo_sk,
    pm.p_promo_name,
    pm.start_date,
    pm.end_date,
    pm.p_cost,
    pm.distinct_customers,
    pm.preferred_customers,
    pm.total_sales,
    pm.total_discount,
    pm.total_profit,
    pm.roi,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pm.roi DESC NULLS LAST) AS roi_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN pm.roi > 2 THEN 'Highly Effective'
        WHEN pm.roi BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Moderately Effective'
        ELSE 'Low Effectiveness'
    END AS effectiveness_category
FROM promo_metrics pm
ORDER BY roi_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH customer_profit AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS total_transactions
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
),
promo_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_promo_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS promo_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk
),
promo_usage AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ss_customer_sk,
        pc.ss_promo_sk,
        pc.promo_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ss_customer_sk ORDER BY pc.promo_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM promo_counts pc
)
SELECT
    cp.c_customer_sk,
    cp.c_first_name,
    cp.c_last_name,
    cp.total_net_profit,
    cp.total_sales,
    cp.total_transactions,
    p.p_promo_name,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'VIP'
        ELSE 'Regular'
    END AS customer_segment,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM customer_profit cp
LEFT JOIN promo_usage pu
    ON cp.c_customer_sk = pu.ss_customer_sk
    AND pu.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN promotion p
    ON pu.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH monthly_store AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_customer_sk END) AS preferred_customers
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
),
monthly_promo AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS promo_discount_total,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_promo_sk) AS distinct_promos
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
        ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
),
store_rank AS (
    SELECT
        ms.ss_store_sk,
        ms.d_year,
        ms.d_month_seq,
        ms.total_net_paid,
        ms.total_discount,
        ms.total_net_profit,
        ms.distinct_customers,
        ms.preferred_customers,
        mp.total_promo_cost,
        mp.promo_discount_total,
        mp.distinct_promos,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ms.d_year, ms.d_month_seq ORDER BY ms.total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank,
        CASE
            WHEN ms.total_discount > (
                SELECT AVG(total_discount)
                FROM monthly_store
                WHERE d_year = ms.d_year AND d_month_seq = ms.d_month_seq
            ) THEN 'Above Avg Discount'
            ELSE 'Below Avg Discount'
        END AS discount_category
    FROM monthly_store ms
    LEFT JOIN monthly_promo mp
        ON ms.ss_store_sk = mp.ss_store_sk
        AND ms.d_year = mp.d_year
        AND ms.d_month_seq = mp.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    sr.ss_store_sk,
    sr.d_year,
    sr.d_month_seq,
    sr.total_net_paid,
    sr.total_discount,
    sr.total_net_profit,
    sr.distinct_customers,
    sr.preferred_customers,
    sr.total_promo_cost,
    sr.promo_discount_total,
    sr.distinct_promos,
    sr.sales_rank,
    sr.discount_category
FROM store_rank sr
WHERE sr.sales_rank <= 5
ORDER BY sr.d_year, sr.d_month_seq, sr.sales_rank

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_time_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, cr.cr_returned_time_sk AS returned_time_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_returned_time_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, sa.item_sk, sa.avg_profit, ra.total_loss, (sa.avg_profit - ra.total_loss) AS net_metric, CASE WHEN (sa.avg_profit - ra.total_loss) < 0 THEN 'Deficit' ELSE 'Surplus' END AS metric_status, t.t_hour AS sale_hour, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY (sa.avg_profit - ra.total_loss) DESC) AS metric_rank FROM sales_agg sa JOIN returns_agg ra ON sa.item_sk = ra.item_sk AND sa.sold_date_sk = ra.returned_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ra.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN time_dim t ON sa.sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 20 ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, metric_rank

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit_sum, COUNT(*) AS sale_cnt FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_time_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS loss_sum FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, sa.item_sk, sa.profit_sum, ra.loss_sum, (sa.profit_sum - ra.loss_sum) AS net_balance, sa.sale_cnt, CASE WHEN sa.profit_sum > ra.loss_sum THEN 'Gain' ELSE 'Deficit' END AS balance_status, t.t_hour AS sale_hour, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY (sa.profit_sum - ra.loss_sum) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM sales_agg sa JOIN returns_agg ra ON sa.item_sk = ra.item_sk AND sa.sold_date_sk = ra.returned_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ra.warehouse_sk JOIN time_dim t ON t.t_time_sk = sa.sold_time_sk WHERE t.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, balance_rank

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_ext_discount_amt < 100 GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 0 GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, sa.item_sk, sa.total_sales, ra.return_cnt, (sa.total_sales / NULLIF(ra.return_cnt,0)) AS sales_per_return, CASE WHEN ra.return_cnt = 0 THEN 'No Returns' ELSE 'Has Returns' END AS return_flag, t.t_hour AS sale_hour, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY (sa.total_sales / NULLIF(ra.return_cnt,0)) DESC) AS sales_return_rank FROM sales_agg sa JOIN returns_agg ra ON sa.item_sk = ra.item_sk AND sa.sold_date_sk = ra.returned_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ra.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN time_dim t ON t.t_time_sk = sa.sold_date_sk % 24 ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, sales_return_rank

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_paid FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 1 GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 0 GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, sa.item_sk, sa.total_paid, ra.total_return_amount, (sa.total_paid - ra.total_return_amount) AS net_amount, CASE WHEN (sa.total_paid - ra.total_return_amount) < 0 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Positive' END AS amount_status, t.t_hour AS sale_hour, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY (sa.total_paid - ra.total_return_amount) ASC) AS amount_rank FROM sales_agg sa JOIN returns_agg ra ON sa.item_sk = ra.item_sk AND sa.sold_date_sk = ra.returned_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = (SELECT MIN(w_warehouse_sk) FROM warehouse) JOIN time_dim t ON t.t_time_sk = (SELECT MAX(t_time_sk) FROM time_dim) ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, amount_rank

WITH all_ret AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS cust_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns sr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns wr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns wr), cust_ret_span AS (SELECT cust_sk, MIN(returned_date_sk) AS first_return_date, MAX(returned_date_sk) AS last_return_date, MAX(returned_date_sk) - MIN(returned_date_sk) AS return_span_days, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM all_ret GROUP BY cust_sk) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, crs.first_return_date, crs.last_return_date, crs.return_span_days, crs.total_returns, crs.total_net_loss, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY crs.total_net_loss DESC) AS gender_net_loss_percentile FROM cust_ret_span crs JOIN customer c ON crs.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE crs.return_span_days BETWEEN 30 AND 180 ORDER BY crs.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 40

WITH all_ret AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS cust_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns sr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns wr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns wr), cust_ret_span AS (SELECT cust_sk, MIN(returned_date_sk) AS first_return_date, MAX(returned_date_sk) AS last_return_date, MAX(returned_date_sk) - MIN(returned_date_sk) AS return_span_days, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM all_ret GROUP BY cust_sk) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, crs.first_return_date, crs.last_return_date, crs.return_span_days, crs.total_returns, crs.total_net_loss, SUM(crs.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender) AS gender_total_net_loss FROM cust_ret_span crs JOIN customer c ON crs.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE crs.total_returns >= 5 GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, crs.first_return_date, crs.last_return_date, crs.return_span_days, crs.total_returns, crs.total_net_loss ORDER BY crs.return_span_days ASC LIMIT 25

WITH all_ret AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS cust_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns sr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns wr UNION ALL SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns wr), cust_ret_span AS (SELECT cust_sk, MIN(returned_date_sk) AS first_return_date, MAX(returned_date_sk) AS last_return_date, MAX(returned_date_sk) - MIN(returned_date_sk) AS return_span_days, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM all_ret GROUP BY cust_sk HAVING COUNT(*) > 2), cust_ret_agg AS (SELECT crs.cust_sk, crs.first_return_date, crs.last_return_date, crs.return_span_days, crs.total_returns, crs.total_net_loss, crs.total_net_loss / crs.total_returns AS avg_loss_per_return FROM cust_ret_span crs) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, cra.first_return_date, cra.last_return_date, cra.return_span_days, cra.total_returns, cra.total_net_loss, cra.avg_loss_per_return, CASE WHEN cra.return_span_days > 730 THEN 'VERY_LONG' WHEN cra.return_span_days BETWEEN 365 AND 730 THEN 'LONG' ELSE 'SHORT' END AS span_category FROM cust_ret_agg cra JOIN customer c ON cra.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cra.avg_loss_per_return > 0 ORDER BY cra.avg_loss_per_return DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT
    cd_bill.cd_gender AS bill_gender,
    cd_bill.cd_marital_status AS bill_marital_status,
    cd_ship.cd_gender AS ship_gender,
    cd_ship.cd_marital_status AS ship_marital_status,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS segment_net_profit,
    AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'HighProfit'
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 20000 THEN 'MidProfit'
        ELSE 'LowProfit'
    END AS profit_class,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
GROUP BY cd_bill.cd_gender, cd_bill.cd_marital_status, cd_ship.cd_gender, cd_ship.cd_marital_status, sm.sm_type
ORDER BY segment_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH profit_by_ship AS (
  SELECT
      p.p_promo_name,
      sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
      cd.cd_gender,
      SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
      CASE
          WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'High'
          WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Medium'
          ELSE 'Low'
      END AS profit_category,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, cd.cd_gender
)
SELECT
    p_promo_name,
    sm_ship_mode_id,
    cd_gender,
    total_net_profit,
    profit_category,
    profit_rank
FROM profit_by_ship
WHERE profit_rank <= 5
ORDER BY p_promo_name, profit_rank, cd_gender

SELECT
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
    p.p_promo_name,
    sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
    cd.cd_gender,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit,
    LAG(SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_net_profit,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - LAG(SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS profit_change,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - LAG(SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) > 0 THEN 'Increase'
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - LAG(SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) < 0 THEN 'Decrease'
        ELSE 'No Change'
    END AS change_indicator
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, cd.cd_gender
ORDER BY p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_ship_mode_id, cs.cs_sold_date_sk

SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    sm.sm_type,
    p.p_promo_name,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_count,
    AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS net_paid_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, sm.sm_type, p.p_promo_name
ORDER BY sm.sm_type, net_paid_rank

WITH daily_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    i.inv_item_sk,
    d.d_year,
    d.d_month_seq,
    d.d_date,
    i.inv_quantity_on_hand,
    COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) AS daily_return_quantity,
    CASE 
      WHEN i.inv_quantity_on_hand = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) AS DOUBLE) / i.inv_quantity_on_hand
    END AS turnover_ratio
  FROM inventory i
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr 
    ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
   AND cr.cr_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk
  GROUP BY i.inv_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_date, i.inv_quantity_on_hand
),
monthly_turnover AS (
  SELECT 
    inv_item_sk,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    SUM(daily_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_quantity,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(SUM(daily_return_quantity) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand)
    END AS turnover_ratio
  FROM daily_stats
  GROUP BY inv_item_sk, d_year, d_month_seq
)
SELECT 
  inv_item_sk,
  d_year,
  d_month_seq,
  total_return_quantity,
  total_inventory_quantity,
  turnover_ratio,
  CASE 
    WHEN turnover_ratio > 0.5 THEN 'High'
    WHEN turnover_ratio > 0.2 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS turnover_category,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY turnover_ratio DESC) AS turnover_rank
FROM monthly_turnover
WHERE turnover_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, turnover_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH daily_losses AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.cc_call_center_id,
    cc.cc_name,
    d.d_date,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, d.d_date
)
SELECT 
  cc_call_center_id,
  cc_name,
  d_date,
  daily_net_loss,
  LAG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date) AS prev_day_net_loss,
  (daily_net_loss - LAG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date)) AS net_loss_change,
  AVG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7day,
  CASE 
    WHEN daily_net_loss > COALESCE(LAG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date), 0) THEN 'Increase'
    WHEN daily_net_loss < COALESCE(LAG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date), 0) THEN 'Decrease'
    ELSE 'No Change'
  END AS change_indicator,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY daily_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM daily_losses
WHERE d_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
ORDER BY cc_call_center_id, d_date
LIMIT 100

WITH loss_by_market_warehouse AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.cc_mkt_class,
    cc.cc_mkt_desc,
    cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
    d.d_year,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY cc.cc_mkt_class, cc.cc_mkt_desc, cr.cr_warehouse_sk, d.d_year
),
market_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    cc_mkt_class,
    cc_mkt_desc,
    d_year,
    SUM(total_net_loss) AS market_total_net_loss
  FROM loss_by_market_warehouse
  GROUP BY cc_mkt_class, cc_mkt_desc, d_year
)
SELECT 
  l.cc_mkt_class,
  l.cc_mkt_desc,
  l.d_year,
  l.cr_warehouse_sk,
  l.total_net_loss,
  l.total_return_amount,
  CASE 
    WHEN l.total_net_loss > 500000 THEN 'Critical'
    WHEN l.total_net_loss > 200000 THEN 'High'
    WHEN l.total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS loss_severity,
  l.total_net_loss / mt.market_total_net_loss AS warehouse_net_loss_pct,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.d_year ORDER BY l.total_net_loss DESC) AS yearly_market_rank,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.cc_mkt_class, l.d_year ORDER BY l.total_net_loss DESC) AS market_warehouse_rank
FROM loss_by_market_warehouse l
INNER JOIN market_totals mt 
  ON l.cc_mkt_class = mt.cc_mkt_class
 AND l.cc_mkt_desc = mt.cc_mkt_desc
 AND l.d_year = mt.d_year
ORDER BY l.d_year, l.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH sales_line AS (SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk, ss.ss_quantity AS sold_qty, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit FROM store_sales ss), returns_line AS (SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number, sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_cdemo_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_qty, sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt FROM store_returns sr), joined AS (SELECT s.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, s.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, s.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, s.ss_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, SUM(s.sold_qty) AS total_sold_qty, SUM(COALESCE(r.return_qty,0)) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(s.sold_qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(COALESCE(r.return_qty,0))*1.0 / SUM(s.sold_qty)) END AS return_ratio FROM sales_line s LEFT JOIN returns_line r ON s.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number AND s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk GROUP BY s.ss_store_sk, s.ss_sold_date_sk, s.ss_item_sk, s.ss_cdemo_sk), with_item AS (SELECT j.*, i.i_brand, i.i_product_name, cd.cd_gender FROM joined j JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = j.item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = j.cdemo_sk), ranked_items AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_sk, date_sk ORDER BY return_ratio DESC) AS rn FROM with_item) SELECT store_sk, date_sk, item_sk, i_brand, i_product_name, cd_gender, total_sold_qty, total_return_qty, return_ratio, CASE WHEN return_ratio > 0.5 THEN 'High' WHEN return_ratio > 0.2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS ratio_category FROM ranked_items WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY store_sk, date_sk, return_ratio DESC

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_cdemo_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_cdemo_sk) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, s.total_sales, r.total_return_amt, (s.total_profit - (r.total_return_amt + r.total_refunded_cash + r.total_net_loss)) AS adjusted_profit, CASE WHEN (s.total_profit - (r.total_return_amt + r.total_refunded_cash + r.total_net_loss)) < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS profit_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_brand ORDER BY (s.total_profit - (r.total_return_amt + r.total_refunded_cash + r.total_net_loss)) DESC) AS brand_profit_rank FROM sales_agg s JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk AND s.ss_cdemo_sk = r.sr_cdemo_sk JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = s.ss_cdemo_sk WHERE i.i_brand IS NOT NULL ORDER BY brand_profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_demo_item AS (SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, i.i_brand, i.i_category, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit_amount FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, i.i_brand, i.i_category), returns_demo_item AS (SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, i.i_brand, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS refunded_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS net_loss_amount FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, i.i_brand, i.i_category) SELECT s.cd_gender, s.cd_marital_status, s.i_brand, s.i_category, s.sales_amount, s.profit_amount, r.return_amount, r.refunded_amount, r.net_loss_amount, (s.profit_amount - (r.return_amount + r.refunded_amount + r.net_loss_amount)) AS adjusted_profit, CASE WHEN (s.profit_amount - (r.return_amount + r.refunded_amount + r.net_loss_amount)) < 0 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Positive' END AS profit_indicator, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.profit_amount - (r.return_amount + r.refunded_amount + r.net_loss_amount)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_demo_item s LEFT JOIN returns_demo_item r ON s.cd_demo_sk = r.cd_demo_sk AND s.i_brand = r.i_brand AND s.i_category = r.i_category ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH brand_gender_monthly AS (SELECT i.i_brand AS brand, cd.cd_gender AS gender, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS month_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, cd.cd_gender, ss.ss_sold_date_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT i.i_brand AS brand, cd.cd_gender AS gender, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS refunded_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS net_loss_amount FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, cd.cd_gender, sr.sr_returned_date_sk), combined_monthly AS (SELECT b.brand, b.gender, b.date_sk, b.month_profit, b.month_sales, COALESCE(r.return_amount,0) AS return_amount, COALESCE(r.refunded_amount,0) AS refunded_amount, COALESCE(r.net_loss_amount,0) AS net_loss_amount, (b.month_profit - (COALESCE(r.return_amount,0) + COALESCE(r.refunded_amount,0) + COALESCE(r.net_loss_amount,0))) AS adjusted_profit FROM brand_gender_monthly b LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON b.brand = r.brand AND b.gender = r.gender AND b.date_sk = r.date_sk), profit_trends AS (SELECT brand, gender, date_sk, adjusted_profit, month_sales, SUM(adjusted_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, gender ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, LAG(adjusted_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, gender ORDER BY date_sk) AS prev_month_profit, AVG(adjusted_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, gender ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3m, CASE WHEN LAG(adjusted_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, gender ORDER BY date_sk) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN adjusted_profit > LAG(adjusted_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, gender ORDER BY date_sk) THEN 'Increase' WHEN adjusted_profit < LAG(adjusted_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, gender ORDER BY date_sk) THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'No Change' END AS profit_change FROM combined_monthly) SELECT brand, gender, date_sk, adjusted_profit, cumulative_profit, prev_month_profit, moving_avg_3m, profit_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY adjusted_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM profit_trends WHERE date_sk >= (SELECT MAX(date_sk) - 12 FROM combined_monthly) ORDER BY brand, date_sk

WITH cust_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
        AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_qty,
        MIN(t.t_hour) AS first_purchase_hour,
        MAX(t.t_hour) AS last_purchase_hour,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.t_hour) AS distinct_purchase_hours
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential
)
SELECT
    cs.c_customer_id,
    cs.c_first_name,
    cs.c_last_name,
    cs.c_birth_year,
    cs.hd_income_band_sk,
    cs.hd_buy_potential,
    cs.total_sales,
    cs.total_profit,
    cs.txn_cnt,
    cs.avg_qty,
    cs.first_purchase_hour,
    cs.last_purchase_hour,
    cs.distinct_purchase_hours,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.total_sales >= 200000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cs.total_sales >= 100000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN cs.total_sales >= 50000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS customer_tier,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank
FROM cust_sales cs
ORDER BY sales_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH hour_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS hour_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS hour_profit,
        AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_customer_cnt,
        AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour
)
SELECT
    hs.t_hour,
    hs.hour_sales,
    hs.hour_profit,
    hs.avg_discount,
    hs.distinct_customers,
    hs.preferred_customer_cnt,
    hs.avg_vehicle_count,
    LAG(hs.hour_profit) OVER (ORDER BY hs.t_hour) AS prev_hour_profit,
    hs.hour_profit - LAG(hs.hour_profit) OVER (ORDER BY hs.t_hour) AS profit_delta,
    CASE
        WHEN hs.hour_profit > LAG(hs.hour_profit) OVER (ORDER BY hs.t_hour) THEN 'Increase'
        WHEN hs.hour_profit < LAG(hs.hour_profit) OVER (ORDER BY hs.t_hour) THEN 'Decrease'
        ELSE 'No Change'
    END AS profit_trend,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hs.hour_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM hour_stats hs
ORDER BY hs.t_hour

WITH cust_txn AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_current_hdemo_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        t.t_hour,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk DESC) AS rn,
        LAG(ss.ss_sold_date_sk) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk DESC) AS prev_date,
        LAG(t.t_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk DESC) AS prev_hour
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
),
churn_calc AS (
    SELECT
        ct.c_customer_sk,
        ct.c_customer_id,
        ct.c_first_name,
        ct.c_last_name,
        ct.c_current_hdemo_sk,
        ct.ss_sold_date_sk AS latest_purchase_date,
        ct.prev_date AS previous_purchase_date,
        ct.t_hour AS latest_purchase_hour,
        ct.prev_hour AS previous_purchase_hour,
        CASE
            WHEN ct.prev_date IS NULL THEN 'New'
            WHEN ct.ss_sold_date_sk - ct.prev_date > 30 THEN 'At Risk'
            ELSE 'Active'
        END AS churn_status,
        ct.ss_sold_date_sk - ct.prev_date AS days_since_last_purchase,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ct.ss_sold_date_sk - ct.prev_date) DESC NULLS LAST) AS churn_rank
    FROM cust_txn ct
    WHERE ct.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    cc.c_customer_id,
    cc.c_first_name,
    cc.c_last_name,
    cc.latest_purchase_date,
    cc.previous_purchase_date,
    cc.days_since_last_purchase,
    cc.latest_purchase_hour,
    cc.previous_purchase_hour,
    cc.churn_status,
    cc.churn_rank,
    hd.hd_buy_potential,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    hd.hd_dep_count
FROM churn_calc cc
LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON cc.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
ORDER BY cc.churn_rank
LIMIT 50

WITH item_store_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk
),
item_store_rank AS (
    SELECT
        isa.*, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY isa.ss_store_sk ORDER BY isa.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM item_store_agg isa
),
item_demo AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        COUNT(*) AS demo_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential
),
item_customer AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        AVG(c.c_birth_year) AS avg_birth_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk
),
item_time AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        t.t_hour,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS qty_by_hour
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, t.t_hour
)
SELECT
    isr.ss_store_sk,
    isr.ss_item_sk,
    isr.total_sales,
    isr.total_profit,
    isr.txn_cnt,
    isr.total_qty,
    isr.sales_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN isr.total_profit / NULLIF(isr.total_sales, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Margin'
        WHEN isr.total_profit / NULLIF(isr.total_sales, 0) BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.2 THEN 'Medium Margin'
        ELSE 'Low Margin'
    END AS profit_category,
    (
        SELECT it.t_hour
        FROM item_time it
        WHERE it.ss_store_sk = isr.ss_store_sk
          AND it.ss_item_sk = isr.ss_item_sk
        ORDER BY it.qty_by_hour DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS peak_hour,
    ic.avg_birth_year,
    ic.distinct_customers,
    id.hd_buy_potential,
    id.demo_cnt,
    id.demo_cnt * 100.0 / SUM(id.demo_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY isr.ss_store_sk, isr.ss_item_sk) AS buy_potential_pct
FROM item_store_rank isr
LEFT JOIN item_customer ic ON isr.ss_store_sk = ic.ss_store_sk AND isr.ss_item_sk = ic.ss_item_sk
LEFT JOIN item_demo id ON isr.ss_store_sk = id.ss_store_sk AND isr.ss_item_sk = id.ss_item_sk
ORDER BY isr.ss_store_sk, isr.sales_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH page_quarter_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS store_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, d_year, d_quarter_seq, total_sales, total_quantity, avg_discount, store_count, total_sales * 0.1 AS estimated_tax, MAX(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department) AS max_dept_sales FROM page_quarter_sales WHERE store_count >= 5 ORDER BY cp_department, total_sales DESC LIMIT 200

WITH page_quarter_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS store_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2015 GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 50000 ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, d_year, d_quarter_seq, total_sales, total_quantity, avg_discount, store_count, total_sales / NULLIF(total_quantity,0) AS avg_price_per_item, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS dept_page_rownum FROM page_quarter_sales ORDER BY cp_department, dept_page_rownum LIMIT 200

WITH page_quarter_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS store_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, d_year, d_quarter_seq, total_sales, total_quantity, avg_discount, store_count, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 0.05 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN avg_discount BETWEEN 0.02 AND 0.05 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY d_quarter_seq ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS future_quarter_sales FROM page_quarter_sales ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_seq, total_sales DESC LIMIT 200

WITH address_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_location_type, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_return_quantity, hd.hd_vehicle_count, i.i_brand FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk ), city_agg AS ( SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, AVG(hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i_brand) AS distinct_brands FROM address_returns GROUP BY ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type ) SELECT ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_qty, cnt_returns, avg_vehicle_count, distinct_brands, SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS state_total_return, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss) AS cum_dist FROM city_agg WHERE cnt_returns BETWEEN 3 AND 10 GROUP BY ca_city, ca_state, ca_location_type, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_qty, cnt_returns, avg_vehicle_count, distinct_brands ORDER BY cum_dist DESC LIMIT 15

WITH demographic_sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(ss.ss_ticket_number) AS transaction_cnt, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ) SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, total_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN total_profit > 10000 THEN 'TOP' WHEN total_profit > 5000 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_tier, transaction_cnt, avg_discount FROM demographic_sales ORDER BY profit_rank

SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_net_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY cs.cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, APPROX_DISTINCT(cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department) AS dept_customer_approx_cnt, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department) AS dept_avg_discount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cp.cp_department IS NOT NULL

SELECT cp.cp_department, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_discount_last3, LAG(cs.cs_net_profit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS prev_profit, CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 500 AND (cs.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(LAG(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk), 0)) > 200 THEN 'SURGE' WHEN cs.cs_net_profit < 0 THEN 'LOSS' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS profit_trend FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cp.cp_department IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cp.cp_department, cs.cs_sold_date_sk

WITH quarterly_profit AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_quarter_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_quarter_name ), quarterly_lag AS ( SELECT qp.d_year, qp.d_quarter_seq, qp.d_quarter_name, qp.total_profit, LAG(qp.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY qp.d_year, qp.d_quarter_seq) AS prev_total_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(qp.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY qp.d_year, qp.d_quarter_seq) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (qp.total_profit - LAG(qp.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY qp.d_year, qp.d_quarter_seq)) / LAG(qp.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY qp.d_year, qp.d_quarter_seq) * 100 END AS profit_growth_pct FROM quarterly_profit qp ), store_closed_counts AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_quarter_name, COUNT(s.s_store_id) AS stores_closed FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_quarter_name ) SELECT ql.d_year, ql.d_quarter_name, ql.total_profit, ql.prev_total_profit, ql.profit_growth_pct, COALESCE(scc.stores_closed, 0) AS stores_closed, CASE WHEN ql.profit_growth_pct IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN ql.profit_growth_pct > 20 THEN 'Strong Growth' WHEN ql.profit_growth_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 20 THEN 'Moderate Growth' ELSE 'Decline' END AS growth_category FROM quarterly_lag ql LEFT JOIN store_closed_counts scc ON ql.d_year = scc.d_year AND ql.d_quarter_seq = scc.d_quarter_seq ORDER BY ql.d_year DESC, ql.d_quarter_seq DESC LIMIT 20

WITH customer_orders AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_net_paid, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt, d_sold.d_date AS order_date, LAG(ws.ws_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY d_sold.d_date) AS prev_net_paid FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d_first.d_year AS first_sales_year, d_last.d_year AS last_review_year, DATE_DIFF('day', d_first.d_date, d_last.d_date) AS days_active, COALESCE(SUM(co.ws_net_paid), 0) AS total_net_paid, COALESCE(AVG(co.ws_ext_discount_amt), 0) AS avg_discount, COALESCE(AVG(co.prev_net_paid), 0) AS avg_prev_net_paid, COALESCE(AVG(co.ws_net_paid - co.prev_net_paid), 0) AS avg_net_paid_change, COUNT(co.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(co.ws_net_paid), 0) DESC) AS spend_rank, CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d_first.d_date, d_last.d_date) > 3650 THEN 'Loyal' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(co.ws_net_paid), 0) > 5000 THEN 'HighSpender' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_segment FROM customer c LEFT JOIN date_dim d_first ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_first.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_last ON c.c_last_review_date = d_last.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN customer_orders co ON co.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d_first.d_year, d_last.d_year, d_first.d_date, d_last.d_date HAVING COALESCE(SUM(co.ws_net_paid), 0) > 0 ORDER BY spend_rank LIMIT 50

WITH combined_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amt, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr UNION ALL SELECT sr.sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns sr ), reason_stats AS ( SELECT cr.reason_sk, AVG(cr.return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, AVG(cr.net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns FROM combined_returns cr GROUP BY cr.reason_sk ) SELECT r.r_reason_id, r.r_reason_desc, rs.avg_return_amt, rs.avg_net_loss, rs.cnt_returns, CASE WHEN rs.avg_return_amt > 500 THEN 'HIGH_RETURN' WHEN rs.avg_return_amt BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 'MID_RETURN' ELSE 'LOW_RETURN' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.avg_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM reason_stats rs JOIN reason r ON rs.reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH combined AS ( SELECT 'store' AS return_type, sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr.sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_qty, sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk FROM store_returns sr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog' AS return_type, NULL AS store_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_qty, cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amt, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk FROM catalog_returns cr ) SELECT s.s_store_name, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(c.return_qty) AS total_quantity, SUM(c.return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(c.net_loss) AS total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_name ORDER BY SUM(c.net_loss) DESC) AS reason_loss_rank FROM combined c LEFT JOIN store s ON c.store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN reason r ON c.reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_name, r.r_reason_desc HAVING SUM(c.net_loss) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.s_store_name, reason_loss_rank LIMIT 50

WITH unified AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, NULL AS store_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, cr.cr_return_quantity AS qty, cr.cr_return_amount AS amt, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr UNION ALL SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk, sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr.sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS qty, sr.sr_return_amt AS amt, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns sr ), cust_store_reason_agg AS ( SELECT customer_sk, store_sk, reason_sk, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(amt) AS total_amt, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM unified GROUP BY customer_sk, store_sk, reason_sk ), cust_store_best_reason AS ( SELECT csra.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY csra.customer_sk, csra.store_sk ORDER BY csra.total_net_loss DESC) AS rn FROM cust_store_reason_agg csra ), cust_best_store AS ( SELECT csbr.customer_sk, csbr.store_sk, SUM(csbr.total_qty) AS store_total_qty, SUM(csbr.total_amt) AS store_total_amt, SUM(csbr.total_net_loss) AS store_total_net_loss, MAX(CASE WHEN csbr.rn = 1 THEN csbr.reason_sk END) AS top_reason_sk FROM cust_store_best_reason csbr GROUP BY csbr.customer_sk, csbr.store_sk ) SELECT cbs.customer_sk, s.s_store_name, cbs.store_total_qty, cbs.store_total_amt, cbs.store_total_net_loss, CASE WHEN cbs.store_total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN cbs.store_total_net_loss BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cbs.store_total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, r.r_reason_desc AS top_reason_desc FROM cust_best_store cbs LEFT JOIN store s ON cbs.store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN reason r ON cbs.top_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE cbs.store_total_net_loss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 5

WITH combined AS ( SELECT cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, NULL AS store_sk FROM catalog_returns cr UNION ALL SELECT sr.sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss, sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk FROM store_returns sr ), reason_cumulative AS ( SELECT c.reason_sk, c.date_sk, SUM(c.net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY c.reason_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss FROM combined c ), store_reason_share AS ( SELECT c.store_sk, c.reason_sk, SUM(c.net_loss) AS store_reason_net_loss FROM combined c WHERE c.store_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.store_sk, c.reason_sk ) SELECT s.s_store_name, r.r_reason_desc, rc.date_sk, rc.cumulative_net_loss, srs.store_reason_net_loss, CASE WHEN srs.store_reason_net_loss / NULLIF(rc.cumulative_net_loss, 0) > 0.5 THEN 'DOMINANT' ELSE 'MINOR' END AS contribution_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_name ORDER BY rc.cumulative_net_loss DESC) AS reason_rank FROM reason_cumulative rc JOIN store_reason_share srs ON rc.reason_sk = srs.reason_sk JOIN store s ON srs.store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN reason r ON rc.reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk ORDER BY s.s_store_name, reason_rank LIMIT 50

WITH customer_returns AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM customer_returns
    GROUP BY customer_sk
)
SELECT
    ca.customer_sk,
    ca.total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN ca.total_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'VIP_HIGH_LOSS'
        WHEN ca.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'VIP_MEDIUM_LOSS'
        ELSE 'VIP_LOW_LOSS'
    END AS loss_tier,
    SUM(ca.total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM customer_agg ca
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk
),
web_warehouse AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
       AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk
),
warehouse_combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(cw.warehouse_sk, ww.warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_sk,
        COALESCE(cw.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(ww.total_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
        (COALESCE(ww.total_net_profit, 0) - COALESCE(cw.total_net_loss, 0)) AS net_difference
    FROM catalog_warehouse cw
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_warehouse ww
        ON cw.warehouse_sk = ww.warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
    wc.warehouse_sk,
    wc.total_net_loss,
    wc.total_net_profit,
    wc.net_difference,
    CASE
        WHEN wc.net_difference > 0 THEN 'PROFITABLE'
        ELSE 'LOSS'
    END AS warehouse_status,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wc.net_difference DESC) AS profit_rank,
    SUM(wc.net_difference) OVER (ORDER BY wc.net_difference DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_difference
FROM warehouse_combined wc
ORDER BY wc.net_difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH all_returns AS (
    SELECT cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
           cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
           cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
           cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT wr.wr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
           wr.wr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
           wr.wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
)
SELECT r.r_reason_desc,
       SUM(ar.return_qty) AS total_return_qty,
       SUM(ar.return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
       SUM(ar.net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       CASE
           WHEN SUM(ar.net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH'
           WHEN SUM(ar.net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
           ELSE 'LOW'
       END AS loss_category,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ar.net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM all_returns ar
JOIN reason r ON ar.reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    wr.wr_order_number,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    wr.wr_return_quantity,
    wr.wr_return_amt,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    ws.ws_sales_price,
    (ws.ws_sales_price * ws.ws_quantity) AS sales_total,
    (ws.ws_sales_price * ws.ws_quantity) - wr.wr_return_amt AS discrepancy,
    CASE
        WHEN (ws.ws_sales_price * ws.ws_quantity) - wr.wr_return_amt > 0 THEN 'OVER_CHARGE'
        WHEN (ws.ws_sales_price * ws.ws_quantity) - wr.wr_return_amt < 0 THEN 'UNDER_CHARGE'
        ELSE 'BALANCED'
    END AS discrepancy_type,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS((ws.ws_sales_price * ws.ws_quantity) - wr.wr_return_amt) DESC) AS discrepancy_rank
FROM web_returns wr
JOIN web_sales ws
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
JOIN reason r
    ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
ORDER BY discrepancy_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH combined AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_net_profit, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, cr.cr_net_loss FROM web_sales ws LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON ws.ws_order_number = cr.cr_order_number), item_profit AS (SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk, ws_web_site_sk, (ws_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss,0)) / NULLIF(ws_ext_sales_price,0) AS profit_margin FROM combined), avg_profit AS (SELECT item_sk, ws_web_site_sk, AVG(profit_margin) AS avg_profit_margin FROM item_profit GROUP BY item_sk, ws_web_site_sk) SELECT ap.item_sk, wsit.web_name, ap.avg_profit_margin, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ap.avg_profit_margin DESC) AS margin_rank, CASE WHEN ap.avg_profit_margin >= 0.30 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN ap.avg_profit_margin >= 0.15 THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'POOR' END AS margin_category FROM avg_profit ap JOIN web_site wsit ON ap.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY ap.avg_profit_margin DESC LIMIT 10

WITH sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, ws.ws_net_profit, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk, ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk FROM web_sales ws), returns AS (SELECT cr.cr_order_number, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk, cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk FROM catalog_returns cr) SELECT wsit.web_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(r.cr_return_amount) AS total_returns, SUM(r.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(r.cr_net_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price),0) > 0.5 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(r.cr_net_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price),0) > 0.2 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(r.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r ON s.ws_order_number = r.cr_order_number LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON r.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN web_site wsit ON s.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk GROUP BY wsit.web_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH customer_returns AS (SELECT cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk), customer_sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk) SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cr.total_return_qty, cr.total_return_amount, cr.total_net_loss, cs.total_orders, cs.total_sales_amount, cs.distinct_items, wsit.web_name, CASE WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_severity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cr.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cr.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rownum FROM customer_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN customer_sales cs ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.ws_bill_cdemo_sk LEFT JOIN web_site wsit ON cs.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH returns_agg AS (SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS gender_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN web_sales ws ON cr.cr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, cd.cd_gender), sales_agg AS (SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS sales_revenue FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk) SELECT wsit.web_name, s.date_sk, s.sales_revenue, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(r.male_return_loss,0) AS male_return_loss, COALESCE(r.female_return_loss,0) AS female_return_loss, (s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) AS net_revenue, LAG(s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY s.date_sk) AS prior_net_revenue, CASE WHEN LAG(s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY s.date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) > LAG(s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY s.date_sk) THEN 'INCREASE' ELSE 'DECREASE' END AS revenue_trend, ROUND(100.0 * ((s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) - LAG(s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY s.date_sk)) / NULLIF(LAG(s.sales_revenue - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY s.date_sk),0),2) AS mom_growth_percent FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN (SELECT site_sk, date_sk, SUM(gender_return_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(CASE WHEN cd_gender = 'M' THEN gender_return_loss ELSE 0 END) AS male_return_loss, SUM(CASE WHEN cd_gender = 'F' THEN gender_return_loss ELSE 0 END) AS female_return_loss FROM returns_agg GROUP BY site_sk, date_sk) r ON s.site_sk = r.site_sk AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON s.site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY wsit.web_name, s.date_sk

WITH store_return_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_id,
        i.i_category,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS returned_qty,
        (SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_quantity), 0)) AS return_rate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_fy_quarter_seq = (
        SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = 2022
    )
      AND ss.ss_sales_price > 0
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, i.i_category
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) > 0
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    i_category,
    sold_qty,
    returned_qty,
    return_rate,
    distinct_tickets,
    CASE
        WHEN distinct_tickets > 500 THEN 'High Volume'
        WHEN distinct_tickets BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 'Medium Volume'
        ELSE 'Low Volume'
    END AS volume_level,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY distinct_tickets DESC) AS volume_rank,
    SUM(return_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY return_rate DESC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS future_cumulative_return
FROM store_return_stats
ORDER BY volume_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT cs_sold_time_sk,
           SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_profit,
           SUM(cs_quantity) AS catalog_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales
    GROUP BY cs_sold_time_sk
),
ws_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_sold_time_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_profit,
           SUM(ws_quantity) AS web_quantity
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_sold_time_sk
)
SELECT
    t.t_hour,
    t.t_am_pm,
    cs_agg.catalog_profit,
    ws_agg.web_profit,
    cs_agg.catalog_quantity,
    ws_agg.web_quantity,
    cs_agg.catalog_profit - ws_agg.web_profit AS profit_diff,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs_agg.catalog_profit DESC) AS catalog_profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN cs_agg.catalog_profit > ws_agg.web_profit THEN 'Catalog Higher'
        WHEN cs_agg.catalog_profit < ws_agg.web_profit THEN 'Web Higher'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS profit_comparison
FROM time_dim t
LEFT JOIN cs_agg ON cs_agg.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
LEFT JOIN ws_agg ON ws_agg.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
WHERE t.t_hour IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.t_hour, t.t_am_pm

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk,
           SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_profit,
           SUM(cs_quantity) AS catalog_qty
    FROM catalog_sales
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk
),
ws_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_profit,
           SUM(ws_quantity) AS web_qty
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk
),
wr_agg AS (
    SELECT wr_item_sk,
           SUM(wr_net_loss) AS return_loss,
           SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS return_qty
    FROM web_returns
    GROUP BY wr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(cs_agg.cs_item_sk, ws_agg.ws_item_sk) AS item_sk,
    cs_agg.catalog_profit,
    ws_agg.web_profit,
    wr_agg.return_loss,
    (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
    (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.return_loss, 0)) / (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit)
    END AS profit_margin,
    CASE
        WHEN (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.return_loss, 0)) / NULLIF((cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit), 0) > 0.5 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.return_loss, 0)) / NULLIF((cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit), 0) > 0.2 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.return_loss, 0)) / NULLIF((cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit), 0) > 0.0 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Poor'
    END AS margin_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM cs_agg
FULL OUTER JOIN ws_agg ON cs_agg.cs_item_sk = ws_agg.ws_item_sk
LEFT JOIN wr_agg ON COALESCE(cs_agg.cs_item_sk, ws_agg.ws_item_sk) = wr_agg.wr_item_sk
WHERE (cs_agg.catalog_profit + ws_agg.web_profit) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH return_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_original_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
     AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
),
return_hour AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk,
        t.t_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS hour_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t
      ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, t.t_hour
)
SELECT
    rs.wr_returning_customer_sk,
    rs.total_original_profit,
    rs.total_return_loss,
    rs.return_cnt,
    rs.total_return_qty,
    (rs.total_original_profit - rs.total_return_loss) AS net_effect,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_return_loss DESC) AS loss_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.total_return_loss > 10000 THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN rs.total_return_loss > 5000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN rs.total_return_loss > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_severity,
    rh.t_hour AS peak_return_hour
FROM return_sales rs
LEFT JOIN return_hour rh
  ON rs.wr_returning_customer_sk = rh.wr_returning_customer_sk
 AND rh.rn = 1
WHERE rs.total_return_loss > 0
ORDER BY rs.total_return_loss DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH catalog_hourly AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour AS hour,
        t.t_am_pm,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS hourly_profit,
        'Catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim t
      ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_am_pm
),
web_hourly AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour AS hour,
        t.t_am_pm,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS hourly_profit,
        'Web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t
      ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_am_pm
),
returns_hourly AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour AS hour,
        t.t_am_pm,
        -SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS hourly_profit,
        'Returns' AS channel
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t
      ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_am_pm
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM catalog_hourly
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_hourly
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM returns_hourly
)
SELECT
    channel,
    hour,
    t_am_pm,
    hourly_profit,
